# Phase 230 (D-23): the honest-skip set, as data.
#
# WHY THIS FILE EXISTS
# `ci-gate` counts a `skipped` conclusion as a pass, so "this lane was skipped" is
# indistinguishable from "this lane passed" unless the legitimate skips are enumerated
# somewhere a machine can read. That enumeration used to live only as prose in
# MAINTAINING.md. Prose is now a RENDERER of this file, not a second source of truth:
# scripts/ci/prohibitions/p21-honest-skip-parity.test.mjs asserts
# manifest <=> ci.yml <=> MAINTAINING.md and fails in every direction (an undocumented
# demotion, a stale doc entry, or a manifest row naming a construct ci.yml does not have).
#
# CONSUMERS
#   - scripts/ci/ci-demotion-observer.sh                   reads the `assert` rows to
#                                                          decide what must have executed
#                                                          on a non-pull_request run
#   - scripts/ci/prohibitions/p21-honest-skip-parity.test.mjs   three-way parity guard
#   - Phase 231 GATE-03                                    SHOULD read this file rather
#                                                          than re-deriving the set.
#                                                          GATE-03 owns the `ci-gate`
#                                                          pass/fail consequence; this
#                                                          file owns the enumeration.
#                                                          The pull_request half belongs
#                                                          in GATE-03, not here.
#
# TIERS
#   A  event-gated, pre-existing (Phase 196). NOT demoted by Phase 230. Phase 231's
#      GATE-01/GATE-02 own these; the observer deliberately does NOT assert on them --
#      asserting would add a tenth red to a 0-pass/9-fail nightly, which is the
#      unread-noise failure this milestone exists to remove.
#   B  event-gated, demoted BY Phase 230. These are exactly what AFTER-PUSH must observe
#      executing on the receiving lane.
#   C  diff-gated (docs-only). Skips on the CONTENT of the diff rather than the event --
#      a different audit question from A/B.
#
# COLUMNS (TAB-separated; `#` and blank lines are comments)
#   tier           A | B | C
#   kind           job | step
#   id             the ci.yml job id, or the step `id:` when kind=step. Every id here
#                  MUST resolve in ci.yml -- the parity guard asserts it, which is what
#                  stops this file from drifting into fiction.
#   parent_job_id  owning job id when kind=step; `-` when kind=job. A step row's parent
#                  MUST also appear here as a kind=job row -- that is how the observer
#                  resolves the parent's display_name (the Actions API returns names,
#                  never ids).
#   display_name   the job `name:` / step `name:` EXACTLY as ci.yml spells it. The
#                  parity guard pins id and display_name adjacent in ci.yml so the
#                  API-facing lookup cannot rot independently of the id-facing guard.
#   gate_level     job | step -- WHERE the predicate is applied. For the four
#                  ruleset-required tier-C lanes this MUST stay `step`: a job-level
#                  docs_only gate would make the required context `skipped` and can
#                  strand a PR under ruleset 14941512 (D-06).
#   gate           the literal gating predicate, normalized (${{ }} stripped, whitespace
#                  collapsed)
#   observer       assert | exempt | ignore
#                    assert = must have executed on a non-PR run (tier B only)
#                    exempt = event-gated but ALSO outcome-gated, so a skip on a healthy
#                             run is CORRECT -- never assert
#                    ignore = outside the observer's scope (tier A / tier C)
#
tier	kind	id	parent_job_id	display_name	gate_level	gate	observer
A	job	install_matrix	-	Install matrix (flag combinations)	job	github.event_name != 'pull_request'	ignore
A	job	upgrade_smoke	-	Upgrade smoke (published source series -> local candidate)	job	github.event_name != 'pull_request'	ignore
A	job	passkeys_manual_fallback_smoke	-	Passkeys manual fallback smoke	job	github.event_name != 'pull_request'	ignore
A	job	passkeys_opt_out_smoke	-	Passkeys opt-out smoke	job	github.event_name != 'pull_request'	ignore
A	job	nightly_probe	-	Nightly probe (forced-failure self-test)	job	github.event_name != 'pull_request'	ignore
A	job	admin_design_recapture	-	Recapture admin-design baselines (in-CI)	job	github.event_name != 'pull_request' && inputs.phase_244_final_main != true	ignore
A	job	admin_checkpoint_recapture	-	Recapture admin-checkpoint baselines (in-CI)	job	github.event_name != 'pull_request' && inputs.phase_244_final_main != true	ignore
A	job	notify_release_lane_rot	-	Notify on red ci-gate (release-lane-rot)	job	always() && github.event_name != 'pull_request' && needs.ci-gate.result == 'failure'	exempt
B	job	admin_eval_render	-	Admin eval render + probe (hard signal on push/schedule/dispatch; not in ci-gate)	job	github.event_name != 'pull_request'	assert
C	job	example_playwright_shard	-	Example Playwright shard (design_gallery)	step	!(github.event_name == 'pull_request' && needs.changes.result == 'success' && needs.changes.outputs.docs_only == 'true')	ignore
C	job	example_unit_smoke	-	Example unit smoke (ExUnit + ConnTest)	step	needs.changes.result != 'success' || needs.changes.outputs.docs_only != 'true'	ignore
C	job	install_smoke	-	Install smoke (fresh phx.new + sigra.install)	step	needs.changes.result != 'success' || needs.changes.outputs.docs_only != 'true'	ignore
C	job	example_http_smoke	-	Example HTTP smoke (boot + curl critical routes)	step	needs.changes.result != 'success' || needs.changes.outputs.docs_only != 'true'	ignore
C	step	admin_behavior	example_playwright_shard	Run admin behavior browser truth	step	!cancelled() && !(github.event_name == 'pull_request' && needs.changes.result == 'success' && needs.changes.outputs.docs_only == 'true') && matrix.seam == 'admin_behavior'	ignore
C	step	admin_checkpoints	example_playwright_shard	Run admin checkpoints	step	!cancelled() && !(github.event_name == 'pull_request' && needs.changes.result == 'success' && needs.changes.outputs.docs_only == 'true') && matrix.seam == 'admin_checkpoints'	ignore
C	step	design_gallery	example_playwright_shard	Run design gallery behavior	step	!cancelled() && !(github.event_name == 'pull_request' && needs.changes.result == 'success' && needs.changes.outputs.docs_only == 'true') && matrix.seam == 'design_gallery' && github.event_name == 'pull_request'	ignore
B	step	design_gallery_snapshots	example_playwright_shard	Run design gallery behavior and snapshots	step	!cancelled() && !(github.event_name == 'pull_request' && needs.changes.result == 'success' && needs.changes.outputs.docs_only == 'true') && matrix.seam == 'design_gallery' && github.event_name != 'pull_request'	assert
C	step	non_admin_smoke	example_playwright_shard	Run non-admin example browser smoke	step	!cancelled() && !(github.event_name == 'pull_request' && needs.changes.result == 'success' && needs.changes.outputs.docs_only == 'true') && matrix.seam == 'non_admin_smoke'	ignore
C	step	demo_showcase	example_playwright_shard	Run demo showcase	step	!cancelled() && !(github.event_name == 'pull_request' && needs.changes.result == 'success' && needs.changes.outputs.docs_only == 'true') && matrix.seam == 'demo_showcase'	ignore

version: 2
updates:
  - package-ecosystem: "github-actions"
    directory: "/"
    schedule:
      interval: "weekly"
    commit-message:
      prefix: "ci"
    labels:
      - "dependencies"
      - "ci"
  - package-ecosystem: "mix"
    directory: "/"
    schedule:
      interval: "weekly"
    commit-message:
      prefix: "deps"
    labels:
      - "dependencies"
  - package-ecosystem: "npm"
    directory: "/test/example/priv/playwright"
    schedule:
      interval: "weekly"
    commit-message:
      prefix: "deps"
    labels:
      - "dependencies"

name: CI

on:
  # Release-ref evidence path: manually dispatch this workflow from a v* tag
  # (`gh workflow run "CI" --ref v1.0.0` or Actions UI) to rerun canonical gates.
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      force_fail_probe:
        description: 'Intentionally fail a nightly-gated job to verify the nightly lane reports red (set true to probe).'
        required: false
        type: boolean
        default: false
      force_rot_probe:
        description: 'Inject a synthetic rotted skip into the GATE-03 honest-skip verdict so the fail direction of ci-gate is provable on demand (set true to probe).'
        required: false
        type: boolean
        default: false
      recapture_branch:
        description: 'Branch to run branch-scoped baseline recapture against (D-04). When set, the two amd64 recapture jobs (admin_design_recapture, admin_checkpoint_recapture) run on this ref and their PRs target it instead of main. Leave empty for ordinary release-evidence dispatches.'
        required: false
        type: string
        default: ''
      phase_244_final_main:
        description: 'Run required Phase 244 final-main consumers without baseline recapture jobs.'
        required: false
        type: boolean
        default: false
  schedule:
    # Nightly-broad run (04:30 UTC). Avoids the 45 6 slot used by playwright-github-pages.yml.
    # Runs the 5 exhaustive/low-probability jobs that are skipped on pull_request events.
    - cron: '30 4 * * *'
  push:
    branches: [main, release-please--branches--main]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]

# Least-privilege default for GITHUB_TOKEN: CI only reads the repo and
# uploads artifacts (via actions/upload-artifact, which does not require
# contents: write). Any job that needs additional scopes must override
# `permissions:` at the job level.
permissions:
  contents: read

# Phase 230 (FAST-04 / D-12, D-13, D-14): PR runs on the same PR number supersede
# each other (superseded run concludes `cancelled`). Every non-PR event (push,
# schedule, workflow_dispatch) keys on its own unique github.run_id, giving it a
# group of one that is structurally never queued and never cancelled — release
# integrity does not depend on the value of any expression. SEED-005's verbatim
# proposal (group on github.ref with a conditional cancel-in-progress) was
# rejected: cancel-in-progress: false still *queues* (GitHub holds one running
# plus one pending per group), and queueing two rapid main pushes compounds the
# release lane's 30-minute gate-ci-green polling ceiling. cancel-in-progress is
# a bare boolean, never an expression producing a quoted string — the string
# "false" is truthy and would cancel anyway. ci.yml's triggers are
# push: branches: [main] plus pull_request: branches: [main], so there is no
# same-SHA double trigger and the "cancelled run strands a required context"
# hazard does not apply.
concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.event.pull_request.number || github.run_id }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

# Note: Repository secret HEX_API_KEY (Hex.pm) is not read by this workflow unless
# you add an explicit publish job with `env: HEX_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.HEX_API_KEY }}`.
# Library/install failures are unrelated to that secret.

jobs:
  release_ref_guard:
    name: Release ref guard
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    # Phase 230 (FAST-07 / D-19, D-20): every job below declares an explicit
    # timeout-minutes so a hung job fails in bounded time instead of consuming
    # the 360-minute GitHub Actions default. Sizing rule: ~2x the live-measured
    # duration from PR run 30390832059 / push run 30389700235 (230-EVIDENCE.md),
    # floor 5 minutes, widened for warm-cache/network-bound/high-historical-max
    # jobs. The clock starts when the job is scheduled onto a runner, so queue
    # and setup time count against the ceiling. example_playwright_smoke is
    # deliberately generous (45) per D-20: it measured 28.5m and has hit 41.7m
    # historically, so a tighter ceiling would time out the very runs this
    # phase is judged on -- tightening is Phase 235's job once the new steady
    # state is measured post-reshape.
    timeout-minutes: 5
    steps:
      - name: Require release tag ref for manual release evidence
        env:
          EVENT_NAME: ${{ github.event_name }}
          PHASE_244_FINAL_MAIN: ${{ inputs.phase_244_final_main }}
          RECAPTURE_BRANCH: ${{ inputs.recapture_branch }}
          FORCE_FAIL_PROBE: ${{ inputs.force_fail_probe }}
          FORCE_ROT_PROBE: ${{ inputs.force_rot_probe }}
          REF: ${{ github.ref }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          if [ "$EVENT_NAME" != "workflow_dispatch" ]; then
            echo "Non-manual CI run; release-ref guard not applicable."
            exit 0
          fi
          if [ "$PHASE_244_FINAL_MAIN" = "true" ]; then
            if [ "$REF" = "refs/heads/main" ] && [ -z "$RECAPTURE_BRANCH" ] \
              && [ "$FORCE_FAIL_PROBE" = "false" ] && [ "$FORCE_ROT_PROBE" = "false" ]; then
              echo "Authorized Phase 244 final-main dispatch; recapture jobs remain excluded."
              exit 0
            fi
            echo "Phase 244 final-main dispatch requires exact main, empty recapture input, and false probes."
            exit 1
          fi
          if [ -n "$RECAPTURE_BRANCH" ]; then
            echo "Recapture dispatch (recapture_branch=$RECAPTURE_BRANCH); release-ref guard not applicable."
            exit 0
          fi
          case "${GITHUB_REF}" in
            refs/tags/v*) ;;
            *)
              echo "Manual CI release-evidence runs must use refs/tags/v*; got ${GITHUB_REF}"
              echo "Run with: gh workflow run \"CI\" --ref v1.0.0"
              exit 1
              ;;
          esac

  # Phase 230 (FAST-05 / D-07): fail-open docs-only classifier. Placed
  # immediately after release_ref_guard so it reads as the top of the DAG.
  # This job NEVER decides whether a required job runs (that would be a
  # trigger-level `paths:` filter, D-06's hard-fail boundary -- a
  # required workflow filtered at the trigger never creates its check
  # contexts and the PR sits permanently unmergeable). It only computes a
  # boolean that the four app-behaviour required lanes consume at the STEP
  # level (D-07) to skip their cost body while still reporting `success`.
  changes:
    name: Detect docs-only change
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 5
    outputs:
      docs_only: ${{ steps.detect.outputs.docs_only }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1  # v7.0.1
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
      - name: Detect docs-only change
        id: detect
        shell: bash
        env:
          EVENT_NAME: ${{ github.event_name }}
          BASE_REF: ${{ github.base_ref }}
        # Phase 230 (FAST-05 / D-07): polarity is fail-open -- consumers
        # test `!= 'true'`, so an empty or missing output runs the heavy
        # steps and the failure mode is "we ran the full matrix
        # unnecessarily", never "a required lane silently skipped". The
        # boolean is computed once here rather than in five jobs because
        # four of the five consumers use a bare `actions/checkout` without
        # `fetch-depth: 0`. Measured no-op cost of this shape: ~36s. The
        # classification rule itself lives in
        # scripts/ci/docs-only-classify.sh rather than in this run body
        # because the docs_only=true branch cannot be observed on any
        # pre-merge pull request (ci.yml triggers on
        # pull_request: branches: [main], so any pre-merge PR's diff
        # necessarily carries this phase's own non-Markdown changes) -- a
        # hermetic self-test wired into fast_checks is the only evidence
        # available inside the phase window, and an inlined rule would
        # have none. github.base_ref/github.event_name reach this shell
        # only via the env: mapping above, never inlined into the run
        # body (ASVS V5, notify-failure-issue.sh:14-18), so a crafted
        # context string cannot inject shell or workflow commands.
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          if [ "${EVENT_NAME}" != "pull_request" ]; then
            echo "docs_only=false" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
            exit 0
          fi
          git fetch origin "${BASE_REF}" --depth=1
          git diff --name-only "origin/${BASE_REF}...HEAD" | bash scripts/ci/docs-only-classify.sh | tee -a "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

  # Phase 194 (CACHE-02): 6 trivial leaf guard jobs folded into one fast_checks
  # job (single checkout + single base-ref resolve) to cut 6 runner cold-starts.
  # Each guard is a distinct named run: step so per-guard failure remains legible
  # in the Actions UI. release_ref_guard stays standalone (D-12).
  # Phase 230 (FAST-05 / D-07): deliberately EXEMPT from docs-only gating.
  # milestone-verification-gate.sh walks .planning/**, getting-started-contract.sh
  # link-checks guides/introduction/getting-started.md, and the ExUnit files under
  # test/sigra/planning/ and test/sigra/*guides* read those paths directly --
  # exactly what a docs-only PR changes. Gating this job would remove coverage
  # in the one dimension the change touches.
  fast_checks:
    name: Fast checks (milestone/installer/contracts/snapshot/ledger guards)
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 10
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1  # v7.0.1
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
      - name: Resolve base ref
        id: base
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          if [ "${{ github.event_name }}" = "pull_request" ]; then
            git fetch origin "${{ github.base_ref }}"
            MB=$(git merge-base "origin/${{ github.base_ref }}" HEAD)
            echo "ref=${MB}" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          else
            echo "ref=HEAD~1" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          fi
      - name: Milestone verification gate
        run: bash scripts/ci/milestone-verification-gate.sh
      - name: Detect installer-related changes (PRs only)
        id: detect
        shell: bash
        # Phase 51: include GA-adjacent lib surfaces (MFA/OAuth/account/passkeys) — see MAINTAINING.md §Installer golden CI contract.
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          if [ "${{ github.event_name }}" != "pull_request" ]; then
            echo "run=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
            exit 0
          fi
          if git diff --name-only "origin/${{ github.base_ref }}...HEAD" | grep -qE '^priv/templates/sigra\.install/|^lib/sigra/install/|^lib/sigra/mfa(\.ex|/)|^lib/sigra/oauth(\.ex|/)|^lib/sigra/account(\.ex|/)|^lib/sigra/passkeys(\.ex|/)'; then
            echo "run=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          else
            echo "run=false" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          fi
      - name: Installer milestone audit (INT-01..03)
        if: steps.detect.outputs.run == 'true'
        run: bash scripts/ci/installer-milestone-audit.sh
      - name: Getting started doc contract
        run: bash scripts/ci/getting-started-contract.sh
      - name: Phase 34 UAT contracts
        run: scripts/ci/phase34-uat-contracts.sh
      - name: Snapshot drift guard (canary allowlist)
        run: bash scripts/ci/snapshot-canary-guard.sh --base "${{ steps.base.outputs.ref }}"
      - name: Snapshot drift guard — design lane
        run: |
          SNAP_DIR="test/example/priv/playwright/tests/admin-design.spec.ts-snapshots" \
          bash scripts/ci/snapshot-canary-guard.sh \
            --base "${{ steps.base.outputs.ref }}" \
            --allowlist test/example/priv/playwright/snapshot-allowlist-design \
            --canary board-notice
      - name: Quality ledger monotonic guard
        run: bash scripts/ci/quality-ledger-monotonic.sh --base "${{ steps.base.outputs.ref }}"
      - name: Quality ledger monotonic guard self-test
        run: bash scripts/ci/quality-ledger-monotonic.test.sh
      # Phase 216 (HARNESS-FOUNDATION): admin eval guards — read committed ledgers + merge-base.
      # These are the merge-blocking forward-only ratchets for the admin eval harness.
      # The expensive render+probe Playwright run is in the separate admin_eval_render job (JUDGE-CI-01).
      - name: Quality findings monotonic guard
        # Phase 216 Plan 07: open finding counts in admin-render-sha.json may not increase vs merge-base.
        run: bash scripts/ci/quality-findings-monotonic.sh --base "${{ steps.base.outputs.ref }}"
      - name: Quality findings monotonic guard self-test
        run: bash scripts/ci/quality-findings-monotonic.test.sh
      - name: Award ledger verify-then-climb guard
        # Phase 216 Plan 07 (D-20): axis up only with fresh verified_at_sha + resolving evidence; band==min(axes).
        run: node scripts/ci/award-guard.mjs --base "${{ steps.base.outputs.ref }}"
      - name: Award ledger verify-then-climb guard self-test
        run: node scripts/ci/award-guard.test.mjs
      - name: Settled findings lint
        # Phase 216 Plan 07: settled-findings.tsv must be sorted + no duplicate finding_id.
        run: bash scripts/ci/settled-findings-lint.sh
      - name: Settled findings lint self-test
        run: bash scripts/ci/settled-findings-lint.test.sh
      - name: Evidence anchor integrity check
        # Phase 216 Plan 07 (D-09): every finding anchor must resolve in captured DOM.
        # Soft-skips (exit 0) when no bundles present in a clean checkout — the full
        # check runs in admin_eval_render where bundles are produced.
        run: node scripts/ci/evidence-anchor-check.mjs
      - name: Stale-render guard self-test
        # Phase 216 Plan 07: unit self-test only — stale-render-guard.sh itself runs in
        # admin_eval_render (it hard-fails on absent bundles, so it cannot run here).
        run: bash scripts/ci/stale-render-guard.test.sh
      - name: Check app.css for orphaned corruption
        # Phase 214 (DEBT-05 / D-17): guard against sg-* split orphaned value
        # fragments re-entering the :root block of test/example's app.css.
        run: bash scripts/ci/app-css-corruption-check.sh
      - name: app.css corruption guard self-test
        # Phase 221 Plan 02 (SHIP-03 / D-10): regression proof that the guard
        # catches an orphan bare value immediately after a ;-terminated decl.
        run: bash scripts/ci/app-css-corruption-check.test.sh
      - name: Upgrade-smoke resolver self-test
        # Phase 222 Plan 01 (HARD-01): offline proof that resolve-sigra-source.sh
        # durably excludes the immutable Hex stray 1.20.0 without a hand-maintained
        # per-release floor. No network call — stubs `mix hex.info sigra`.
        run: bash scripts/ci/upgrade-smoke.test.sh
      - name: Notify-failure-issue self-test
        # Phase 222 Plan 02 (HARD-01/HARD-02/D-07): hermetic proof that the shared
        # tracking-issue notifier is idempotent (create-once / comment-once) and
        # fail-closed on missing LABEL/TITLE/BODY. No real `gh` CLI or network call.
        run: bash scripts/ci/notify-failure-issue.test.sh
      - name: Pages legacy-branch script self-test
        # Phase 240 Plan 01 (GREEN-05/SC-3): hermetic proof that
        # ensure-github-pages-legacy-branch.sh exits 1 on every non-2xx Pages API
        # status except the one named, documented PUT-403, and never POST-creates
        # a Pages site on a 403/500. PATH-shadowed fake `gh`; no network call.
        run: bash scripts/ci/ensure-github-pages-legacy-branch.test.sh
      - name: GREEN-04 evidence collector self-test
        # Quick task 260918-lfq (CR-01/CR-02/SELFTEST-CI): hermetic proof that
        # capture-green-04-evidence.sh fails CLOSED rather than emitting a clean
        # receipt when an SC-2 job selector matches zero jobs, when a matched job
        # has a null conclusion, when the `main` window is below the run floor, or
        # when the window does not contain the dispatch run. Each token is observed
        # RED against a stub payload that triggers it. Stub `gh` on PATH and a
        # throwaway git repo: no token, no network, no Postgres.
        run: bash scripts/ci/capture-green-04-evidence.test.sh
      - name: Panel forced-floor check self-test
        # Phase 217 Plan 03 (SC-1/D-06): 12-cell grid completeness + NONE token + anchor validation.
        # Self-test only — does NOT run panel-forced-floor-check.mjs over live panel output
        # (no committed panel-findings.json at this phase's scope).
        run: node scripts/ci/panel-forced-floor-check.test.mjs
      - name: Panel CI-isolation self-test
        # Phase 217 Plan 03 (SC-5/JUDGE-CI-01): negative-assertion proof that no workflow
        # run: step invokes the panel or auto-fix loop orchestrators.
        run: bash scripts/ci/panel-ci-isolation.test.sh
      - name: Fix-apply self-test
        # Phase 217 Plan 06 (SC-4): hermetic proof that fix-apply.mjs enforces +/-1.0px band,
        # refuses ties/>1.0px/CSS/component/judgment; copy-swap is text-node-only; !important preserved.
        run: node scripts/panel/fix-apply.test.mjs
      - name: Auto-fix loop self-test
        # Phase 217 Plan 06 (SC-4): hermetic proof that admin-autofix-loop.sh fires git revert on
        # rail 1 (count-monotonic), the finding lands in settled-findings.tsv (waived), and the
        # poison-set prevents re-apply. The loop binary itself is NOT wired into CI (JUDGE-CI-01).
        run: bash scripts/ci/admin-autofix-loop.test.sh
      - name: Fix-queue lint
        # Phase 217 (WR-01): validates guides/reference/fix-queue.json on the merge path
        # (auto_eligible derivation, finding_id keyspace, sort/dedup). Reads committed
        # state only — no DB, browser, or API key.
        run: bash scripts/ci/fix-queue-lint.sh
      - name: Panel verdicts lint
        # Phase 217 (WR-01): validates guides/reference/admin-panel-verdicts.json on the
        # merge path (T-217-05-EOP: never stores open_findings; finding_id integrity).
        run: bash scripts/ci/panel-verdicts-lint.sh
      # Phase 217 (WR-02): Phase-217 self-tests that were written but never executed
      # on any merge lane. The five below are fully hermetic (built-in node modules /
      # bash only — no cheerio, DB, browser, or API key) and run on the ubuntu-latest
      # default node with zero added setup cost.
      - name: Anchor lib self-test
        run: node scripts/ci/lib/anchor.test.mjs
      - name: Panel schema self-test
        run: node scripts/panel/panel-schema.test.mjs
      - name: Fix-queue build self-test
        run: node scripts/ci/fix-queue-build.test.mjs
      - name: Fix-queue lint self-test
        run: bash scripts/ci/fix-queue-lint.test.sh
      - name: Panel verdicts lint self-test
        run: bash scripts/ci/panel-verdicts-lint.test.sh
      - name: CI run metrics self-test
        # Phase 230 (D-21 / SC-5): hermetic proof that ci-run-metrics.sh clamps negative
        # durations to 0, never filters per-job durations by conclusion (a
        # continue-on-error "failure" job still counts), and fails closed on a missing
        # `gh`, a non-zero `gh` exit, or an empty job list. The measuring script itself
        # is NOT run here -- it requires a live `gh` against a real run -- only its
        # PATH-shadowed self-test, which makes no network call and needs no GH_TOKEN.
        run: bash scripts/ci/ci-run-metrics.test.sh
      - name: Offline attestation runtime self-test
        run: bash scripts/ci/verify-terminal-ratification-attestation-offline.test.sh
      - name: Verify retained terminal attestation offline
        # This is intentionally in required fast_checks: every PR and main push
        # revalidates the retained signature, policy, receipt digest, and
        # adversarial failure cases with networking disabled.
        # The verifier is sha256-pinned by the phase 235 contract tests, so it
        # cannot be edited to look in the archive; the shim gives it a staged
        # ROOT instead and runs its exact reviewed bytes.
        run: >-
          bash scripts/ci/run-pinned-phase-verifier.sh
          verify-terminal-ratification-attestation-offline.sh
          235-terminal-ratification-measured-not-read
      - name: Docs-only classifier self-test
        # Phase 230 (FAST-05 / D-07): hermetic proof that the docs-only
        # classification rule is correct in both directions, plus the
        # empty-input and crafted-path cases (docs.md/evil.ex,
        # .planning-evil/x.ex, a git-quoted embedded-escape path never
        # forces the true branch). No network, no git repository, no gh.
        # This is deliberately NOT gated on docs_only -- fast_checks runs
        # in full on every event -- and it is the only in-phase evidence
        # for the true branch: ci.yml triggers on
        # pull_request: branches: [main], so any pre-merge pull request's
        # base-to-HEAD diff necessarily carries this phase's own
        # non-Markdown commits and can never classify docs_only=true.
        # AFTER-DOCSONLY (the end-to-end true observation) is a
        # post-merge obligation recorded in 230-EVIDENCE.md; this
        # self-test is what stands between the rule and silent rot until
        # then.
        run: bash scripts/ci/docs-only-classify.test.sh
      - name: Playwright cache key guard
        # Phase 230 (FAST-06 / D-18): proves the version embedded in
        # example_playwright_smoke's Playwright browser cache key tracks
        # the resolved @playwright/test version in
        # test/example/priv/playwright/package-lock.json (D-16, D-18). Does
        # NOT cover the browser set ("chromium-webkit") encoded in the same
        # key -- that is D-16's concern and is asserted structurally by
        # plan 06 Task 1's ci.yml verify block. No live `gh`, no
        # artifacts -- both this guard and its self-test run unconditionally.
        run: bash scripts/ci/playwright-cache-key-guard.sh
      - name: Playwright cache key guard self-test
        run: bash scripts/ci/playwright-cache-key-guard.test.sh
      - name: Demotion observer self-test
        # Phase 230 closeout: the observer behind .github/workflows/ci-observe.yml's
        # demotion receipt -- the standing, permanent form of the AFTER-PUSH evidence
        # item. Its load-bearing case is the fail-OPEN hole: an unfinished construct
        # serializes `completedAt: "0001-01-01T00:00:00Z"` and `conclusion: ""`, which a
        # duration check clamps to 0s (indistinguishable from a skip) and a
        # `conclusion != 'skipped'` check waves through. Hermetic: a PATH-shadowed
        # recording `gh`, no network, no GH_TOKEN.
        run: bash scripts/ci/ci-demotion-observer.test.sh
      - name: Wait-for-ci-gate self-test
        # Phase 231 (DX-05 / D-20, D-21): hermetic proof that the extracted
        # release-lane poll loop (scripts/ci/wait-for-ci-gate.sh, invoked by
        # release-please.yml's gate-ci-green job) is fail-closed and its 120-attempt
        # ceiling is wired. It is hermetic, so it proves the logic and never that a
        # real release passed the gate -- that half is the standing receipt D-21
        # books against the next real release (and the live invocation already
        # recorded for this phase's own tracer slice against run 30466318240).
        run: bash scripts/ci/wait-for-ci-gate.test.sh
      - name: Honest-skip verdict self-test
        # Phase 231 (GATE-03 / D-01, D-03, D-04): hermetic proof that the
        # manifest-driven legitimacy verdict (scripts/ci/honest-skip-verdict.sh)
        # is correct in both directions -- an allowed skip passes, the same
        # skip on a non-pull_request event fails naming the lane, and an
        # allowed skip with a rotted (branch- or SHA-keyed) manifest gate
        # fails anyway -- and fails closed on its own vacuity (an empty
        # manifest intersection, a fully empty lane-result map, a workflow
        # needs: parse yielding nothing). It is hermetic, so it proves the
        # logic and never that ci-gate actually invokes it -- that half is
        # plan 231-09's wiring step plus SC-3's two dispatched runs.
        run: bash scripts/ci/honest-skip-verdict.test.sh
      - name: Phase 230 prohibition guards
        # Phase 230 closeout: the 13 `verification: test` prohibitions recorded across
        # 230-01..09-PLAN.md, mechanized. Each file is the `check_target` in its
        # prohibition's frontmatter, and GSD's `check prohibition-enforcement` proves each
        # one fail-FIRST against a known-bad fixture in test/fixtures/prohibitions/ before
        # accepting a pass -- so these cannot rot into vacuous greens without the phase
        # verification noticing. node:test rather than the repo's usual ExUnit idiom
        # because that producer accepts only `node-test` / `lint-rule`.
        # A bare directory arg is NOT valid here (node 22 resolves it as a module); the
        # shell glob is load-bearing.
        run: node --test --test-reporter=tap scripts/ci/prohibitions/*.test.mjs
      - name: Docs-only receipt self-test
        # Phase 230 closeout: the observer behind ci-observe.yml's docs-only receipt --
        # the standing form of AFTER-DOCSONLY. Asserts the five ruleset-required contexts
        # stay merge-eligible on a docs_only=true run while fast_checks and the library
        # suite still execute in full, and that an unestablishable classification is
        # never silently read as `false`.
        run: bash scripts/ci/docs-only-receipt.test.sh
      # Phase 217 (WR-02): excerpt.test.mjs and judge.test.mjs transitively require
      # cheerio (excerpt.mjs / judge.mjs load it from the Playwright subproject
      # node_modules), so they need the playwright deps installed first. Pin node and
      # do a scoped `npm ci` so these two self-tests still run on the merge path.
      - uses: actions/setup-node@820762786026740c76f36085b0efc47a31fe5020  # v7.0.0
        with:
          node-version: '20'
          cache: 'npm'
          cache-dependency-path: 'test/example/priv/playwright/package-lock.json'
      - name: Install Playwright subproject deps (for cheerio-backed self-tests)
        working-directory: test/example/priv/playwright
        run: npm ci --ignore-scripts
      - name: Excerpt self-test
        run: node scripts/panel/excerpt.test.mjs
      - name: Judge self-test
        run: node scripts/panel/judge.test.mjs
      - name: Judge CLI bundle-wiring self-test
        run: node scripts/panel/judge-cli.test.mjs

  install_golden_contract:
    name: Install golden + idempotency contract (subprocess harness)
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 15
    needs: release_ref_guard
    services:
      postgres:
        image: postgres:15
        env:
          POSTGRES_PASSWORD: postgres
          POSTGRES_DB: sigra_test
        ports: ['5432:5432']
        options: >-
          --health-cmd pg_isready --health-interval 10s
          --health-timeout 5s --health-retries 5
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1  # v7.0.1
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
      - name: Detect installer-related changes (PRs only)
        id: detect
        shell: bash
        # Phase 51: include GA-adjacent lib surfaces (MFA/OAuth/account/passkeys) — see MAINTAINING.md §Installer golden CI contract.
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          if [ "${{ github.event_name }}" != "pull_request" ]; then
            echo "run=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
            exit 0
          fi
          git fetch origin "${{ github.base_ref }}" --depth=1
          if git diff --name-only "origin/${{ github.base_ref }}...HEAD" | grep -qE '^priv/templates/sigra\.install/|^lib/sigra/install/|^lib/sigra/mfa(\.ex|/)|^lib/sigra/oauth(\.ex|/)|^lib/sigra/account(\.ex|/)|^lib/sigra/passkeys(\.ex|/)'; then
            echo "run=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          else
            echo "run=false" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          fi
      - uses: erlef/setup-beam@54075bcc5e249e4758d363f27d099f55d843f124  # v1.24.1
        id: setup
        if: steps.detect.outputs.run == 'true'
        with:
          version-file: .tool-versions
          version-type: strict
      - name: Cache library deps
        id: install_golden_deps_cache
        if: steps.detect.outputs.run == 'true'
        uses: actions/cache@55cc8345863c7cc4c66a329aec7e433d2d1c52a9  # v6.1.0
        with:
          path: |
            deps
            _build
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-library-otp${{ steps.setup.outputs.otp-version }}-elixir${{ steps.setup.outputs.elixir-version }}-test-${{ hashFiles('mix.lock') }}-v1
          restore-keys: ${{ runner.os }}-library-otp${{ steps.setup.outputs.otp-version }}-elixir${{ steps.setup.outputs.elixir-version }}-test-
      - name: Install Hex + Rebar
        if: steps.detect.outputs.run == 'true'
        run: |
          mix local.hex --force
          mix local.rebar --force
      - name: Install phx_new archive
        if: steps.detect.outputs.run == 'true'
        run: mix archive.install --force hex phx_new 1.8.8
      - name: Fetch library deps
        if: steps.detect.outputs.run == 'true'
        run: mix deps.get
      - name: Run install golden + idempotency tests
        if: steps.detect.outputs.run == 'true'
        env:
          MIX_ENV: test
          PGUSER: postgres
          PGPASSWORD: postgres
          PGHOST: localhost
        run: mix test test/sigra/install/golden_diff_test.exs test/sigra/install/idempotency_test.exs
      # D-06 (Phase 213): hard-gate drift-detector — rebless_golden --check verifies that
      # the committed fixture exactly matches what the pinned phx_new archive generates.
      # Exits 2 on drift (non-zero fails the job). No continue-on-error. Runs only when
      # installer-related changes are detected (gated by the same detect step above).
      - name: Fixture drift-detector (rebless_golden --check)
        if: steps.detect.outputs.run == 'true'
        env:
          MIX_ENV: test
          PGUSER: postgres
          PGPASSWORD: postgres
          PGHOST: localhost
        run: mix sigra.fixture.rebless_golden --check

  # DX-01: sole full-library-suite owner. It deliberately remains exempt from
  # docs-only gating: repository-facing documentation changes still need the
  # library contract checked on every pull request.
  library_tests_shard:
    name: Library tests shard
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 20
    needs: release_ref_guard
    services:
      postgres:
        image: postgres:15
        env:
          POSTGRES_PASSWORD: postgres
          # Sigra.Test.PostgresRepo and admin/audit integration tests expect this DB to exist.
          POSTGRES_DB: sigra_test
        ports: ['5432:5432']
        options: >-
          --health-cmd pg_isready --health-interval 10s
          --health-timeout 5s --health-retries 5
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1  # v7.0.1
      - uses: erlef/setup-beam@54075bcc5e249e4758d363f27d099f55d843f124  # v1.24.1
        id: setup
        with:
          version-file: .tool-versions
          version-type: strict
      - name: Cache library deps
        id: deps_cache
        uses: actions/cache@55cc8345863c7cc4c66a329aec7e433d2d1c52a9  # v6.1.0
        with:
          path: |
            deps
            _build
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-library-otp${{ steps.setup.outputs.otp-version }}-elixir${{ steps.setup.outputs.elixir-version }}-test-${{ hashFiles('mix.lock') }}-v1
          restore-keys: ${{ runner.os }}-library-otp${{ steps.setup.outputs.otp-version }}-elixir${{ steps.setup.outputs.elixir-version }}-test-
      - name: Install Hex + Rebar
        run: |
          mix local.hex --force
          mix local.rebar --force
      # phx_new archive is required by test/sigra/install/golden_diff_test.exs
      # and idempotency_test.exs — both use InstallFixture.setup_tmp_app/1
      # which shells out to `mix phx.new` to scaffold a fresh Phoenix app.
      - name: Install phx_new archive
        run: mix archive.install --force hex phx_new 1.8.8
      - name: Fetch library deps
        run: mix deps.get
      - name: Prepare timing output directory
        run: mkdir -p test-results
      - name: Run contributor CI gate
        env:
          PGUSER: postgres
          MIX_ENV: test
          PGPASSWORD: postgres
          PGHOST: localhost
          SIGRA_EXUNIT_TIMING_JSON: test-results/ci-exunit-timing-main.json
          SIGRA_EXUNIT_TIMING_INVOCATION: main
          SIGRA_EXUNIT_TIMING_THREADLINE_GUARD_JSON: test-results/ci-exunit-timing-threadline-guard.json
        # Local equivalent: run: MIX_ENV=test mix ci (MIX_ENV is set above).
        run: mix ci
      - name: Upload library test timing
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@043fb46d1a93c77aae656e7c1c64a875d1fc6a0a # v7.0.1
        with:
          name: library-test-timing-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}
          path: |
            test-results/ci-exunit-timing-main.json
            test-results/ci-exunit-timing-threadline-guard.json
          retention-days: 7
          if-no-files-found: warn
      - name: Capture CI measurement metadata
        if: always()
        env:
          JOB_NAME: Library tests shard
          CONFIGURED_NODE: ''
          DEPS_CACHE_HIT: ${{ steps.deps_cache.outputs.cache-hit }}
          EXAMPLE_DEPS_CACHE_HIT: ''
          INSTALL_DEPS_CACHE_HIT: ''
          HTTP_DEPS_CACHE_HIT: ''
          BROWSER_DEPS_CACHE_HIT: ''
          BROWSER_CACHE_HIT: ''
        run: |
          node <<'NODE'
          const fs = require('node:fs');
          const { spawnSync } = require('node:child_process');
          const readTool = (name) => {
            try { return fs.readFileSync('.tool-versions', 'utf8').split(/\n/).find((line) => line.trim().startsWith(`${name} `))?.trim().split(/\s+/)[1] ?? null; }
            catch { return null; }
          };
          const commandVersion = (command, args, pattern) => {
            const result = spawnSync(command, args, { encoding: 'utf8' });
            if (result.error?.code === 'ENOENT') return { value: null, reason: 'binary_missing' };
            if (result.status !== 0) return { value: null, reason: 'version_command_failed' };
            const line = `${result.stdout ?? ''}\n${result.stderr ?? ''}`.split(/\r?\n/).map((s) => s.trim()).find((s) => pattern.test(s));
            return line ? { value: line, reason: null } : { value: null, reason: 'version_line_unrecognized' };
          };
          const elixirOut = commandVersion('elixir', ['--version'], /^Elixir v?[0-9.]+/);
          const otpOut = commandVersion('elixir', ['--version'], /^Erlang\/OTP [0-9.]+/);
          const cache = (value) => value === 'true' ? 'hit' : value === 'false' ? 'miss' : null;
          const lockVersion = () => {
            try { return JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('test/example/priv/playwright/package-lock.json', 'utf8')).packages['node_modules/@playwright/test'].version ?? null; }
            catch { return null; }
          };
          const metadata = {
            schema_version: 'sigra.ci-measurement-metadata/v1',
            repository: process.env.GITHUB_REPOSITORY ?? null,
            run_id: process.env.GITHUB_RUN_ID ?? null,
            run_attempt: process.env.GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT ?? null,
            source_sha: process.env.GITHUB_SHA ?? null,
            event: process.env.GITHUB_EVENT_NAME ?? null,
            matrix_seam: null,
            job_name: process.env.JOB_NAME,
            timing_artifact_name: `library-test-timing-${process.env.GITHUB_RUN_ID}-${process.env.GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT}`,
            exunit_reports: [
              { invocation: 'main', path: 'ci-exunit-timing-main.json' },
              { invocation: 'threadline_guard', path: 'ci-exunit-timing-threadline-guard.json' },
            ],
            runner_os: process.env.RUNNER_OS ?? null,
            runner_arch: process.env.RUNNER_ARCH ?? null,
            runner_image: { image_os: process.env.ImageOS ?? null, image_version: process.env.ImageVersion ?? null },
            cache_outcome: { library_deps: cache(process.env.DEPS_CACHE_HIT) },
            configured_versions: { erlang: readTool('erlang'), elixir: readTool('elixir'), node: null, playwright: lockVersion() },
            observed_versions: { erlang: otpOut.value, elixir: elixirOut.value, node: null, playwright: null },
            version_unavailable: { erlang: otpOut.reason, elixir: elixirOut.reason, node: 'not_applicable', playwright: 'not_applicable' },
          };
          fs.mkdirSync('test-results', { recursive: true });
          fs.writeFileSync('test-results/ci-measurement-metadata.json', `${JSON.stringify(metadata, null, 2)}\n`);
          NODE
      - name: Upload library measurement metadata
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@043fb46d1a93c77aae656e7c1c64a875d1fc6a0a # v7.0.1
        with:
          name: library-measurement-metadata-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}
          path: test-results/ci-measurement-metadata.json
          retention-days: 7
          if-no-files-found: warn

  # TEST-01 (D-02/D-03): Thin name-preserving aggregator. Reuses job id `library_tests`
  # and name `Library tests` — byte-identical to ruleset 14941512 required check string
  # (confirmed via gh api repos/szTheory/sigra/rulesets/14941512 at execution time).
  # A bare matrix on a named job emits "Library tests (1)"/"(2)" — never a bare
  # "Library tests" — which would orphan the required check (stuck pending → merge outage).
  # The aggregator restores the bare context and the job id ci-gate.needs references.
  # ci-gate is UNCHANGED (D-03): still needs: library_tests and reads needs.library_tests.result.
  # Phase 230 (FAST-05 / D-07): deliberately EXEMPT from docs-only gating --
  # this aggregator only reflects library_tests_shard's own (already exempt)
  # result; carries no `changes` dependency and no docs_only reference itself.
  library_tests:
    name: Library tests          # BYTE-IDENTICAL to ruleset 14941512 — DO NOT EDIT (D-02)
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 5
    needs: [library_tests_shard]
    if: always()                 # must run even if a shard fails (mirrors ci-gate pattern)
    steps:
      - name: Require the library suite owner to pass
        env:
          SHARD: ${{ needs.library_tests_shard.result }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          if [[ "$SHARD" != "success" ]]; then
            echo "library_tests_shard result: $SHARD"
            exit 1
          fi
          echo "all library tests passed"

  library_tests_dep_off:
    name: Library tests (dep-off — Threadline absent)
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 10
    needs: [release_ref_guard, changes]
    # This lane owns the required docs build and full generated-index check,
    # so it must run for docs-only candidates as well as other PRs.
    if: ${{ !cancelled() && needs.release_ref_guard.result == 'success' }}
    services:
      postgres:
        image: postgres:15
        env:
          POSTGRES_PASSWORD: postgres
          # Sigra.Test.PostgresRepo and admin/audit integration tests expect this DB to exist.
          POSTGRES_DB: sigra_test
        ports: ['5432:5432']
        options: >-
          --health-cmd pg_isready --health-interval 10s
          --health-timeout 5s --health-retries 5
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1  # v7.0.1
      - uses: erlef/setup-beam@54075bcc5e249e4758d363f27d099f55d843f124  # v1.24.1
        id: setup
        with:
          version-file: .tool-versions
          version-type: strict
      - name: Cache library deps (dep-off lane)
        id: dep_off_deps_cache
        uses: actions/cache@55cc8345863c7cc4c66a329aec7e433d2d1c52a9  # v6.1.0
        with:
          path: |
            deps
            _build
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-library-dep-off-otp${{ steps.setup.outputs.otp-version }}-elixir${{ steps.setup.outputs.elixir-version }}-test-${{ hashFiles('mix.lock') }}-v1
          restore-keys: ${{ runner.os }}-library-dep-off-otp${{ steps.setup.outputs.otp-version }}-elixir${{ steps.setup.outputs.elixir-version }}-test-
      - name: Install Hex + Rebar
        run: |
          mix local.hex --force
          mix local.rebar --force
      - name: Install phx_new archive
        run: mix archive.install --force hex phx_new 1.8.8
      - name: Fetch library deps
        env:
          MIX_ENV: test
        run: mix deps.get
      # The sole alias owner exercises dep-off. This lane now owns only the one
      # docs build that is intentionally outside the contributor alias.
      - name: Check docs build cleanly
        run: mix docs --warnings-as-errors
      - name: Check generated docs index
        run: bash scripts/ci/check-docs-index.sh
      - name: Cache hit summary
        if: always()
        run: |
          {
            echo "## library_tests_dep_off cache"
            echo "- deps cache (exact hit): ${{ steps.dep_off_deps_cache.outputs.cache-hit }}"
          } >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"

  example_unit_smoke:
    name: Example unit smoke (ExUnit + ConnTest)
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 10
    needs: [changes]
    # Phase 230 (FAST-05 / D-09, D-07): first time this required lane gains
    # a dependency edge -- it had no `needs:` at all before this plan. That
    # is safe specifically because `!cancelled()` is used, never `always()`
    # (T-230-05-07): the two are identical for the failure case this gate
    # exists to handle (a `changes` failure still leaves this job running,
    # preserving fail-open intent), and they diverge only on cancellation --
    # `always()` would keep this job running on a run FAST-04's
    # `cancel-in-progress` just superseded.
    if: ${{ !cancelled() }}
    services:
      postgres:
        image: postgres:15
        env:
          POSTGRES_PASSWORD: postgres
        ports: ['5432:5432']
        options: >-
          --health-cmd pg_isready --health-interval 10s
          --health-timeout 5s --health-retries 5
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1  # v7.0.1
      - uses: erlef/setup-beam@54075bcc5e249e4758d363f27d099f55d843f124  # v1.24.1
        id: setup
        if: ${{ needs.changes.result != 'success' || needs.changes.outputs.docs_only != 'true' }}
        with:
          version-file: .tool-versions
          version-type: strict
      - name: Cache example deps
        id: example_unit_deps_cache
        if: ${{ needs.changes.result != 'success' || needs.changes.outputs.docs_only != 'true' }}
        uses: actions/cache@55cc8345863c7cc4c66a329aec7e433d2d1c52a9  # v6.1.0
        with:
          path: |
            test/example/deps
            test/example/_build
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-example-otp${{ steps.setup.outputs.otp-version }}-elixir${{ steps.setup.outputs.elixir-version }}-test-${{ hashFiles('test/example/mix.lock', 'test/example/config/**', 'test/example/lib/**/*.ex', 'lib/**/*.ex', 'mix.exs') }}-v1
          restore-keys: ${{ runner.os }}-example-otp${{ steps.setup.outputs.otp-version }}-elixir${{ steps.setup.outputs.elixir-version }}-test-
      - name: Fetch example deps
        if: ${{ needs.changes.result != 'success' || needs.changes.outputs.docs_only != 'true' }}
        working-directory: test/example
        run: mix deps.get
      - name: Compile example
        if: ${{ needs.changes.result != 'success' || needs.changes.outputs.docs_only != 'true' }}
        working-directory: test/example
        run: mix compile --warnings-as-errors
      - name: Setup database
        if: ${{ needs.changes.result != 'success' || needs.changes.outputs.docs_only != 'true' }}
        working-directory: test/example
        env:

        run: mix archive.install --force hex phx_new 1.8.8
      - name: Fetch Sigra library deps
        run: mix deps.get
      - name: Scaffold fresh Phoenix app
        # --no-mailer removed: sigra.install generates accounts/mailer.ex
        # which `use Swoosh.Mailer`; skipping the mailer scaffold drops
        # Swoosh from the tmp app's deps and breaks `mix compile` with
        # `module Swoosh.Mailer is not loaded`. scripts/ci/install-smoke.sh

        run: mix phx.new tmp_app --no-assets --no-install

        run: |

          # deps/0 list. Perl -0777 for multiline match on `defp deps do\n    [`.
          perl -i -0777 -pe 's/defp deps do\s*\n\s*\[/defp deps do\n    [\n      {:sigra, path: "..", override: true},/' mix.exs

        # task (including sigra.install) until deps are resolved. Must
        # run before the install step. Mirrors install-smoke.sh:54.
        run: mix deps.get

        working-directory: tmp_app
        env:
          MIX_ENV: test
          PGUSER: postgres
          PGPASSWORD: postgres
          PGHOST: localhost
          # WR-02: pipe matrix.flags through an env var instead of direct
          # ${{ }} expansion into the shell string. Today `matrix.flags`
          # comes from the repo itself (safe), but env-var-indirection is
          # the pattern GitHub recommends because it prevents a future
          # maintainer from unknowingly inheriting command-injection if
          # the matrix value ever gets sourced from `github.event.*`.
          MATRIX_FLAGS: ${{ matrix.flags }}

        working-directory: tmp_app
        env:
          MIX_ENV: test
          PGUSER: postgres
          PGPASSWORD: postgres
          PGHOST: localhost
        run: |
          mix deps.get

          mix ecto.migrate

        working-directory: tmp_app
        env:
          MIX_ENV: test
          PGUSER: postgres
          PGPASSWORD: postgres
          PGHOST: localhost
        run: |
          PHX_SERVER=true mix phx.server > /tmp/install-matrix-server.log 2>&1 &

          for i in $(seq 1 30); do
            if curl -sf http://localhost:4000/ > /dev/null; then
              echo "tmp_app responded after ${i}s"
              exit 0
            fi

            if [[ "${i}" -eq 30 ]]; then
              echo "FAIL: tmp_app did not boot within 30 seconds"
              cat /tmp/install-matrix-server.log
              exit 1
            fi

            sleep 1
          done

  example_playwright_smoke:

    needs: [release_ref_guard, changes, example_playwright_shard]

    steps:

          merge-multiple: false

        env:
          CLASSIFIER_RESULT: ${{ needs.changes.result }}
          DOCS_ONLY: ${{ needs.changes.outputs.docs_only }}
          SHARDS: ${{ needs.example_playwright_shard.result }}
        run: |
          node <<'NODE'
          const fs = require('node:fs');
          const identity = {run_id: process.env.GITHUB_RUN_ID, run_attempt: process.env.GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT,
            source_sha: process.env.GITHUB_SHA, event: process.env.GITHUB_EVENT_NAME,
            workflow_ref: process.env.GITHUB_WORKFLOW_REF, workflow_sha: process.env.GITHUB_WORKFLOW_SHA,

          fs.writeFileSync('/tmp/browser-execution-identity.json', JSON.stringify(identity));
          NODE
          node scripts/ci/ci-browser-records.mjs --verify \
            --directory browser-execution-records \
            --identity /tmp/browser-execution-identity.json --native-result "$SHARDS"
      - name: Aggregate every Playwright shard result
        env:
          RELEASE_GUARD: ${{ needs.release_ref_guard.result }}
          DOCS_ONLY: ${{ needs.changes.outputs.docs_only }}
          CLASSIFIER_RESULT: ${{ needs.changes.result }}
          SHARDS: ${{ needs.example_playwright_shard.result }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          if [ "$RELEASE_GUARD" != "success" ]; then
            echo "::error::release_ref_guard=$RELEASE_GUARD"
            exit 1
          fi
          if [ "$SHARDS" != "success" ]; then
            echo "::error::example_playwright_shard=$SHARDS"
            exit 1
          fi
          if [ "$GITHUB_EVENT_NAME" = "pull_request" ] && [ "$CLASSIFIER_RESULT" = "success" ] && [ "$DOCS_ONLY" = "true" ]; then
