    # Phase 231 GATE-02 / D-06: this job now runs on every event, including
    # pull_request, with no condition at all. The branch-name condition it
    # replaced (`... || github.head_ref == 'ship/v1.42-ci-gate-remediation'`)
    # had evaluated false on every pull request since that branch merged
    # months ago, so generated-host parity reported green while verifying
    # nothing -- ci-gate counts a `skipped` conclusion as a pass. Do not
    # replace this with the house `github.event_name != 'pull_request'`
    # pattern either: that would still leave parity verified on no PR at
    # all, which is the same defect restated rather than fixed. Measured
    # cost: ~4 runner-minutes fully in parallel behind release_ref_guard
    # (~3s), against a PR pole of 989s (example_playwright_smoke) -- FAST-01's
    # p50 wall-clock target is unaffected (D-07).
    needs: release_ref_guard
    services:
      postgres:
        image: postgres:15
        env:
          POSTGRES_PASSWORD: postgres
        ports: ['5432:5432']
        options: >-
          --health-cmd pg_isready --health-interval 10s
          --health-timeout 5s --health-retries 5
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1  # v7.0.1
      - uses: erlef/setup-beam@54075bcc5e249e4758d363f27d099f55d843f124  # v1.24.1
        with:
          version-file: .tool-versions
          version-type: strict
      - uses: actions/setup-node@820762786026740c76f36085b0efc47a31fe5020  # v7.0.0
        with:
          node-version: '20'
          cache: 'npm'
          cache-dependency-path: 'test/example/priv/playwright/package-lock.json'
      - name: Install Hex + Rebar
        run: |
          mix local.hex --force
          mix local.rebar --force
      - name: Install phx_new archive
        run: mix archive.install --force hex phx_new 1.8.8
      - name: Install Playwright deps
        working-directory: test/example/priv/playwright
        run: npm ci
      - name: Install Playwright browsers
        working-directory: test/example/priv/playwright
        run: npx playwright install --with-deps chromium webkit
      - name: Run generated admin acceptance smoke
        env:
          PGUSER: postgres
          PGPASSWORD: postgres
          PGHOST: localhost
          GITHUB_WORKSPACE: ${{ github.workspace }}
        # Phase 31 Plan 4 (D-10, D-11, D-17): the generated-host parity
        # seam runs the full acceptance target (`--test all` — both the
        # desktop/mobile shell and the denial-response assertions) so
        # generated-host admin parity stays explicit and narrow rather
        # than collapsing into a single monolithic verification job.
        run: scripts/ci/admin-acceptance-smoke.sh --test all
      - name: Collect curated generated-host admin screenshots
        if: always()
        working-directory: test/example/priv/playwright
        # D-19, D-20, D-25: curated reviewer PNGs for the generated-host
        # admin checkpoints live alongside the example-app bundle so
        # reviewers can diff generated vs example parity with the same
        # artifact naming convention.
        run: |
          mkdir -p artifacts/admin-checkpoints/
          if compgen -G "test-results/**/admin-*.png" > /dev/null; then
            # WR-03: `cp -n` (no-clobber) surfaces basename collisions as
            # cp warnings instead of silently overwriting an earlier
            # checkpoint. See the matching block in the example_playwright
            # _smoke job for the full rationale. Visible src_count pairs
            # "expected" with ls -la's "collected" under this step's log.
            src_count=$(find test-results -type f -name 'admin-*.png' | wc -l)
            echo "source admin-*.png count under test-results/: ${src_count}"
            find test-results -type f -name 'admin-*.png' -exec cp -n {} artifacts/admin-checkpoints/ \;
          fi
          echo "curated generated-host admin screenshots:"
          ls -la artifacts/admin-checkpoints/ || true
      # D-19, D-22: green-run generated-host reviewer bundle scoped to this
      # dedicated admin parity job. Always uploaded so the Playwright HTML
      # report and curated PNGs are available without needing the richer
      # diagnostic bundle on successful runs.
      #
      # D-23: branch-aware retention expressed as two mutually exclusive
      # upload steps — 14 days for main/release runs, 7 days for PR/push
      # runs. Keeping the retention values literal makes the policy grep-
      # auditable from the workflow file.
      - name: Upload generated admin review bundle (main, 14d retention)
        if: always() && github.ref == 'refs/heads/main'
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@043fb46d1a93c77aae656e7c1c64a875d1fc6a0a  # v7.0.1
        with:
          name: generated-admin-report
          path: |
            test/example/priv/playwright/playwright-report/
            test/example/priv/playwright/artifacts/admin-checkpoints/
          retention-days: 14
      - name: Upload generated admin review bundle (PR/push, 7d retention)
        if: always() && github.ref != 'refs/heads/main'
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@043fb46d1a93c77aae656e7c1c64a875d1fc6a0a  # v7.0.1
        with:
          name: generated-admin-report
          path: |
            test/example/priv/playwright/playwright-report/
            test/example/priv/playwright/artifacts/admin-checkpoints/
          retention-days: 7
      # D-21, D-24: failure bundle publishes test-results/ so retained
      # video (selective `retain-on-failure` on the `admin-generated`
      # project), traces, and failure screenshots are published alongside
      # the HTML report only when this job fails — keeping the seam's
      # successful-run artifact policy lightweight per D-22.
      - name: Upload generated admin failure diagnostics (main, 14d retention)
        if: failure() && github.ref == 'refs/heads/main'
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@043fb46d1a93c77aae656e7c1c64a875d1fc6a0a  # v7.0.1
        with:
          name: generated-admin-failure-diagnostics
          path: test/example/priv/playwright/test-results/
          retention-days: 14
      - name: Upload generated admin failure diagnostics (PR/push, 7d retention)
        if: failure() && github.ref != 'refs/heads/main'
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@043fb46d1a93c77aae656e7c1c64a875d1fc6a0a  # v7.0.1
        with:
          name: generated-admin-failure-diagnostics
          path: test/example/priv/playwright/test-results/
          retention-days: 7

  ci-gate:
    name: ci-gate
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 5
    # GATE-03 (Phase 231 / D-02): `changes` (first in needs: below) is an
    # input provider for the honest-skip verdict step, not a gated lane --
    # `changes` is absent from NEVER_DOCS_GATED
    # (scripts/ci/prohibitions/_lib.mjs), so this edge is permitted.
    # `if: always()` on this job stays unchanged, so a red or skipped
    # `changes` cannot make ci-gate vanish. NOTE: honest-skip-verdict.sh's
    # own needs: extractor requires every line in the needs: list below to
    # be a bare `      - id` entry -- no comments or blanks inside the list
    # itself, or the extraction silently yields zero entries.
    needs:
      - changes
      - install_golden_contract
      - library_tests
      - library_tests_dep_off
      - install_smoke
      - upgrade_smoke
      - example_http_smoke
      - example_unit_smoke
      - example_playwright_smoke
      - generated_admin_playwright_smoke
      - fast_checks
    if: always()
    steps:
      # GATE-03 (Phase 231 / D-02): ci-gate was a pure aggregation job with
      # no working tree until now. This checkout exists solely so the
      # honest-skip verdict step below can read the committed manifest
      # (.github/ci-skip-manifest.tsv) and this workflow file. Default
      # fetch depth is correct: the script reads a committed file, never
      # history.
      - name: Checkout (honest-skip manifest)
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1  # v7.0.1
      # GATE-03 (Phase 231 / D-02, D-05): runs BEFORE the legacy loop below,
      # which retains its verdict policy, so this diff is reviewable and today's
      # behaviour is provably non-regressing. Distinguishes a correctly
      # event-/diff-gated skip from a rotted one -- ci.yml's own legacy loop
      # treats every skip as a pass with no such distinction. Every GitHub
      # context value below reaches the shell only through this env: map,
      # never inlined into the run: body (ci.yml:132-135, ASVS V5).
      - name: Honest-skip verdict (GATE-03)
        env:
          DOCS_ONLY: ${{ needs.changes.outputs.docs_only }}
          CLASSIFIER_RESULT: ${{ needs.changes.result }}
          EVENT_NAME: ${{ github.event_name }}
          FORCE_ROT_PROBE: ${{ inputs.force_rot_probe }}
          INSTALL_GOLDEN_CONTRACT: ${{ needs.install_golden_contract.result }}
          LIBRARY_TESTS: ${{ needs.library_tests.result }}
          LIBRARY_TESTS_DEP_OFF: ${{ needs.library_tests_dep_off.result }}
          INSTALL_SMOKE: ${{ needs.install_smoke.result }}
          UPGRADE_SMOKE: ${{ needs.upgrade_smoke.result }}
          EXAMPLE_UNIT_SMOKE: ${{ needs.example_unit_smoke.result }}
          EXAMPLE_HTTP_SMOKE: ${{ needs.example_http_smoke.result }}
          EXAMPLE_PLAYWRIGHT_SMOKE: ${{ needs.example_playwright_smoke.result }}
          GENERATED_ADMIN_PLAYWRIGHT_SMOKE: ${{ needs.generated_admin_playwright_smoke.result }}
          FAST_CHECKS: ${{ needs.fast_checks.result }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          bash scripts/ci/honest-skip-verdict.sh --format table --event "${EVENT_NAME}" --docs-only "${DOCS_ONLY}" \
            --classifier-result "${CLASSIFIER_RESULT}" \
            --lane install_golden_contract="${INSTALL_GOLDEN_CONTRACT}" \
            --lane library_tests="${LIBRARY_TESTS}" \
            --lane library_tests_dep_off="${LIBRARY_TESTS_DEP_OFF}" \
            --lane install_smoke="${INSTALL_SMOKE}" \
            --lane upgrade_smoke="${UPGRADE_SMOKE}" \
            --lane example_unit_smoke="${EXAMPLE_UNIT_SMOKE}" \
            --lane example_http_smoke="${EXAMPLE_HTTP_SMOKE}" \
            --lane example_playwright_smoke="${EXAMPLE_PLAYWRIGHT_SMOKE}" \
            --lane generated_admin_playwright_smoke="${GENERATED_ADMIN_PLAYWRIGHT_SMOKE}" \
            --lane fast_checks="${FAST_CHECKS}"
      - name: Verify required release CI lanes
        env:
          INSTALL_GOLDEN_CONTRACT: ${{ needs.install_golden_contract.result }}
          LIBRARY_TESTS: ${{ needs.library_tests.result }}
          LIBRARY_TESTS_DEP_OFF: ${{ needs.library_tests_dep_off.result }}
          INSTALL_SMOKE: ${{ needs.install_smoke.result }}
          UPGRADE_SMOKE: ${{ needs.upgrade_smoke.result }}
          EXAMPLE_UNIT_SMOKE: ${{ needs.example_unit_smoke.result }}
          EXAMPLE_HTTP_SMOKE: ${{ needs.example_http_smoke.result }}
          EXAMPLE_PLAYWRIGHT_SMOKE: ${{ needs.example_playwright_smoke.result }}
          GENERATED_ADMIN_PLAYWRIGHT_SMOKE: ${{ needs.generated_admin_playwright_smoke.result }}
          FAST_CHECKS: ${{ needs.fast_checks.result }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          failed=0
          for lane in \
            INSTALL_GOLDEN_CONTRACT \
            LIBRARY_TESTS \
            LIBRARY_TESTS_DEP_OFF \
            INSTALL_SMOKE \
            UPGRADE_SMOKE \
            EXAMPLE_UNIT_SMOKE \
            EXAMPLE_HTTP_SMOKE \
            EXAMPLE_PLAYWRIGHT_SMOKE \
            GENERATED_ADMIN_PLAYWRIGHT_SMOKE \
            FAST_CHECKS
          do
            result="${!lane}"
            if [[ "$result" != "success" && "$result" != "skipped" ]]; then
              echo "Required release lane $lane: $result"
              failed=1
            fi
          done
          if [[ "$failed" -ne 0 ]]; then
            echo "ci-gate failed: one or more required release lanes did not succeed."
            exit 1
          fi
          echo "ci-gate passed: all required release lanes succeeded."

  # HARD-01 (Phase 222 Plan 02, D-02): loud, discoverable consumer for a red
  # ci-gate on main -- upgrade_smoke (and any other required release lane)
  # failing on push/schedule/dispatch previously had no failure consumer and
  # rotted silently for as long as nobody happened to look. This job opens
  # or updates a single durable tracking Issue via the shared
  # scripts/ci/notify-failure-issue.sh (D-07). It is intentionally NOT added
  # to ci-gate.needs and is NOT a required check -- mirrors nightly_probe's
  # standalone, not-in-ci-gate posture (ci.yml:2180) -- a push-only required
  # context risks stranding PR merges under ruleset 14941512 (Pitfall 2).
  notify_release_lane_rot:
    name: Notify on red ci-gate (release-lane-rot)
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 10
    needs: [ci-gate]
    if: always() && github.event_name != 'pull_request' && needs.ci-gate.result == 'failure'
    permissions:
      issues: write
    env:
      GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1  # v7.0.1
      - name: Open or update release-lane-rot tracking issue
        env:
          LABEL: release-lane-rot
          TITLE: "ci-gate red on main (release-lane-rot)"
          RUN_URL: ${{ github.server_url }}/${{ github.repository }}/actions/runs/${{ github.run_id }}
          COMMIT_SHA: ${{ github.sha }}
          EVENT_NAME: ${{ github.event_name }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          echo "::error::ci-gate failed on main (event: ${EVENT_NAME}) -- opening/updating tracking issue release-lane-rot"
          BODY="ci-gate failed on main (event: ${EVENT_NAME}).

          - Run: ${RUN_URL}
          - Commit: ${COMMIT_SHA}
          - Surface: ci-gate aggregate (covers upgrade_smoke and the other required release lanes -- see MAINTAINING.md)

          This is the HARD-01 loud-red-main signal (Phase 222 Plan 02). Investigate the failing lane(s) on the linked run, then close this issue once the lane is green again."
          export BODY
          bash scripts/ci/notify-failure-issue.sh

  # D-09 (197-04): dedicated non-PR-gated job that recaptures the 84 admin-design
  # baselines (28 boards × chromium/mobile/dark) in-CI so the committed PNGs match
  # what ubuntu CI renders. This job
  # carries job-level `permissions: contents: write` (the workflow default is
  # `contents: read`, ci.yml:26) so it can commit the recaptured PNGs. It is
  # NOT in ci-gate.needs — it is a one-time recapture utility, not a PR gate.
  # The recaptured PNGs land on a ci/recapture-admin-design-<run_id> branch and
  # a PR is opened for human review (OQ2) before anything merges to main.
  admin_design_recapture:
    name: Recapture admin-design baselines (in-CI)
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 40
    if: github.event_name != 'pull_request' && inputs.phase_244_final_main != true
    needs: release_ref_guard
    permissions:
      contents: write   # REQUIRED — workflow default is `contents: read` (ci.yml:26)
      pull-requests: write  # required for gh pr create
    services:
      postgres:
        image: postgres:15
        env:
          POSTGRES_PASSWORD: postgres
        ports: ['5432:5432']
        options: >-
          --health-cmd pg_isready --health-interval 10s
          --health-timeout 5s --health-retries 5
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
      - name: Boot example app through shared action
        id: boot
        uses: ./.github/actions/example-playwright-boot
        with:
          database-name: sigra_admin_design_recapture
          app-port: "4000"
          base-url: http://localhost:4000
          server-log: /tmp/example-admin-design-recapture-server.log
          browsers: chromium webkit
          warmup-paths: /users/register /users/log_in /admin/_design

      - name: Re-establish board-notice canary (OQ1 deliberate re-baseline)
        # OQ1: The global --font-sans override modifies board-notice (the design-lane
        # canary). snapshot-canary-guard.sh forbids a canary *modify* (line 104) but
        # tolerates a canary *added* (line 100). To re-establish the canary with the
        # new font, delete the existing board-notice PNGs BEFORE --update-snapshots
        # so Playwright re-creates them as newly-added files rather than modifications.
        # This is a one-time deliberate re-baseline, NOT allowlisting the canary.
        run: |
          echo "Removing existing board-notice PNGs so recapture creates them as 'added' (not 'modified')"
          find test/example/priv/playwright/tests/admin-design.spec.ts-snapshots \
            -name 'board-notice-admin-design-*.png' -delete || true
          echo "Removed board-notice PNGs:"
          shopt -s nullglob
          board_notice_files=(test/example/priv/playwright/tests/admin-design.spec.ts-snapshots/board-notice-admin-design-*.png)
          if (( ${#board_notice_files[@]} == 0 )); then
            echo "(none — deletion successful)"
          else
            for path in "${board_notice_files[@]}"; do printf '%s\n' "${path##*/}"; done
          fi
      - name: Recapture admin-design baselines
        # D-09: recapture all 84 admin-design PNGs (28 boards × chromium/mobile/dark)
        # in the ubuntu CI environment so the committed baselines match what CI renders.
        # The fonts.check hard guard in waitForLiveViewReady (197-03) ensures the font
        # is loaded before any snapshot is taken.
        working-directory: test/example/priv/playwright
        env:
          CI: "true"
          SIGRA_EXAMPLE_URL: "http://localhost:4000"
        run: |
          npx playwright test \
            tests/admin-design.spec.ts \
            --project=admin-design-chromium \
            --project=admin-design-mobile \
            --project=admin-design-dark \
            --update-snapshots
      - name: Gate recaptured baselines via snapshot-canary-guard and commit to PR branch (OQ1, OQ2)
        # Recapture PRs open on-demand only (workflow_dispatch) — see the checkpoint
        # job for rationale. Prevents scheduled/push runs from opening baseline PRs.
        if: github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch'
        # OQ1 (board-notice canary re-baseline): board-notice PNGs were deleted before
        # recapture so they appear as 'added' to the guard — the guard's legitimate birth
        # path (line 100). NOT allowlisted (canary is never allowlistable); NOT a
        # forbidden 'modify'. The tripwire stays armed for future incremental PRs.
        #
        # OQ2 (reviewable commit): recaptured PNGs land on a ci/recapture-admin-design-<run_id>
        # branch and a PR is opened via gh pr create — baseline changes get human review
        # under branch protection rather than a silent push to main. The commit carries
        # [skip ci] to avoid re-triggering this job. D-04: when dispatched with a
        # non-empty recapture_branch, the PR targets that branch instead of main so
        # recaptured PNGs land green-before-merge on the Phase 219 branch.
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          RECAPTURE_BASE: ${{ github.event.inputs.recapture_branch }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          SNAP_DIR="test/example/priv/playwright/tests/admin-design.spec.ts-snapshots"

          # Compute changed slugs (tracked diff vs HEAD + untracked new files).
          # slug_of: strip -admin-design-{chromium,mobile,dark}.png suffix.
          declare -A seen_slugs=()
          while IFS=$'\t' read -r _status path; do
            [[ -z "${path:-}" ]] && continue
            case "$path" in "${SNAP_DIR}"/*.png) ;; *) continue;; esac
            sl=$(basename "$path" | sed -E 's/-admin-design-(chromium|mobile|dark)\.png$//')
            seen_slugs["$sl"]=1
          done < <(git diff --name-status HEAD -- "$SNAP_DIR" 2>/dev/null || true)
          while IFS= read -r line; do
            [[ "$line" == '??'* ]] || continue
            path="${line:3}"
            case "$path" in "${SNAP_DIR}"/*.png) ;; *) continue;; esac
            sl=$(basename "$path" | sed -E 's/-admin-design-(chromium|mobile|dark)\.png$//')
            seen_slugs["$sl"]=1
          done < <(git status --porcelain -- "$SNAP_DIR" 2>/dev/null || true)

          echo "Changed slugs: ${!seen_slugs[*]}"

          # Build --allow args for all non-canary changed slugs.
          allow_args=()
          for sl in "${!seen_slugs[@]}"; do
            if [[ "$sl" != "board-notice" ]]; then
              allow_args+=(--allow "$sl")
            fi
          done

          # Run canary guard. board-notice should appear as 'added' (deleted before
          # recapture) which the guard tolerates (line 100 of snapshot-canary-guard.sh).
          bash scripts/ci/snapshot-canary-guard.sh \
            --base HEAD \
            --allowlist test/example/priv/playwright/snapshot-allowlist-design \
            --canary board-notice \
            "${allow_args[@]}"

          # OQ2: commit to a reviewable branch, not main.
          BRANCH="ci/recapture-admin-design-${{ github.run_id }}"
          git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config user.email "github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
          git checkout -b "$BRANCH"
          git add "$SNAP_DIR/"
          if git diff --cached --quiet; then
            echo "No snapshot changes to commit -- baselines already match CI render."
          else
            git commit -m "ci(197): recapture admin-design baselines in ubuntu CI [skip ci]"
            git push origin "$BRANCH"
            gh pr create \
              --title "ci: recapture admin-design baselines in ubuntu CI (${{ github.run_id }})" \
              --body "Admin-design baseline recapture (automated). Triggered by the global --font-sans Space Grotesk override (Phase 197-03). OQ1: board-notice canary re-established as added (not modified). OQ2: reviewable PR instead of push to main. Merge after visual review." \
              --base "${RECAPTURE_BASE:-main}" \
              --head "$BRANCH"
          fi
      - name: Check cross-lane baseline drift from global --font-sans (OQ3, COMPARE mode only)
        # OQ3: the :root --font-sans override is global; admin-checkpoints and demo-showcase
        # may also shift under the font change. Run both in COMPARE mode (no --update-snapshots)
        # against the font-loaded app to measure drift without recapturing them.
        #
        # Outcome A: both pass within existing tolerance -> scope stays admin-design only.
        # Outcome B: either fails -> this step records the shift; the job continues but
        #   a tracked todo is written below (see next step). Do NOT recapture sibling lanes
        #   here (wrong-canary risk per OQ3 resolution).
        #
        # continue-on-error: true so a font-driven compare failure does not block the
        # recapture job from committing its PNGs and opening the PR (the PR is the
        # deliverable; OQ3 is a measurement step).
        id: cross_lane_compare
        continue-on-error: true
        working-directory: test/example/priv/playwright
        env:
          CI: "true"
          SIGRA_EXAMPLE_URL: "http://localhost:4000"
        run: |
          echo "=== OQ3: running admin-checkpoints in COMPARE mode (no --update-snapshots) ==="
          npx playwright test \
            tests/admin-checkpoints.spec.ts \
            --project=admin-checkpoints-chromium \
            --project=admin-checkpoints-mobile \
            --project=admin-checkpoints-dark
          CHECKPOINTS_EXIT=$?
          echo "=== OQ3: running demo-showcase in COMPARE mode (no --update-snapshots) ==="
          npx playwright test \
            tests/demo-showcase.spec.ts \
            --project=demo-showcase-chromium
          DEMO_EXIT=$?
          echo "cross_lane_checkpoints_exit=${CHECKPOINTS_EXIT}" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "cross_lane_demo_exit=${DEMO_EXIT}" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          if [[ "$CHECKPOINTS_EXIT" -ne 0 || "$DEMO_EXIT" -ne 0 ]]; then
            echo "OQ3: one or more sibling lanes shifted under the global --font-sans change."
            exit 1
          fi
          echo "OQ3: all sibling lanes pass within existing tolerance -- scope stays admin-design only."
      - name: Record OQ3 cross-lane drift result (tracked todo if shift detected)
        # OQ3: if either sibling lane shifted, write a tracked todo with the concrete
        # per-lane recapture path so the shift is not silently ignored. If both passed,
        # record that the font does not move them (scope stays admin-design only).
        if: always()
        run: |
          if [[ "${{ steps.cross_lane_compare.outcome }}" == "failure" ]]; then
            echo "OQ3: sibling lane(s) shifted -- creating tracked todo."
            mkdir -p .planning/todos/pending
            TODO_DATE=$(date -u +%Y-%m-%d)
            TODO_FILE=".planning/todos/pending/${TODO_DATE}-oq3-cross-lane-font-drift.md"
            {
              echo "# OQ3: Cross-lane font drift - sibling lane recapture needed"
              echo ""
              echo "Created: Auto-generated by admin_design_recapture CI job (OQ3 resolution)"
              echo "Trigger: Global --font-sans Space Grotesk override (Phase 197-03) shifted one or"
              echo "more sibling Playwright lanes when run in COMPARE mode against the font-loaded app."
              echo ""
              echo "## Which lane(s) shifted"
              echo ""
              echo "Check the admin_design_recapture CI job output (Step: Check cross-lane baseline drift)"
              echo "for the specific compare failure. OQ3 runs admin-checkpoints and demo-showcase in"
              echo "COMPARE mode; if either exits non-zero, that lane's baselines shifted."
              echo ""
              echo "## Per-lane recapture commands"
              echo ""
              echo "### admin-checkpoints lane"
              echo "Boot example app on :4011 (avoid Rulestead Docker on :4000), then:"
              echo "  cd test/example/priv/playwright"
              echo "  SIGRA_EXAMPLE_URL=http://localhost:4011 npx playwright test tests/admin-checkpoints.spec.ts \\"
              echo "    --project=admin-checkpoints-chromium --project=admin-checkpoints-mobile --project=admin-checkpoints-dark \\"
              echo "    --update-snapshots"
              echo "  # Then gate through snapshot-recapture-gate.sh (NOT snapshot-canary-guard.sh)"
              echo "  # The admin-checkpoints canary is: impersonation-banner"
              echo "  # The admin-checkpoints allowlist is: test/example/priv/playwright/snapshot-allowlist"
              echo "  bash scripts/ci/snapshot-recapture-gate.sh --canary impersonation-banner --allow <each changed non-canary slug>"
              echo ""
              echo "### demo-showcase lane"
              echo "Boot example app, then:"
              echo "  cd test/example/priv/playwright"
              echo "  SIGRA_EXAMPLE_URL=http://localhost:4011 npx playwright test tests/demo-showcase.spec.ts \\"
              echo "    --project=demo-showcase-chromium --update-snapshots"
              echo "  # demo-showcase baselines live in tests/demo-showcase.spec.ts-snapshots/"
              echo "  # No dedicated canary guard for demo-showcase; review PNGs manually."
              echo ""
              echo "## Notes"
              echo "- Do NOT recapture these lanes in the admin_design_recapture job."
              echo "  Per-lane allowlist/canary names differ; wrong-canary recapture would arm/disarm the wrong tripwire."
              echo "- Plan 05 re-gate touches only the design lane's continue-on-error."
              echo "  A deferred sibling recapture does NOT block the re-gate."
              echo "- These lanes were green-gating pre-font; font-shifted lanes surface as a normal red."
            } > "$TODO_FILE"
            echo "Tracked todo written: $TODO_FILE"
            echo "OQ3 DEFERRED: one or more sibling lanes shifted. See tracked todo for per-lane recapture path."
          else
            echo "OQ3 CLOSED: admin-checkpoints and demo-showcase pass within existing tolerance."
            echo "The global --font-sans change does not move sibling lanes -- scope stays admin-design only."
          fi
      - name: Dump example app log (on failure)
        if: failure()
        # WR-04: surface the backgrounded server log directly in the failure step.
        run: |
          echo "--- /tmp/example-recapture-server.log ---"
          cat /tmp/example-recapture-server.log || echo "(no log file)"

  admin_checkpoint_recapture:
    name: Recapture admin-checkpoint baselines (in-CI)
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 20
    if: github.event_name != 'pull_request' && inputs.phase_244_final_main != true
    needs: release_ref_guard
    permissions:
      contents: write   # REQUIRED — workflow default is `contents: read` (ci.yml:26)
      pull-requests: write  # required for gh pr create
    services:
      postgres:
        image: postgres:15
        env:
          POSTGRES_PASSWORD: postgres
        ports: ['5432:5432']
        options: >-
          --health-cmd pg_isready --health-interval 10s
          --health-timeout 5s --health-retries 5
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
      - name: Boot example app through shared action
        id: boot
        uses: ./.github/actions/example-playwright-boot
        with:
          database-name: sigra_admin_checkpoint_recapture
          app-port: "4000"
          base-url: http://localhost:4000
          server-log: /tmp/example-checkpoint-recapture-server.log
          browsers: chromium webkit

      - name: Re-establish impersonation-banner canary (D-03.2 delete-rebirth)
        # snapshot-canary-guard.sh forbids a canary *modify* but tolerates a canary
        # *added*. A working-tree-only delete + recreate still reads as `modified`
        # vs HEAD (HEAD retains the old bytes), so the deletion must be COMMITTED
        # first: then the reborn PNG is a brand-new untracked file (pure `added`)
        # relative to the delete commit, which the guard tolerates. (219 fix — the
        # earlier `find -delete` yielded `modified` for a canary whose bytes actually
        # change, e.g. the first amd64 re-baseline of a previously hand-reconciled
        # baseline. The admin-design board-notice step shares this latent gap but
        # only stays green while board-notice is byte-identical.)
        run: |
          git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config user.email "github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
          echo "Deleting + committing impersonation-banner PNGs so recapture creates them as a pure 'added' (not 'modified')"
          git rm -q --ignore-unmatch \
            test/example/priv/playwright/tests/admin-checkpoints.spec.ts-snapshots/impersonation-banner-admin-checkpoints-*.png
          git commit -q -m "ci(219): delete impersonation-banner canary for amd64 rebirth [skip ci]" \
            || echo "(no impersonation-banner PNGs to delete — nothing committed)"
          echo "Committed canary deletion; recreate follows via --update-snapshots. Remaining files:"
          shopt -s nullglob
          impersonation_banner_files=(test/example/priv/playwright/tests/admin-checkpoints.spec.ts-snapshots/impersonation-banner-admin-checkpoints-*.png)
          if (( ${#impersonation_banner_files[@]} == 0 )); then
            echo "(none — deletion successful)"
          else
            for path in "${impersonation_banner_files[@]}"; do printf '%s\n' "${path##*/}"; done
          fi
      - name: Recapture admin-checkpoint baselines
        # D-09: recapture admin-checkpoint PNGs in the ubuntu CI environment so
        # committed baselines match what CI renders. The checkpoint lane covers
        # 3 projects: chromium / mobile / dark.
        working-directory: test/example/priv/playwright
        env:
          CI: "true"
          SIGRA_EXAMPLE_URL: "http://localhost:4000"
        run: |
          npx playwright test \
            tests/admin-checkpoints.spec.ts \
            --project=admin-checkpoints-chromium \
            --project=admin-checkpoints-mobile \
            --project=admin-checkpoints-dark \
            --update-snapshots
      - name: Recapture demo-showcase baselines (D-03.1)
        # demo-showcase (4 PNGs, chromium-only) has no dedicated recapture job; fold it
        # into this job since it already boots the example on :4000. No canary/allowlist
        # choreography — the lane has neither.
        working-directory: test/example/priv/playwright
        env:
          CI: "true"
          SIGRA_EXAMPLE_URL: "http://localhost:4000"
        run: |
          npx playwright test tests/demo-showcase.spec.ts --project=demo-showcase-chromium --update-snapshots
      - name: Gate recaptured baselines via snapshot-canary-guard and commit to PR branch
        # Recapture PRs open on-demand only (workflow_dispatch). On schedule/push the
        # impersonation-banner canary's delete-rebirth always shows as drift, which
        # previously opened a duplicate recapture PR every single day. The merge-gating
        # snapshot guards live in fast_checks (committed-ledger), not here.
        if: github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch'
        # D-05/D-06: the checkpoint job now self-gates like the design job instead of
        # relying on human visual review — impersonation-banner PNGs were deleted before
        # recapture so they appear as 'added' to the guard (the guard's legitimate birth
        # path), and every other changed slug is passed via --allow so the guard's own
        # never-allowlistable-canary assertion (D-06, snapshot-canary-guard.sh) stays the
        # single source of truth. demo-showcase has no canary/allowlist, so its PNGs are
        # git-added directly without going through the guard.
        # Recaptured PNGs land on a ci/recapture-admin-checkpoints-<run_id> branch;
        # [skip ci] prevents recursive triggering. D-04: the PR targets the dispatched
        # recapture_branch when set, else main.
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          RECAPTURE_BASE: ${{ github.event.inputs.recapture_branch }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          SNAP_DIR="test/example/priv/playwright/tests/admin-checkpoints.spec.ts-snapshots"
          DEMO_SNAP_DIR="test/example/priv/playwright/tests/demo-showcase.spec.ts-snapshots"

          # Compute changed slugs (tracked diff vs HEAD + untracked new files).
          # slug_of: strip -admin-checkpoints-{chromium,mobile,dark}.png suffix.
          declare -A seen_slugs=()
          while IFS=$'\t' read -r _status path; do
            [[ -z "${path:-}" ]] && continue
            case "$path" in "${SNAP_DIR}"/*.png) ;; *) continue;; esac
            sl=$(basename "$path" | sed -E 's/-admin-checkpoints-(chromium|mobile|dark)\.png$//')
            seen_slugs["$sl"]=1
          done < <(git diff --name-status HEAD -- "$SNAP_DIR" 2>/dev/null || true)
          while IFS= read -r line; do
            [[ "$line" == '??'* ]] || continue
            path="${line:3}"
            case "$path" in "${SNAP_DIR}"/*.png) ;; *) continue;; esac
            sl=$(basename "$path" | sed -E 's/-admin-checkpoints-(chromium|mobile|dark)\.png$//')
            seen_slugs["$sl"]=1
          done < <(git status --porcelain -- "$SNAP_DIR" 2>/dev/null || true)

          if [[ ${#seen_slugs[@]} -eq 0 ]]; then CHANGED="(none)"; else CHANGED="${!seen_slugs[*]}"; fi
          echo "Recaptured/changed slugs: ${CHANGED}"

          # Build --allow args for all non-canary changed slugs.
          allow_args=()
          for sl in "${!seen_slugs[@]}"; do
            if [[ "$sl" != "impersonation-banner" ]]; then
              allow_args+=(--allow "$sl")
            fi
          done

          # Run canary guard. impersonation-banner should appear as 'added' (deleted
          # before recapture) which the guard tolerates.
          bash scripts/ci/snapshot-canary-guard.sh \
            --base HEAD \
            --allowlist test/example/priv/playwright/snapshot-allowlist \
            --canary impersonation-banner \
            "${allow_args[@]}"

          # Commit to a reviewable branch, not main.
          BRANCH="ci/recapture-admin-checkpoints-${{ github.run_id }}"
          git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config user.email "github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
          git checkout -b "$BRANCH"
          git add "$SNAP_DIR/" "$DEMO_SNAP_DIR/"
          if git diff --cached --quiet; then
            echo "No snapshot changes to commit -- baselines already match CI render."
          else
            git commit -m "ci(219): recapture admin-checkpoint + demo-showcase baselines in ubuntu CI [skip ci]"
            git push origin "$BRANCH"
            gh pr create \
              --title "ci: recapture admin-checkpoint + demo-showcase baselines in ubuntu CI (${{ github.run_id }})" \
              --body "Admin-checkpoint + demo-showcase baseline recapture (automated, Phase 219 D-03). Changed admin-checkpoint slugs: ${CHANGED}. Includes the impersonation-banner canary re-baseline preserving the Phase 204-03 WCAG contrast fix (vt-status-pill color-mix corrected for WCAG AA), re-established as 'added' via delete-rebirth and guard-verified (not allowlisted). demo-showcase (4 PNGs) has no canary. Merge after reviewing the named slugs above." \
              --base "${RECAPTURE_BASE:-main}" \
              --head "$BRANCH"
          fi
      - name: Dump example app log (on failure)
        if: failure()
        run: |
          echo "--- /tmp/example-checkpoint-recapture-server.log ---"
          cat /tmp/example-checkpoint-recapture-server.log || echo "(no log file)"

  # Phase 216 Plan 07 (JUDGE-CI-01): admin eval render + probe job.
  # Boots the example app, runs the full admin-eval harness (render matrix + derivative guards),
  # and uploads the gitignored eval bundles as CI artifacts.
  #
  # NOT in ci-gate.needs — this is the expensive render evidence job, not the merge gate.
  # The merge-blocking forward-only signals are the committed-ledger guards in fast_checks.
  #
  # Phase 230 (FAST-03 / D-10, D-11): demoted to push, schedule and workflow_dispatch only.
  # This job measured 17m33s and gated nothing, so charging it to every PR was pure waste;
  # it is not in ci-gate.needs and is not a ruleset-required context, so demotion breaks no
  # gate. To get render evidence for a PR branch, dispatch this workflow on that ref
  # (workflow_dispatch).
  #
  # Phase 231 (GATE-04 / D-11 step 4): the job-level continue-on-error that used to mask
  # this lane is REMOVED. Plan 231-05 observed the harness's b1-b6 guards run to completion
  # in CI for the first time (run 30512523387, job 90775422130, `PASS — all phases green`);
  # that observation is what makes removal honest rather than premature. This lane is now a
  # hard signal on push/schedule/workflow_dispatch: a harness failure reddens the run. The
  # step-level `continue-on-error: true` at `id: admin_eval_harness` below is retained
  # DELIBERATELY (D-13) — it lets partial evidence bundles upload as artifacts before the
  # "Fail the job if harness did not PASS" step re-fails the job, so an investigator still
  # has something to download when it dies. p05 (scripts/ci/prohibitions/) mechanically
  # forbids reinstating the job-level mask and requires the step-level flag to stay.
  admin_eval_render:
    name: Admin eval render + probe (hard signal on push/schedule/dispatch; not in ci-gate)
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 40
    needs: [release_ref_guard]
    if: github.event_name != 'pull_request'
    # PORT must agree at COMPILE and RUNTIME: config.exs bakes
    # System.get_env("PORT", "4000") into ExampleWeb.Endpoint at compile time (a
    # compile_env key), so booting on a different PORT trips validate_compile_env
    # and aborts the app (→ ERR_CONNECTION_REFUSED for every eval test). Pin it
    # job-wide so compile, ecto, seeds, and boot all use 4011.
    env:
      PORT: "4011"
    services:
      postgres:
        image: postgres:15
        env:
          POSTGRES_PASSWORD: postgres
        ports: ['5432:5432']
        options: >-
          --health-cmd pg_isready --health-interval 10s
          --health-timeout 5s --health-retries 5
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
      - name: Boot example app through shared action
        id: boot
        uses: ./.github/actions/example-playwright-boot
        with:
          database-name: sigra_admin_eval_render
          app-port: "4011"
          base-url: http://localhost:4011
          server-log: /tmp/example-admin-eval-render-server.log
          browsers: chromium webkit
          warmup-paths: /admin/_design

      - name: Run admin-eval harness (render matrix + derivative guards)
        # JUDGE-CI-01: render+probe is here (off the merge path), never in fast_checks.
        # The harness runs the spec across all 3 projects and chains the 5 derivative guards.
        # continue-on-error: true so we can upload any partial bundles as artifacts even on failure.
        id: admin_eval_harness
        continue-on-error: true
        env:
          SIGRA_EXAMPLE_URL: "http://localhost:4011"
        run: bash scripts/ci/admin-eval-harness.sh
      - name: Upload eval bundles as CI artifacts
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@043fb46d1a93c77aae656e7c1c64a875d1fc6a0a  # v7.0.1
        with:
          name: admin-eval-bundles-${{ github.run_id }}
          path: test/example/priv/playwright/eval/
          retention-days: 7
          if-no-files-found: warn
      - name: Fail the job if harness did not PASS
        # Re-fail after artifact upload so investigators can download partial bundles.
        if: steps.admin_eval_harness.outcome == 'failure'
        run: |
          echo "admin-eval harness reported failure (see Run admin-eval harness step above)"
          exit 1
      - name: Dump example app log (on failure)
        if: failure()
        run: |
          echo "--- /tmp/example-admin-eval-render-server.log ---"
          cat /tmp/example-admin-eval-render-server.log || echo "(no log file)"
      - name: Cache hit summary
        if: always()
        run: |
          {
            echo "## admin_eval_render cache"
            echo "- deps cache (exact hit): ${{ steps.boot.outputs.deps_cache_hit }}"
          } >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"

  # D-14 forced-failure probe: a needs-free, nightly-gated job that proves the
  # nightly trigger path reports red on a real failure. Dispatching with
  # `gh workflow run "CI" -f force_fail_probe=true` reds this job and only
  # this job. Normal nightly/push/dispatch runs (force_fail_probe=false) keep
  # the step skipped and the job green. Never runs on pull_request events.
  # NOT in ci-gate.needs — it is a standalone self-test, not a gate input.
  nightly_probe:
    name: Nightly probe (forced-failure self-test)
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 5
    if: github.event_name != 'pull_request'
    steps:
      - name: Forced-failure probe (nightly self-test)
        if: ${{ inputs.force_fail_probe }}
        run: |
          echo "force_fail_probe=true: intentionally failing to prove the nightly lane reports red"
          exit 1

name: FAST-01 post-remediation evidence

on:
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  capture:
    if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/main'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 20
    permissions:
      contents: read
      actions: read
      id-token: write
      attestations: write
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1
        with:
          # The collector proves ancestry for the remediation cutoff, which is
          # intentionally older than the single-commit checkout default.
          fetch-depth: 0
      - name: Fix protected endpoint at workflow start
        id: endpoint
        shell: bash
        run: echo "value=$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
      - name: Capture post-remediation FAST-01 window
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: bash scripts/ci/capture-fast-01-gap-closure.sh --protected-output fast-01-source-complete-remeasurement.json --endpoint "${{ steps.endpoint.outputs.value }}"
      - name: Require a source-complete measured population
        run: |
          jq -e '
            .schema_version == "sigra.fast-01-source-complete-remeasurement/1" and
            .status == "measured" and .eligible_pr_run_count >= 10 and
            (.verdict == "pass" or .verdict == "miss") and
            (.source_collection.pages | length) > 0 and
            .source_collection.exhausted == true and
            .source_collection.terminal_page == .source_collection.requested_pages[-1] and
            .source_collection.pages[-1].returned_count == 0 and
            (.instrument_receipt.command | contains("scripts/ci/ci-run-metrics.sh")) and
            .instrument_receipt.output.runs == .runs and
            (if .verdict == "miss" then
              .binding_poles.median.run_id == .selected_poles.median_run_id and
              .binding_poles.maximum.run_id == .selected_poles.maximum_run_id and
              .binding_poles.median.exhausted == true and .binding_poles.maximum.exhausted == true and
              .binding_poles.median.pages[-1].returned_count == 0 and
              .binding_poles.maximum.pages[-1].returned_count == 0
            else .binding_poles == null end)
          ' fast-01-source-complete-remeasurement.json
      - name: Attest post-remediation provenance
        uses: actions/attest-build-provenance@0f67c3f4856b2e3261c31976d6725780e5e4c373
        with:
          subject-path: fast-01-source-complete-remeasurement.json
      - name: Upload post-remediation subject
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@043fb46d1a93c77aae656e7c1c64a875d1fc6a0a
        with:
          name: fast-01-source-complete-remeasurement
          path: fast-01-source-complete-remeasurement.json

name: Phase 244 Playwright measurement

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      phase_244_measure:
        description: 'Run the read-only Playwright baseline measurement.'
        required: false
        type: boolean
        default: false

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  phase_244_playwright_measure:
    name: Phase 244 Playwright measurement
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 60
    if: ${{ github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && inputs.phase_244_measure == true && github.ref_type == 'branch' && startsWith(github.ref, 'refs/heads/phase-244/') }}
    services:
      postgres:
        image: postgres:15
        env:
          POSTGRES_PASSWORD: postgres
        ports: ['5432:5432']
        options: >-
          --health-cmd pg_isready --health-interval 10s
          --health-timeout 5s --health-retries 5
    steps:
      - name: Reject unauthorized dispatch routes
        env:
          EVENT_NAME: ${{ github.event_name }}
          MEASURE: ${{ inputs.phase_244_measure }}
          REF_TYPE: ${{ github.ref_type }}
          REF: ${{ github.ref }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          [[ "$EVENT_NAME" == workflow_dispatch ]]
          [[ "$MEASURE" == true ]]
          [[ "$REF_TYPE" == branch ]]
          [[ "$REF" == refs/heads/phase-244/* ]]

      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@820762786026740c76f36085b0efc47a31fe5020 # v7.0.0
        with:
          node-version: '20'

      - name: Install ImageMagick pixel comparator
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install --yes imagemagick
          compare -version

      - name: Set up shared BEAM toolchain
        id: setup_beam
        uses: erlef/setup-beam@54075bcc5e249e4758d363f27d099f55d843f124 # v1.24.1
        with:
          version-file: .tool-versions
          version-type: strict

      - name: Boot example app for render A
        uses: ./.github/actions/example-playwright-boot
        with:
          database-name: sigra_phase_244_measure_a
          app-port: '4001'
          base-url: http://localhost:4001
          server-log: /tmp/phase-244-measure-a-server.log
          browsers: chromium
          warmup-paths: /users/register /users/log_in /admin
          skip-beam-setup: 'true'
          otp-version: ${{ steps.setup_beam.outputs.otp-version }}
          elixir-version: ${{ steps.setup_beam.outputs.elixir-version }}

      - name: Boot example app for render B
        uses: ./.github/actions/example-playwright-boot
        with:
          database-name: sigra_phase_244_measure_b
          app-port: '4002'
          base-url: http://localhost:4002
          server-log: /tmp/phase-244-measure-b-server.log
          browsers: chromium
          warmup-paths: /users/register /users/log_in /admin
          skip-beam-setup: 'true'
          otp-version: ${{ steps.setup_beam.outputs.otp-version }}
          elixir-version: ${{ steps.setup_beam.outputs.elixir-version }}

      - name: Prepare measurement harness
        env:
          GITHUB_SHA: ${{ github.sha }}
          GITHUB_RUN_ID: ${{ github.run_id }}
          GITHUB_REF_NAME: ${{ github.ref_name }}
          PHASE244_CAPTURE_SCOPE: tracer
        run: bash scripts/ci/run-playwright-drift.sh

      - name: Upload measurement artifacts and diagnostics
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02 # v4.6.2
        with:
          name: phase-244-playwright-measurement-${{ github.run_id }}
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/phase-244-playwright-measurement/
          if-no-files-found: warn
          retention-days: 30

name: Phase 247 Hex dry-run evidence

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      candidate_sha:
        description: Fixed PR #224 candidate source SHA
        required: true
        type: string
      evidence_pr_number:
        description: Merged evidence-only PR number
        required: true
        type: string
      evidence_pr_head_sha:
        description: Exact pre-merge evidence PR head SHA
        required: true
        type: string
      manifest_blob_id:
        description: Baseline manifest blob ID at the evidence PR head
        required: true
        type: string

permissions:
  contents: read
  pull-requests: read
  actions: read

concurrency:
  group: phase-247-hex-dry-run-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}
