fi

dispatch_scenario() {
  local case_name="$1" run_list run_id run_json jobs_json artifacts_json artifact_id archive receipt_tmp reserve current_jobs new_jobs
  jq -e --arg name "$case_name" '.scenarios[$name] == null' "$EVIDENCE" >/dev/null || fail "scenario already has a receipt: $case_name"
  current_jobs="$(jq -r '.budget.actual_jobs // 0' "$EVIDENCE")"
  (( current_jobs + 6 <= MAX_JOBS )) || fail "dispatch would exceed the $MAX_JOBS-job ceiling"
  local input_json
  input_json="$(jq -cn --arg scenario "$case_name" --arg candidate "$CANDIDATE_SHA" --arg fixture "$FIXTURE_SHA" --arg blob "$FIXTURE_BLOB" \
    '{scenario:$scenario,candidate_sha:$candidate,fixture_sha:$fixture,fixture_blob:$blob}')"
  validate_dispatch_inputs "$input_json"
  api_post_dispatch "$input_json" || fail "dispatch failed for $case_name"
  record_budget
  run_list="$(mktemp "$WORK_DIR/runs.XXXXXX")"
  api_get "actions/workflows/$WORKFLOW_ID/runs?event=workflow_dispatch&branch=$FIXTURE_BRANCH&per_page=100" "$run_list"
  run_id="$(jq -r --arg branch "$FIXTURE_BRANCH" --arg sha "$FIXTURE_SHA" --arg title "Phase 253 Gate Canary / $case_name /" '[.workflow_runs[] | select(.workflow_id==259268962 and .head_branch==$branch and .head_sha==$sha and .event=="workflow_dispatch" and (.display_title|startswith($title)))] | sort_by(.run_number) | last | .id // empty' "$run_list")"
  [[ -n "$run_id" ]] || fail "dispatch receipt not found for $case_name"
  if [[ "$case_name" == cancelled ]]; then
    jq -e --argjson run_id "$run_id" --arg branch "$FIXTURE_BRANCH" --arg sha "$FIXTURE_SHA" \
      '.workflow_runs[] | select(.id==$run_id and .event=="workflow_dispatch" and .head_branch==$branch and .head_sha==$sha and .workflow_id==259268962)' \
      "$run_list" >/dev/null || fail 'refusing to cancel a run whose fixture identity is not exact'
    require_listed '{"action":"cancel_run","scenario":"cancelled"}'
    # The typed POST route needs a JSON object body; GitHub's cancel takes no parameters, so it is exactly {} (253-101).
    transport_call cancel_run POST /dev/null "$(jq -cn --argjson id "$run_id" '{run_id:$id}')" '{}' '{}' one || fail 'identified canary cancellation failed'
    [[ "$LAST_REQUEST_STATUS" == 202 ]] || fail "identified canary cancellation returned HTTP $LAST_REQUEST_STATUS"
  fi
  run_json="$(mktemp "$WORK_DIR/run.XXXXXX")"
  TERMINAL_RUN_JSON="$run_json"
  local watch_status
  if watch_run "$run_id" "$case_name"; then watch_status=0; else watch_status=$?; fi
  record_budget
  (( watch_status != 124 )) || fail "watch exceeded its reserved four-minute window for $case_name"
  (( watch_status != 77 )) || fail "watch received a GitHub 403/429 rate-limit response; stop until reset"
  jobs_json="$(mktemp "$WORK_DIR/jobs.XXXXXX")"
  artifacts_json="$(mktemp "$WORK_DIR/artifacts.XXXXXX")"
  api_get "actions/runs/$run_id/jobs?per_page=100" "$jobs_json"
  api_get "actions/runs/$run_id/artifacts?per_page=100" "$artifacts_json"
  local run_attempt conclusion
  run_attempt="$(jq -r '.run_attempt' "$run_json")"
  conclusion="$(jq -r '.conclusion // ""' "$run_json")"
  if [[ "$conclusion" == failure ]]; then
    failed_logs="$(mktemp "$WORK_DIR/failed-logs.XXXXXX")"
    download_no_follow "https://api.github.com/repos/$REPO/actions/runs/$run_id/logs" "$failed_logs" 0 || fail "failed-log retrieval failed for run $run_id"
  fi
  current_jobs="$(jq -r '.budget.actual_jobs // 0' "$EVIDENCE")"
  new_jobs="$(jq -r '[.jobs[] | select(.conclusion != "skipped")] | length' "$jobs_json")"
  (( current_jobs + new_jobs <= MAX_JOBS )) || fail "hosted execution count exceeded $MAX_JOBS jobs"
  receipt_tmp="$(mktemp "$WORK_DIR/receipt.XXXXXX")"
  if [[ "$case_name" == cancelled ]]; then
    jq -n --slurpfile run "$run_json" --slurpfile jobs "$jobs_json" --slurpfile artifacts "$artifacts_json" \
      --arg run_id "$run_id" --argjson attempt "$run_attempt" '{run_id:$run_id,run_attempt:$attempt,run:$run[0],jobs:$jobs[0],artifacts:$artifacts[0]}' > "$receipt_tmp"
  else
    artifact_id="$(jq -r --arg name "gate-canary-$case_name-$run_id-$run_attempt" '[.artifacts[] | select(.name==$name and .expired==false and (.size_in_bytes|type)=="number" and .size_in_bytes<=2097152)] | if length==1 then .[0].id else empty end' "$artifacts_json")"
    [[ -n "$artifact_id" ]] || fail "expected same-run retained artifact missing for $case_name"
    archive="$(mktemp "$WORK_DIR/artifact.XXXXXX")"
    download_no_follow "https://api.github.com/repos/$REPO/actions/artifacts/$artifact_id/zip" "$archive" "$MAX_ARTIFACT_COMPRESSED" || fail "artifact download failed for $case_name"
    local artifact_data
    artifact_data="$(python3 "$PUBLISHER" --extract-canary-artifact "$archive")" || fail "retained artifact is malformed for $case_name"
    jq -n --slurpfile run "$run_json" --slurpfile jobs "$jobs_json" --slurpfile artifacts "$artifacts_json" \
      --arg run_id "$run_id" --argjson attempt "$run_attempt" --arg artifact_id "$artifact_id" --argjson retained "$artifact_data" \
      '{run_id:$run_id,run_attempt:$attempt,run:$run[0],jobs:$jobs[0],artifacts:$artifacts[0],retained_artifact:{artifact_id:$artifact_id,archive_sha256:$retained.archive_sha256,archive_base64:$retained.archive_base64,files:{"canary-result.json":$retained.file}}}' > "$receipt_tmp"
  fi
  preserve_evidence
  preserve_evidence
  jq --arg scenario "$case_name" --slurpfile receipt "$receipt_tmp" --argjson count "$REQUEST_COUNT" --argjson jobs "$((current_jobs + new_jobs))" --arg ref "$PRIOR_EVIDENCE_REF" --arg sha "$PRIOR_EVIDENCE_SHA" --arg status "$PRIOR_EVIDENCE_STATUS" --arg path "${EVIDENCE#${ROOT}/}" \
    '.scenarios[$scenario]=$receipt[0] | .budget.request_count=$count | .budget.actual_jobs=$jobs | .run_attempts=((.run_attempts // []) + [{run_id:$receipt[0].run_id,run_attempt:$receipt[0].run_attempt,jobs:[$receipt[0].jobs.jobs[] | {job_id:.id,name:.name,conclusion:.conclusion,executed:(.conclusion != "skipped")}]}]) | .preserved_revisions += [{path:$path,ref:$ref,sha256:$sha,status:$status}]' "$EVIDENCE" > "${EVIDENCE}.tmp"
  mv "${EVIDENCE}.tmp" "$EVIDENCE"
  python3 "$ROOT/scripts/ci/ci-hosted-gate-verify.py" --mode canary --evidence "$EVIDENCE" --scenario "$case_name"
  record_budget
  [[ "$conclusion" == success && "$case_name" == actual-failure || "$conclusion" == success && "$case_name" == missing-seam || "$conclusion" == success && "$case_name" == unexpected-skip ]] && fail "negative source unexpectedly concluded success: $case_name"
  # The guard above is false for every expected outcome; without this the function returned 1 and set -e ended the run.
  return 0
}

for current_scenario in "${SCENARIOS[@]}"; do dispatch_scenario "$current_scenario"; done

if [[ "$ALL_REMAINING" == true ]]; then
  python3 "$ROOT/scripts/ci/ci-hosted-gate-verify.py" --mode canary --evidence "$EVIDENCE" --scenario sources || fail 'source matrix is incomplete before separate verifier dispatch'
  MATRIX_B64="$(python3 "$PUBLISHER" --compact-matrix "$EVIDENCE")" || fail 'compact verifier matrix exceeds its bounded dispatch input'
  current_jobs="$(jq -r '.budget.actual_jobs // 0' "$EVIDENCE")"
  (( current_jobs + 1 <= MAX_JOBS )) || fail "separate verifier would exceed the $MAX_JOBS-job ceiling"
  input_json="$(jq -cn --arg candidate "$CANDIDATE_SHA" --arg fixture "$FIXTURE_SHA" --arg blob "$FIXTURE_BLOB" --arg matrix "$MATRIX_B64" \
    '{scenario:"verifier",candidate_sha:$candidate,fixture_sha:$fixture,fixture_blob:$blob,matrix_evidence:$matrix}')"
  validate_dispatch_inputs "$input_json"
  api_post_dispatch "$input_json" || fail 'separate verifier dispatch failed'
  record_budget
  # The verifier run is found by its distinct workflow display title and exact fixture identity.
  VERIFY_LIST="$(mktemp "$WORK_DIR/verifier-runs.XXXXXX")"
  api_get "actions/workflows/$WORKFLOW_ID/runs?event=workflow_dispatch&branch=$FIXTURE_BRANCH&per_page=100" "$VERIFY_LIST"
  VERIFY_ID="$(jq -r --arg branch "$FIXTURE_BRANCH" --arg sha "$FIXTURE_SHA" '[.workflow_runs[] | select(.head_branch==$branch and .head_sha==$sha and .event=="workflow_dispatch" and (.display_title|startswith("Phase 253 Gate Canary / verifier /")))] | sort_by(.run_number) | last | .id // empty' "$VERIFY_LIST")"
  [[ -n "$VERIFY_ID" ]] || fail 'separate verifier run was not created'
  VERIFY_RUN="$(mktemp "$WORK_DIR/verifier-run.XXXXXX")"
  TERMINAL_RUN_JSON="$VERIFY_RUN"
  if watch_run "$VERIFY_ID" 'separate verifier'; then watch_status=0; else watch_status=$?; fi
  (( watch_status != 124 )) || fail 'separate verifier watch exceeded its reservation'
  (( watch_status != 77 )) || fail 'separate verifier watch received a GitHub 403/429; stop until reset'
  VERIFY_JOBS="$(mktemp "$WORK_DIR/verifier-jobs.XXXXXX")"
  # watch_run already copied the terminal run into $VERIFY_RUN; a second read would be a 19th terminal poll
  # against the frozen 18 (253-101: the offline gate exhausts terminal_polls on it).
  api_get "actions/runs/$VERIFY_ID/jobs?per_page=100" "$VERIFY_JOBS"
  new_jobs="$(jq -r '[.jobs[] | select(.conclusion != "skipped")] | length' "$VERIFY_JOBS")"
  (( current_jobs + new_jobs <= MAX_JOBS )) || fail "separate verifier exceeded the $MAX_JOBS-job ceiling"
  preserve_evidence
  jq --argjson id "$VERIFY_ID" --slurpfile run "$VERIFY_RUN" --slurpfile jobs "$VERIFY_JOBS" --arg ref "$PRIOR_EVIDENCE_REF" --arg sha "$PRIOR_EVIDENCE_SHA" --arg status "$PRIOR_EVIDENCE_STATUS" --arg path "${EVIDENCE#${ROOT}/}" \
    '.separate_verifier={status:"passed",run_id:($id|tostring),job_conclusion:$run[0].conclusion,run:$run[0],jobs:$jobs[0]} | .budget.actual_jobs+=([$jobs[0].jobs[] | select(.conclusion != "skipped")] | length) | .budget.request_count+=(0) | .run_attempts=((.run_attempts // []) + [{run_id:($id|tostring),run_attempt:$run[0].run_attempt,jobs:[$jobs[0].jobs[] | {job_id:.id,name:.name,conclusion:.conclusion,executed:(.conclusion != "skipped")}]}]) | .preserved_revisions += [{path:$path,ref:$ref,sha256:$sha,status:$status}]' "$EVIDENCE" > "${EVIDENCE}.tmp"
  mv "${EVIDENCE}.tmp" "$EVIDENCE"
  python3 "$ROOT/scripts/ci/ci-hosted-gate-verify.py" --mode canary --evidence "$EVIDENCE" --scenario matrix
fi

record_budget
[[ "$REQUEST_COUNT" -le "$MAX_REQUESTS" ]] || fail 'request budget exceeded'
echo "ci-gate-canary: retained evidence at $EVIDENCE (requests=$REQUEST_COUNT/$MAX_REQUESTS; job ceiling=$MAX_JOBS; time ceiling=${MAX_MINUTES}m)"

def seed_server(server, repo, parent):
    server.git_dir = str(repo.parent / "server.git")
    subprocess.run(["git", "init", "--bare", "-q", server.git_dir], check=True)
    object_rows = subprocess.check_output(["git", "-C", str(repo), "rev-list", "--objects", parent], text=True).splitlines()
    object_kinds = {}
    for row in object_rows:
        sha = row.split(" ", 1)[0]
        kind = subprocess.check_output(["git", "-C", str(repo), "cat-file", "-t", sha], text=True).strip()
        data = subprocess.check_output(["git", "-C", str(repo), "cat-file", kind, sha])
        stored = server.git("hash-object", "-w", "-t", kind, "--stdin", data=data).decode().strip()
        if stored != sha:
            raise AssertionError("server seed object identity differs")
        object_kinds[sha] = kind
        if kind == "blob":
            server.blobs[sha] = {"sha": sha, "content": base64.b64encode(data).decode(), "size": len(data)}
    for sha, kind in object_kinds.items():
        if kind == "tree":
            flattened = subprocess.check_output(["git", f"--git-dir={server.git_dir}", "ls-tree", "-rz", "-r", sha])
            values = {}
            for entry in flattened.split(b"\0"):
                if entry:
                    meta, name = entry.split(b"\t", 1)
                    mode, typ, blob = meta.decode().split()
                    values[name.decode()] = {"path": name.decode(), "mode": mode, "type": typ, "sha": blob}
            server.tree_entries[sha] = values
            server.trees[sha] = {"sha": sha, "tree": list(values.values()), "truncated": False}
    for sha in subprocess.check_output(["git", "-C", str(repo), "rev-list", parent], text=True).splitlines():
        raw = subprocess.check_output(["git", "-C", str(repo), "cat-file", "commit", sha])
        head, message = raw.split(b"\n\n", 1)
        lines = head.decode().splitlines()
        tree = next(line.split()[1] for line in lines if line.startswith("tree "))
        parents = [line.split()[1] for line in lines if line.startswith("parent ")]
        server.commits[sha] = {"sha": sha, "tree": {"sha": tree}, "parents": [{"sha": p} for p in parents],
                               "message": message.decode(), "author": {}, "committer": {}}


def parse_local_tree(repo, commit):
    result = {}
    raw = subprocess.check_output(["git", "-C", str(repo), "ls-tree", "-rz", "-r", commit])
    for row in raw.split(b"\0"):
        if row:
            meta, path = row.split(b"\t", 1)
            mode, kind, sha = meta.decode().split()
            result[path.decode()] = {"path": path.decode(), "mode": mode, "type": kind, "sha": sha}
    return result


MISSING = object()


class ObjectServer(http.server.BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
    protocol_version = "HTTP/1.1"

    def _reply(self, status, value):
        body = json.dumps(value, ensure_ascii=False, separators=(",", ":")).encode()
        self.send_response(status)
        self.send_header("Content-Type", "application/json")
        self.send_header("Content-Length", str(len(body)))
        self.send_header("X-GitHub-Request-Id", "local-object-fixture")
        self.end_headers()
        self.wfile.write(body)
        self.server.journal.append({"method": self.command, "path": self.path, "status": status,
                                    "charged": self.server.ledger_pending(),
                                    "request_body_sha256": hashlib.sha256(self.server.last_body).hexdigest() if self.server.last_body else None,
                                    "request_body_bytes": len(self.server.last_body)})

    def _read(self):
        self.server.last_body = self.rfile.read(int(self.headers.get("Content-Length", "0")))
        return json.loads(self.server.last_body or b"{}")

    def _wire_commit(self, value):
        """GitHub's commit JSON drops exactly one trailing newline from the stored message.

        The stored object (and so its sha) keeps the newline-terminated bytes. The
        echo_message_verbatim flag restores the older fixture behaviour.
        """
        message = value.get("message")
        if (not self.server.flags.get("echo_message_verbatim") and isinstance(message, str)
                and message.endswith("\n")):
            return dict(value, message=message[:-1])
        return value

    def _first(self):
        hook = getattr(self.server, "first_hook", None)
        if hook:
            self.server.first_hook = None
            hook()

    def do_GET(self):  # noqa: N802
        self._first()
        self.server.last_body = b""
        prefix = "/repos/szTheory/sigra/git/"
        if self.path.startswith(prefix + "commits/"):
            sha = self.path.removeprefix(prefix + "commits/")
            value = self.server.commits.get(sha)
            if value and self.server.flags.get("alter_commit_readback") and sha != self.server.parent_sha:
                value = dict(value, message="tampered message\n")
                self.server.flags["alter_commit_readback"] = False
            value = self._wire_commit(value) if value else value
            override = self.server.flags.get("readback_message")
            if value and override is not None and sha != self.server.parent_sha:
                value = {k: v for k, v in value.items() if k != "message"}
                sent = self.server.commits[sha]["message"]
                replaced = override(sent)
                if replaced is not MISSING:
                    value["message"] = replaced
            if value and self.server.flags.get("readback_other_sha") and sha != self.server.parent_sha:
                value = dict(value, sha="e" * 40)
            self._reply(200, value) if value else self._reply(404, {"message": "Not Found"})
            return
        if self.path.startswith(prefix + "blobs/"):
            sha = self.path.removeprefix(prefix + "blobs/")
            value = self.server.blobs.get(sha)
            if value:
                raw = base64.b64decode(value["content"])
                if self.server.flags.get("alter_blob_readback") and sha != self.server.parent_sha:
                    raw = bytes([raw[0] ^ 1]) + raw[1:]
                    self.server.flags["alter_blob_readback"] = False
                encoded = base64.b64encode(raw).decode()
                # GitHub wraps blob base64 in 60-character lines, each ending with a newline.
                wrapped = "".join(encoded[i:i + 60] + "\n" for i in range(0, len(encoded), 60))
                if len(encoded) > 60:
                    self.server.flags["multiline_blob_reads"] = self.server.flags.get("multiline_blob_reads", 0) + 1
                value = dict(value, content=wrapped)
            self._reply(200, value) if value else self._reply(404, {"message": "Not Found"})
            return
        if self.path.startswith(prefix + "trees/"):
            sha = self.path.removeprefix(prefix + "trees/")
            value = self.server.trees.get(sha)
            self._reply(200, value) if value else self._reply(404, {"message": "Not Found"})
            return
        if self.path.startswith("/repos/szTheory/sigra/git/ref/heads/"):
            name = self.path.removeprefix("/repos/szTheory/sigra/git/ref/heads/")
            sha = self.server.refs.get(name)
            if sha and self.server.flags.get("lose_ref_readback"):
                self.server.flags["lose_ref_readback"] = False
                self._reply(404, {"message": "Not Found"})
                return
            self._reply(200, {"ref": "refs/heads/" + name, "object": {"sha": sha}}) if sha else self._reply(404, {"message": "Not Found"})
            return
        self._reply(404, {"message": "Not Found"})

    def do_POST(self):  # noqa: N802
        self._first()
        value = self._read()
        prefix = "/repos/szTheory/sigra/git/"
        if self.path == prefix + "blobs":
            data = value.get("content", "").encode("utf-8") if value.get("encoding") == "utf-8" else base64.b64decode(value.get("content", ""), validate=True)
            sha = object_sha("blob", data)
            stored = self.server.git("hash-object", "-w", "--stdin", data=data).decode().strip()
            if stored != sha:
                self._reply(422, {"message": "blob SHA mismatch"})
                return
            self.server.blobs[sha] = {"sha": sha, "content": base64.b64encode(data).decode(), "size": len(data)}
            self._reply(201, self.server.blobs[sha])
            return
        if self.path == prefix + "trees":
            base = value.get("base_tree")
            entries = dict(self.server.tree_entries.get(base, {}))
            for item in value.get("tree", []):
                path = item["path"]
                if item.get("sha") is None and "content" not in item:
                    entries.pop(path, None)
                    continue
                data = item["content"].encode("utf-8") if "content" in item else None
                sha = object_sha("blob", data) if data is not None else item.get("sha")
                if data is not None:
                    stored = self.server.git("hash-object", "-w", "--stdin", data=data).decode().strip()
                    if stored != sha:
                        self._reply(422, {"message": "inline blob SHA mismatch"})
                        return
                    self.server.blobs[sha] = {"sha": sha, "content": base64.b64encode(data).decode(), "size": len(data)}
                if sha not in self.server.blobs:
                    self._reply(422, {"message": "tree references unknown blob"})
                    return
                entries[path] = {"path": path, "mode": item["mode"], "type": "blob", "sha": sha}
            sha = self.server.write_tree(entries)
            self.server.tree_entries[sha] = entries
            self.server.trees[sha] = {"sha": sha, "tree": list(entries.values()), "truncated": False}
            response = dict(self.server.trees[sha])
            if self.server.flags.get("alter_tree_sha"):
                response["sha"] = "f" * 40
                self.server.flags["alter_tree_sha"] = False
            self._reply(201, response)
            return
        if self.path == prefix + "commits":
            tree = value.get("tree")
            parents = list(value.get("parents", []))
            if tree not in self.server.trees or any(parent not in self.server.commits for parent in parents):
                self._reply(422, {"message": "commit references unknown object"})
                return
            author, committer = value["author"], value["committer"]
            def ident(item):
                from datetime import datetime, timezone
                epoch = int(datetime.strptime(item["date"], "%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ").replace(tzinfo=timezone.utc).timestamp())
                return f"{item['name']} <{item['email']}> {epoch} +0000"
            raw = f"tree {tree}\n" + "".join(f"parent {parent}\n" for parent in parents)
            raw += f"author {ident(author)}\ncommitter {ident(committer)}\n\n{value['message']}"
            sha = self.server.git("hash-object", "-w", "-t", "commit", "--stdin", data=raw.encode()).decode().strip()
            result = {"sha": sha, "tree": {"sha": tree}, "parents": [{"sha": p} for p in parents],
                      "message": value["message"], "author": author, "committer": committer}
            self.server.commits[sha] = result
            self._reply(201, self._wire_commit(result))
            return
        if self.path == prefix + "refs":
            ref = value.get("ref", "")
            sha = value.get("sha")
            name = ref.removeprefix("refs/heads/")
            if not ref.startswith("refs/heads/gsd/253-replan-") or sha not in self.server.commits:
                self._reply(422, {"message": "invalid ref or unknown commit"})
                return
            if self.server.flags.get("race_create"):
                self.server.refs[name] = self.server.parent_sha
                self.server.flags["race_create"] = False
                self._reply(422, {"message": "reference already exists"})
                return
            if name in self.server.refs:
                self._reply(422, {"message": "reference already exists"})
                return
            self.server.refs[name] = sha
            self._reply(201, {"ref": ref, "object": {"sha": sha}})
            return
        self._reply(404, {"message": "Not Found"})

    def server_git(self, *args, data=None):
        return self.server.git(*args, data=data)

    def log_message(self, *_args):
        pass


class ObjectHTTPServer(http.server.ThreadingHTTPServer):
    def git(self, *args, data=None):
        return subprocess.check_output(["git", f"--git-dir={self.git_dir}", *args], input=data)

    def ledger_pending(self):
        if not pathlib.Path(self.ledger_path).exists():
            return False
        ledger = json.loads(pathlib.Path(self.ledger_path).read_text())
        return bool(ledger.get("transactions") and ledger["transactions"][-1]["state"] == "pending")

    def write_tree(self, entries):
        def build(prefix):
            direct, directories = {}, set()
            for path, entry in entries.items():
                if path.startswith(prefix):
                    remainder = path[len(prefix):]
                    if "/" in remainder:
                        directories.add(remainder.split("/", 1)[0])
                    else:
                        direct[remainder] = entry
            rows = [f"{e['mode']} blob {e['sha']}\t{name}\0".encode() for name, e in direct.items()]
            for name in directories:
                sha = build(prefix + name + "/")
                rows.append(f"040000 tree {sha}\t{name}\0".encode())
            return self.git("mktree", "-z", data=b"".join(rows)).decode().strip()
        return build("")

    def test_commit_message_matches_accepts_only_equality_or_one_stripped_newline(self):
        import importlib.util
        spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("ci_git_publication_unit", PUBLISHER)
        module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
        spec.loader.exec_module(module)
        sent = "Phase 253 frozen CI candidate\n"
        for label, server_message in {"stripped": sent[:-1], "verbatim": sent}.items():
            with self.subTest(label):
                self.assertTrue(module.commit_message_matches(server_message, sent))
        for label, server_message in {
            "one extra newline": sent + "\n", "two characters stripped": sent[:-2], "crlf": sent[:-1] + "\r\n",
            "trailing space": sent[:-1] + " ", "stripped plus space newline": sent[:-1] + " \n", "empty": "",
            "missing": None, "non-string": 5, "list": [sent], "unrelated": "other\n", "case change": sent.lower(),
        }.items():
            with self.subTest(label):
                self.assertFalse(module.commit_message_matches(server_message, sent))
        self.assertFalse(module.commit_message_matches(sent, None))
        self.assertFalse(module.commit_message_matches("a", "ab\n"))

def no_network_env(temp):
    """Environment in which a live transport cannot obtain a token, so it stops before any connection."""
    stub_dir = pathlib.Path(temp) / "stub-bin"
    stub_dir.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    stub = stub_dir / "gh"
    stub.write_text("#!/bin/sh\nexit 1\n")
    stub.chmod(0o755)
    env = {key: value for key, value in os.environ.items() if key not in {"GH_TOKEN", "GITHUB_TOKEN"}}
    env["PATH"] = f"{stub_dir}:{env['PATH']}"
    env["HOME"] = str(temp)
    return env


def git_run(repo, *args):
    return subprocess.run(["git", "-C", str(repo), *args], check=True, text=True, capture_output=True).stdout.strip()


MAIN_RECORD_REL = f"{PHASE_REL}/253-LOAD-RECOVERY-MAIN-FETCH-R12.json"


def write_main_record(repo, fetched, rel=MAIN_RECORD_REL, **overrides):
    """253-138: a sigra.phase253.main-fetch/r12 record (the 253-136 field names) naming `fetched` as the fresh main."""
    record = {"schema_version": "sigra.phase253.main-fetch/r12", "status": "fetched",
              "command": "git fetch --no-tags origin main", "fetched_main_sha": fetched, "fetch_head_sha": fetched,
              "fetched_at_utc": "2026-10-19T03:43:56Z", "anomalies": []}
    record.update(overrides)
    for key in [key for key, value in record.items() if value is MISSING]:
        del record[key]
    path = pathlib.Path(repo) / rel
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    path.write_text(json.dumps(record, indent=2) + "\n")
    return rel

    def test_actual_github_origin_needs_live_allocation_hosts_and_server_derived_identities(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="sigra-origin-actual-") as temp:
            repo, parent, source, manifest_path, manifest, allocation, ledger_path, server, root = self.prepare_registered(temp)

            hermetic_receipt = json.loads(receipt_path.read_text())
            hermetic_ledger = json.loads(ledger_path.read_text())

            def live_shaped(mutate=None):
                """Rewrite the measured hermetic run into the shape a live allocation would have produced."""
                live_allocation = {"schema_version": "sigra.phase253.http-allocation/v1", "window_id": "publication-test-window",
                                   "source_sha256": hashlib.sha256(manifest_path.read_bytes()).hexdigest(), "max_requests": 24,
                                   "max_elapsed_seconds": 60, "max_response_bytes": 2 * 1024 * 1024, "max_pages": 1, "max_hops": 2,
                                   "repository": "szTheory/sigra", "download_hosts": [], "mode": "live"}
                allocation_file = root / "live-allocation.json"
                allocation_file.write_text(json.dumps(live_allocation))
                ledger = json.loads(json.dumps(hermetic_ledger))
                ledger["allocation_sha256"] = hashlib.sha256(allocation_file.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
                for tx in ledger["transactions"]:
                    tx["host"] = "api.github.com"
                receipt = json.loads(json.dumps(hermetic_receipt))
                receipt.update({"status": "published-actual-github", "production_publish_performed": True,
                                "allocation_path": str(allocation_file), "allocation_sha256": ledger["allocation_sha256"],
                                "origin": {"kind": "actual-github", "host": "api.github.com", "allocation_mode": "live",
                                           "transactions": len(ledger["transactions"]), "identities_from_ledger": True}})
                if mutate:
                    mutate(receipt, ledger, allocation_file)
                receipt["publication_transactions"] = [{"sequence": tx["sequence"], "sha256": canonical_sha(tx)} for tx in ledger["transactions"]]
                ledger_file = root / "live-ledger.json"
                ledger_file.write_text(json.dumps(ledger))
                receipt["ledger_path"] = str(ledger_file)
                receipt["ledger_sha256"] = hashlib.sha256(ledger_file.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
                path = root / "live-receipt.json"
                path.write_text(json.dumps(receipt))
                return path

            def verify(path, *extra):
                return subprocess.run(["python3", str(PUBLISHER), "--verify-publication", str(path), *extra], cwd=ROOT, text=True, capture_output=True)

            accepted = verify(live_shaped(), "--require-live-origin")
            self.assertEqual(accepted.returncode, 0, accepted.stderr)

            def forged_commit(receipt, ledger, allocation_file):
                for row in receipt["server_object_receipts"]:
                    if row["kind"] == "commit" and row["variant"] == "candidate":
                        row["sha"] = "e" * 40
                receipt["candidate_sha"] = "e" * 40

            def local_host(receipt, ledger, allocation_file):
                ledger["transactions"][3]["host"] = "localhost"

            def hermetic_allocation(receipt, ledger, allocation_file):
                value = json.loads(allocation_file.read_text())
                value.update({"mode": "hermetic-test", "test_origin": "https://localhost:1", "test_ca_file": "/dev/null"})
                allocation_file.write_text(json.dumps(value))
                ledger["allocation_sha256"] = hashlib.sha256(allocation_file.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
                receipt["allocation_sha256"] = ledger["allocation_sha256"]

            def stripped_response(receipt, ledger, allocation_file):
                for tx in ledger["transactions"]:
                    if tx["route_id"] in ("git_create_commit", "git_get_commit"):
                        tx["response_body_base64"] = base64.b64encode(b"{}").decode()

            for label, mutate in {"identity absent from every server response": forged_commit, "non-GitHub host in the ledger": local_host,
                                  "hermetic allocation claimed as actual": hermetic_allocation,
                                  "commit response stripped": stripped_response}.items():
                with self.subTest(label=label):
                    self.assertNotEqual(verify(live_shaped(mutate), "--require-live-origin").returncode, 0, label)

    def recording_env(self, temp, evidence):

        marker, snapshot = pathlib.Path(temp) / "calls", pathlib.Path(temp) / "evidence-at-first-call.json"
        for name in ("gh", "curl"):
            stub = stub_dir / name
            stub.write_text(f'#!/bin/sh\nprintf "{name} %s\\n" "$*" >> "{marker}"\n'
                            f'[ -f "{evidence}" ] && cp "{evidence}" "{snapshot}"\nexit 1\n')
            stub.chmod(0o755)
        env = {key: value for key, value in os.environ.items() if key not in {"GH_TOKEN", "GITHUB_TOKEN"}}
        env["PATH"] = f"{stub_dir}:{env['PATH']}"

    def test_canary_artifact_extraction_enforces_the_zip_limits(self):

        def archive(members, compression=zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED):
            buffer = io.BytesIO()

                    bundle.writestr(name, data)
            return buffer.getvalue()
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="sigra-zip-limits-") as temp:
            def extract(data):

            good = extract(archive([("canary-result.json", b'{"scenario":"full-pass"}\n')]))
            self.assertEqual(good.returncode, 0, good.stderr)

def commit_all(repo, message):
    git_run(repo, "add", "-A")
    git_run(repo, "-c", "user.name=Fixture", "-c", "user.email=fixture@example.test", "commit", "-qm", message)
    return git_run(repo, "rev-parse", "HEAD")


def stale_parent_repo(root):
    """253-134 reproduced: the candidate source sits on an old parent P0 while main advanced P0 -> M1 with conflicting edits
    to the same release-managed files; refs/remotes/origin/main and a main-fetch record name M1."""
    root.mkdir()
    subprocess.run(["git", "init", "-q", str(root)], check=True)
    (root / ".github/workflows").mkdir(parents=True)
    (root / ".github/workflows/ci.yml").write_text("name: CI\non:\n  pull_request:\n    branches: [main]\n")
    (root / "mix.exs").write_text('version: "1.4.0"\n')
    (root / "CHANGELOG.md").write_text("# Changelog\n\n## 1.4.0\n")
    (root / ".release-please-manifest.json").write_text('{".": "1.4.0"}\n')
    (root / "app.txt").write_text("base\n")
    p0 = commit_all(root, "P0")
    git_run(root, "checkout", "-q", "-b", "upstream-main")
    (root / "mix.exs").write_text('version: "1.5.0"\n')
    (root / "CHANGELOG.md").write_text("# Changelog\n\n## 1.5.0 (main)\n\n## 1.4.0\n")
    (root / ".release-please-manifest.json").write_text('{".": "1.5.0"}\n')
    m1 = commit_all(root, "M1: main advanced")
    git_run(root, "checkout", "-q", "-b", "candidate-source", p0)
    (root / "mix.exs").write_text('version: "1.4.1-candidate"\n')
    (root / "CHANGELOG.md").write_text("# Changelog\n\n## 1.4.1 (candidate)\n\n## 1.4.0\n")
    (root / ".release-please-manifest.json").write_text('{".": "1.4.1"}\n')
    (root / "app.txt").write_text("candidate\n")
    source = commit_all(root, "S: candidate on the stale parent")
    git_run(root, "update-ref", "refs/remotes/origin/main", m1)
    write_main_record(root, m1)
    return p0, m1, source

def derived_receipt(real, scenario, index):
    """One scenario receipt derived from the real R9 full-pass receipt: its own run, job and artifact ids, run-name,
    shifted timestamps, random node ids and runner ids, and fresh random archive bytes of the real archive's length.
    Every scenario keeps an archive (the real cancelled source has none), so the size is an upper bound."""
    import datetime
    import random
    rng = random.Random(253118 + index)
    run_id = str(real["run_id"])
    new_run = str(int(run_id) + 1000 * index)
    text = json.dumps(real)
    for job in real["jobs"]["jobs"]:
        text = text.replace(str(job["id"]), str(job["id"] + 10_000_000 * index))
    for artifact in real["artifacts"]["artifacts"]:
        text = text.replace(str(artifact["id"]), str(artifact["id"] + index))
    text = text.replace(run_id, new_run).replace("/ full-pass /", f"/ {scenario} /").replace("gate-canary-full-pass-",
                                                                                           f"gate-canary-{scenario}-")
    shift = datetime.timedelta(minutes=7 * index, seconds=index)
    text = ISO_TIME.sub(lambda match: '"' + (datetime.datetime.strptime(match.group(1), "%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ") + shift)
                        .strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ") + '"', text)
    receipt = json.loads(text)
    alphabet = "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789_-"

    def scramble(value):
        if isinstance(value, dict):
            for key, item in value.items():
                if key == "node_id" and isinstance(item, str):
                    value[key] = item[:3] + "".join(rng.choice(alphabet) for _ in item[3:])
                elif key == "runner_id" and type(item) is int and item:
                    value[key] = rng.randrange(1_000_000_000, 1_999_999_999)
                    value["runner_name"] = f"GitHub Actions {value[key]}"
                else:
                    scramble(item)
        elif isinstance(value, list):
            for item in value:
                scramble(item)
    scramble(receipt)
    retained = receipt["retained_artifact"]
    archive = bytes(rng.randrange(256) for _ in range(len(base64.b64decode(real["retained_artifact"]["archive_base64"]))))
    digest = hashlib.sha256(archive).hexdigest()
    retained.update(archive_base64=base64.b64encode(archive).decode("ascii"), archive_sha256=digest)
    for artifact in receipt["artifacts"]["artifacts"]:
        if str(artifact["id"]) == str(retained["artifact_id"]):
            artifact["digest"] = "sha256:" + digest
    return receipt

        real = self.evidence["scenarios"]["full-pass"]

        result = verifier.verify_scenario(alone["scenarios"]["full-pass"], "full-pass", alone)
        self.assertEqual((result["status"], result["run_id"]), ("verified", "38906314106"))
        # Negative control: padding the same six receipts past the cap raises the documented refusal.
        padded = self.six()

"""253-110: the hermetic-vs-live branch audit, kept complete and current automatically. No network.

253-104 halted on a branch whose live side no offline gate had executed: every harness ran hermetic-test allocations,
so request_one's live origin check first ran in a hosted window. This checker re-scans the hosted-proof files (five,
plus the 253-126 shape-probe driver since schema r11) with a stated matcher and fails when

- a matched site has no audit row, or a row no longer names a current site (stale anchor or moved line);
- a coverage ref names a test that does not exist, or an offline-live-test ref names a test with no live marker;
- a live-policy-gate row names no live-policy test, or no summary assertion that proves the branch ran;
- a justified row has no justification or no residual risk;
- (test_no_gap_rows) any row is still a gap.

Its own positive controls prove it can fail: a removed row, an added hermetic branch in a source copy, a missing test
ref, a hermetic-only test cited as live coverage, a moved line and a justified row without residual risk.

253-118 (schema r10) adds the response-shape class. Branch rows could not see a fake whose response differs from what
GitHub sends (253-113 halted on exactly that), so every GitHub route in ci-hosted-transport.py ROUTES (test routes
excluded) and the two workflow sources have one response_shape_rows entry naming the fields local verifiers and drivers
compare, the committed real responses those fields resolve in, and either the tests that compare against those real
bytes or a justification with its residual risk. The checker fails when

- a route has no row, a row names an unknown route, or a route has two rows;
- a real-sample locator does not hash as recorded, names a transaction of another route or status, or a pointer, archive
  member or source file that does not resolve;
- a compared field resolves in no real sample and has no per-field reason;
- a real-shape-test ref names no single existing test, or a test with no visible real-sample read;
- a justified row has no justification or residual risk, or any row is a gap (test_no_gap_rows).

253-129 adds the observed-route rule (test_probe_observed_routes_are_not_justified): for every committed ledger whose name
ends -R11-PROBE.json (the 253-127 read-only probe), every route with a 2xx or 3xx row there must have a response-shape
row that is real-shape-test and cites at least one of that ledger's rows for the route; fields the probe did not observe
may stay in fields_without_real_sample with a reason. Its positive controls revert shape-run_logs to justified, remove
its probe sample, point a probe locator at the wrong sequence, and delete the probe ledgers (a vacuous rule is reported).

253-140 adds three rules (blind spot #4: the R11 audit listed pr_create as justified with no real sample and had no
mergeable field anywhere, while GitHub withheld the PR run because the PR conflicted):

- fields_backed (check_fields_backed): every fields_compared entry of every response-shape row resolves at its dotted path
  (meta: against the ledger transaction, header: against its scrubbed headers) in at least one decoded real sample, or is
  a key of coverage.fields_without_real_sample with a non-empty reason, and then coverage.residual_risk is non-empty. A
  fabricated locator (path, sha256, sequence, route or status not matching a committed transaction) loads nothing, so
  it backs no field and is itself a problem.
- window observed routes (check_window_observed_routes): every route with a 2xx or 3xx transaction in a committed R11
  window ledger (CANARY-HTTP-LEDGER-R11, PR-HTTP-LEDGER-R11) has a real-shape-test row that cites at least one of that
  ledger's 2xx/3xx rows for the route, exactly as 253-129's probe rule does for the -R11-PROBE ledger.
- consumed PR keys (PR_BODY_KEYS): every key ci-pr-proof.sh or ci-hosted-gate-verify.py reads from a pr_create or pr_read
  body is in that route's fields_compared. PRBodyKeysTrackTheCodeTests scans the code's PR-body read sites so the list
  cannot fall behind the code, and greps every listed key in the code so it cannot run ahead of it either.

253-167 adds two pagination rules (blind spot #5: the R12 audit compared header:link on rules_main but not on check_runs,
and its live pagination row was covered only by tests using the /repos/ link form, while GitHub's first real rel=next link,
253-143 sequence 21, used /repositories/<id>/):

- paginated_link_fields (check_paginated_link_fields): every response-shape row whose route is in the transport's
  fetch_pages route set, read from ci-hosted-transport.py at check time (test_page excluded), lists header:link and
  meta:page_ordinal in fields_compared.
- link_forms_modelled: every rel=next/last destination path in every committed window ledger (CANARY-HTTP-LEDGER-R7..R12,
  PR-HTTP-LEDGER-R11, PROBE-HTTP-LEDGER-R11-PROBE) is the repos form (/repos/szTheory/sigra/) or the repositories-id form
  (/repositories/1207487684/), any other form fails, and each observed form is emitted by at least one fake source
  (ci-gate-canary-dryrun.py, ci-hosted-transport.test.py, ci-pr-proof.test.sh), grepped at check time; the
  repositories-id form's fake must carry the id 1207487684.

The observed-route rule's window ledgers include CANARY-HTTP-LEDGER-R12 since 253-167.

Field syntax: a dotted path into the decoded response body ([] steps into each list item, a leading [] for a list root);
meta:FIELD for a ledger transaction field; header:NAME for a scrubbed response header; value:PATH=TEXT for a leaf equal to
TEXT; source:TEXT for text present in a committed source sample (a workflow file).

MATCHER = {
    "files": list(FILES),
    "skip": "blank lines, lines whose first non-space character is #, and text inside triple-quoted strings",
    "literal_strip": "a quoted literal that contains whitespace and neither == nor != (a message, not a compared value) "
                     "is replaced by an empty literal before matching",
    "topic": r"hermetic|HERMETIC|test_origin|test_ca_file|[\"']live[\"']|synthetic|API_HOST|dryrun_window|DRYRUN_WINDOW_PREFIX",
    "condition": r"^\s*(if|elif|while|assert)\b|\bif\b.*\belse\b|==|!=|\[\[|jq -e|\bnot in\b|\band\b|\bor\b|\brequire\(",
    "selector": r"require_live_origin|--require-live-origin",
    "selector_excludes": r"add_argument\(|^\s*def ",
    "rule": "a line is a site when condition and topic both match its stripped code, or when selector matches it and "
            "selector_excludes does not; a site is keyed by file, its exact stripped source line (anchor) and the "
            "1-based occurrence of that exact line in the file",
}
LITERAL = re.compile(r'"(?:[^"\\\n]|\\.)*"|\'(?:[^\'\\\n]|\\.)*\'')
# A test cited as offline live coverage must visibly run the live side: a live mode value, the live-policy shim, the
# live-policy dry-run, a Live* test class, a real (non-dry-run) window constant or a test named for the live side. It is
# a floor, not a proof: each row's live_behavior states what the cited test actually runs.
LIVE_MARKER = re.compile(r"[\"']live[\"']|mode=\"live\"|live_run\(|--live-policy|LiveWorld|LivePolicy|LiveHost|self\.shim\b|"
                         r"live_allocation\(|def test_\w*live|github-api|REAL_CANARY|REAL_PR")


def _strip_literals(code):
    return LITERAL.sub(lambda m: '""' if re.search(r"\s", m.group(0)) and not re.search(r"==|!=", m.group(0)) else m.group(0),
                       code)


def code_lines(text):
    """Yield (line number, raw line, code) for every line outside triple-quoted strings and full-line comments."""
    in_doc = False
    for number, raw in enumerate(text.splitlines(), 1):
        parts = raw.split('"""')
        outside = parts[1::2] if in_doc else parts[0::2]
        if (len(parts) - 1) % 2:
            in_doc = not in_doc
        code = "".join(outside)
        if not code.strip() or code.strip().startswith("#"):
            continue
        yield number, raw, code


def scan_text(text, matcher=MATCHER):
    topic, condition = re.compile(matcher["topic"]), re.compile(matcher["condition"])
    selector, excludes = re.compile(matcher["selector"]), re.compile(matcher["selector_excludes"])
    sites = []
    stripped_lines = [line.strip() for line in text.splitlines()]
    for number, raw, code in code_lines(text):
        code = _strip_literals(code)
        hit = (condition.search(code) and topic.search(code)) or (selector.search(code) and not excludes.search(code))
        if hit:
            anchor = raw.strip()
            occurrence = sum(1 for line in stripped_lines[:number] if line == anchor)
            sites.append({"anchor": anchor, "occurrence": occurrence, "line": number})
    return sites


def scan(root):
    return {rel: scan_text((Path(root) / rel).read_text()) for rel in FILES}


def anchor_line(text, anchor, occurrence):
    seen = 0
    for number, line in enumerate(text.splitlines(), 1):
        if line.strip() == anchor:
            seen += 1
            if seen == occurrence:
                return number
    return None


def _block(lines, start):
    """The indented block that starts at lines[start] (a def or class line)."""
    indent = len(lines[start]) - len(lines[start].lstrip())
    end = start + 1
    while end < len(lines) and (not lines[end].strip() or len(lines[end]) - len(lines[end].lstrip()) > indent):
        end += 1
    return lines[start:end], indent


def test_source(text, name):
    """Return (function body, enclosing class header) for a test ref name ("test_x" or "Class.test_x"), else None.

    A bare name must be defined exactly once in the file; a qualified name is looked up inside its class."""
    lines = text.splitlines()
    wanted_class, _, func = name.rpartition(".")
    found = []
    for index, line in enumerate(lines):
        if re.match(rf"\s*def {re.escape(func)}\(", line):
            body, indent = _block(lines, index)
            owner, header = None, ""
            for back in range(index - 1, -1, -1):
                match = re.match(r"(\s*)class (\w+)", lines[back])
                if match and len(match.group(1)) < indent:
                    owner = match.group(2)
                    class_lines = [lines[back]]
                    for follow in lines[back + 1:index]:
                        if re.match(r"\s*def ", follow):
                            break
                        class_lines.append(follow)
                    header = "\n".join(class_lines)
                    break
            if not wanted_class or owner == wanted_class:
                found.append(("\n".join(body), header))
    return found[0] if len(found) == 1 else None


def check(record, root, matcher=MATCHER):
    """Every problem with the record against the source tree at root; an empty list means complete and current."""
    root = Path(root)
    problems = []
    if record.get("schema") != SCHEMA:
        problems.append(f"schema is not {SCHEMA}")
    if record.get("matcher") != matcher:
        problems.append("the record's matcher is not the checker's matcher")
    if not re.fullmatch(r"[0-9a-f]{40}", str(record.get("audit_head", ""))):
        problems.append("audit_head is not a full commit id")
    rows = record.get("rows")
    if not isinstance(rows, list) or not rows:
        return problems + ["the record has no rows"]
    texts = {rel: (root / rel).read_text() for rel in FILES}
    tests = {rel: (root / rel).read_text() for rel in TEST_FILES if (root / rel).exists()}
    sites = {rel: scan_text(texts[rel], matcher) for rel in FILES}
    keyed = {}
    ids = set()
    for row in rows:
        rid = row.get("id")
        if not rid or rid in ids:
            problems.append(f"row id {rid!r} is missing or repeated")
        ids.add(rid)
        if row.get("file") not in FILES:
            problems.append(f"{rid}: file {row.get('file')!r} is not one of the five audited files")
            continue
        for field in ("anchor", "hermetic_behavior", "live_behavior"):
            if not isinstance(row.get(field), str) or not row[field].strip():
                problems.append(f"{rid}: {field} is missing")
        key = (row["file"], row.get("anchor"), row.get("occurrence", 1))
        if key in keyed:
            problems.append(f"{rid}: duplicates row {keyed[key]['id']} for the same site")
        keyed[key] = row
        line = anchor_line(texts[row["file"]], row.get("anchor"), row.get("occurrence", 1))
        if line is None:
            problems.append(f"{rid}: anchor no longer exists in {row['file']}: {row.get('anchor')!r}")
        elif line != row.get("line"):
            problems.append(f"{rid}: anchor moved from line {row.get('line')} to line {line} in {row['file']}")
        is_site = any((row["file"], site["anchor"], site["occurrence"]) == key for site in sites[row["file"]])
        if not is_site and not (row.get("supplementary") and str(row.get("supplementary_reason", "")).strip()):
            problems.append(f"{rid}: anchor is not a matcher site and the row is not a reasoned supplementary row")
        coverage = row.get("coverage") or {}
        kind = coverage.get("kind")
        if kind not in KINDS:
            problems.append(f"{rid}: coverage kind {kind!r} is not one of {KINDS}")
            continue
        refs = coverage.get("refs") or []
        if kind in ("offline-live-test", "live-policy-gate") and not refs:
            problems.append(f"{rid}: {kind} needs at least one test ref")
        bodies = []
        for ref in refs:
            path, sep, name = str(ref).partition("::")
            if not sep or path not in TEST_FILES:
                problems.append(f"{rid}: ref {ref!r} is not path::test_name in an approved test file")
                continue
            found = test_source(tests.get(path, ""), name)
            if found is None:
                problems.append(f"{rid}: ref {ref!r} names no single existing test function")
                continue
            body, header = found
            bodies.append(body)
            if kind == "offline-live-test" and not LIVE_MARKER.search(body + "\n" + header):
                problems.append(f"{rid}: ref {ref!r} shows no live marker, so it cannot count as live coverage")
            if kind == "live-policy-gate" and path not in LIVE_POLICY_GATE_FILES:
                problems.append(f"{rid}: live-policy-gate ref {ref!r} is not a live-policy gate test")
        if kind == "live-policy-gate":
            assertions = coverage.get("summary_assertions") or []
            if not assertions:
                problems.append(f"{rid}: live-policy-gate needs the summary assertion that proves the branch ran")
            for item in assertions:
                if not any(item in body for body in bodies):
                    problems.append(f"{rid}: summary assertion {item!r} is not asserted by any cited test")
        if kind == "justified":
            for field in ("justification", "residual_risk"):
                if not str(coverage.get(field, "")).strip():
                    problems.append(f"{rid}: a justified row needs a non-empty {field}")
    for rel in FILES:
        for site in sites[rel]:
            if (rel, site["anchor"], site["occurrence"]) not in keyed:
                problems.append(f"unaudited site {rel}:{site['line']}: {site['anchor']}")
    counts = record.get("match_counts")
    actual_counts = {rel: len(sites[rel]) for rel in FILES}
    if counts != actual_counts:
        problems.append(f"match_counts {counts} differ from the scan {actual_counts}")
    return problems + check_response_shapes(record, root)

}
PR_KEY_SOURCES = ("scripts/ci/ci-pr-proof.sh", "scripts/ci/ci-hosted-gate-verify.py")
_NO_BODY = object()
_MEMBER_CACHE = {}


def transport_routes(root):
    """ROUTES as the transport module at root defines it (imported, never parsed by pattern)."""
    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("audit_transport_routes", Path(root) / TRANSPORT_REL)
    module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
    spec.loader.exec_module(module)
    return dict(module.ROUTES)


def _path_tokens(path):
    tokens = []
    for part in path.split("."):
        name, each = part, 0
        while name.endswith("[]"):
            name, each = name[:-2], each + 1
        if name:
            tokens.append(name)
        tokens.extend([None] * each)
    return tokens


def _leaves(value, tokens):
    """Every value at a tokenized path; a key must be present (its value may be null), [] steps into each list item."""
    if not tokens:
        yield value
        return
    head, rest = tokens[0], tokens[1:]
    if head is None:
        if isinstance(value, list):
            for item in value:
                yield from _leaves(item, rest)
    elif isinstance(value, dict) and head in value:
        yield from _leaves(value[head], rest)


def json_pointer(document, pointer):
    if pointer == "":
        return document
    if not pointer.startswith("/"):
        raise KeyError(pointer)
    for raw in pointer[1:].split("/"):
        key = raw.replace("~1", "/").replace("~0", "~")
        document = document[int(key)] if isinstance(document, list) else document[key]
    return document


def field_resolves(field, sample):
    """True when field is present in one loaded real sample ({tx, body} for a response, {text} for a source file)."""
    body, tx, text = sample.get("body", _NO_BODY), sample.get("tx"), sample.get("text")
    if field.startswith("source:"):
        return text is not None and field[len("source:"):] in text
    if field.startswith("meta:"):
        return isinstance(tx, dict) and any(True for _ in _leaves(tx, _path_tokens(field[len("meta:"):])))
    if field.startswith("header:"):
        headers = tx.get("scrubbed_headers") if isinstance(tx, dict) else None
        return isinstance(headers, dict) and any(True for _ in _leaves(headers, _path_tokens(field[len("header:"):])))
    if body is _NO_BODY:
        return False
    if field.startswith("value:"):
        path, sep, wanted = field[len("value:"):].partition("=")
        return bool(sep) and any(leaf == wanted or (not isinstance(leaf, (dict, list)) and leaf is not None and str(leaf) == wanted)
                                 for leaf in _leaves(body, _path_tokens(path)))
    return any(True for _ in _leaves(body, _path_tokens(field)))


def load_sample(root, sample, route, cache):
    """Return (loaded sample, problems) for one locator. A sequence must be a transaction of the row's route (or, for a
    workflow-source row, of the route the locator names) with the recorded status; its body is the decoded response."""
    if not isinstance(sample, dict):
        return None, ["a real sample is not an object"]
    rel = sample.get("path")
    if not isinstance(rel, str) or not rel or Path(rel).is_absolute() or ".." in Path(rel).parts:
        return None, [f"real sample path {rel!r} is not a relative checkout path"]
    path = Path(root) / rel
    if rel not in cache:
        cache[rel] = path.read_bytes() if path.is_file() else None
    raw = cache[rel]
    if raw is None:
        return None, [f"real sample {rel} does not exist"]
    digest = hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()
    if digest != sample.get("sha256"):
        return None, [f"real sample {rel} hashes to {digest}, not the recorded {sample.get('sha256')}"]
    data, where = raw, rel
    if "member" in sample:
        key = (digest, sample["member"])
        if key not in _MEMBER_CACHE:  # keyed by the archive's verified digest, so a changed archive is re-read
            try:
                with tarfile.open(fileobj=io.BytesIO(raw), mode="r:*") as bundle:
                    handle = bundle.extractfile(sample["member"])
                    _MEMBER_CACHE[key] = handle.read() if handle is not None else None
            except (tarfile.TarError, KeyError):
                _MEMBER_CACHE[key] = None
        data = _MEMBER_CACHE[key]
        if data is None:
            return None, [f"real sample {rel} has no archive member {sample['member']!r}"]
        member_digest = hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()
        if member_digest != sample.get("member_sha256"):
            return None, [f"real sample {rel} member {sample['member']} hashes to {member_digest}, not the recorded "
                          f"{sample.get('member_sha256')}"]
        where = f"{rel}!{sample['member']}"
    if sample.get("kind") == "source":
        try:
            return {"text": data.decode("utf-8", "strict")}, []
        except UnicodeError:
            return None, [f"source sample {where} is not UTF-8 text"]
    try:
        document = json.loads(data)
    except (UnicodeError, ValueError):
        return None, [f"real sample {where} is not JSON"]
    if "sequence" in sample:
        wanted_route = sample.get("route", route) if route.startswith("workflow-source:") else route
        if route.startswith("workflow-source:") and "route" not in sample:
            return None, [f"real sample {where} sequence {sample['sequence']} names no route for a workflow-source row"]
        rows = [tx for tx in (document.get("transactions") if isinstance(document, dict) else None) or []
                if isinstance(tx, dict) and tx.get("sequence") == sample["sequence"]]
        if len(rows) != 1:
            return None, [f"real sample {where} has no single transaction with sequence {sample['sequence']}"]
        tx = rows[0]
        if tx.get("route_id") != wanted_route:
            return None, [f"real sample {where} sequence {sample['sequence']} is route {tx.get('route_id')}, not {wanted_route}"]
        if tx.get("actual_status") != sample.get("actual_status"):
            return None, [f"real sample {where} sequence {sample['sequence']} has status {tx.get('actual_status')}, "
                          f"not the recorded {sample.get('actual_status')}"]
        try:
            body = json.loads(base64.b64decode(tx.get("response_body_base64") or "", validate=True))
        except (UnicodeError, ValueError):
            body = _NO_BODY
        return {"tx": tx, "body": body}, []
    if "pointer" in sample:
        if not str(sample.get("route_evidence", "")).strip():
            return None, [f"real sample {where} pointer {sample['pointer']!r} states no route_evidence (a pointer cannot be "
                          "route-checked, so the locator must say why it is this route's response)"]
        try:
            return {"tx": None, "body": json_pointer(document, sample["pointer"])}, []
        except (KeyError, IndexError, ValueError, TypeError):
            return None, [f"real sample {where} pointer {sample['pointer']!r} does not resolve"]
    return None, [f"real sample {where} names no sequence, pointer or source kind"]


def _consumer_problems(rid, consumers, root, texts):
    problems = []
    if not isinstance(consumers, list) or not consumers:
        return [f"{rid}: consumers must name at least one file::symbol that reads this response"]
    for consumer in consumers:
        rel, sep, symbol = str(consumer).partition("::")
        if not sep or rel not in FILES or not symbol:
            problems.append(f"{rid}: consumer {consumer!r} is not file::symbol in one of the five hosted-proof files")
            continue
        if rel not in texts:
            texts[rel] = (Path(root) / rel).read_text()
        if not re.search(rf"(?<![\w]){re.escape(symbol)}(?![\w])", texts[rel]):
            problems.append(f"{rid}: consumer symbol {symbol!r} does not occur in {rel}")
    return problems


def check_response_shapes(record, root):
    """Every problem with the response-shape class; an empty list means route-complete, resolved and current."""
    root = Path(root)
    rows = record.get("response_shape_rows")
    if not isinstance(rows, list) or not rows:
        return ["the record has no response_shape_rows"]
    problems = []
    expected = (set(transport_routes(root)) - TEST_ROUTES) | set(WORKFLOW_SOURCE_IDS)
    tests = {rel: (root / rel).read_text() for rel in SHAPE_TEST_FILES if (root / rel).exists()}
    cache, texts, seen, ids = {}, {}, {}, set()
    for row in rows:
        rid = row.get("id") if isinstance(row, dict) else None
        if not rid or rid in ids:
            problems.append(f"response-shape row id {rid!r} is missing or repeated")
        ids.add(rid)
        if not isinstance(row, dict):
            continue
        route = row.get("route")
        if route not in expected:
            problems.append(f"{rid}: route {route!r} is not a transport route (test routes excluded) or a workflow-source id")
            continue
        if route in seen:
            problems.append(f"{rid}: route {route} already has response-shape row {seen[route]}")
        seen.setdefault(route, rid)
        if row.get("families") not in SHAPE_FAMILIES:
            problems.append(f"{rid}: families {row.get('families')!r} is not one of {SHAPE_FAMILIES}")
        problems += _consumer_problems(rid, row.get("consumers"), root, texts)
        fields = row.get("fields_compared")
        if not isinstance(fields, list) or not fields or not all(isinstance(item, str) and item for item in fields) \
                or len(set(fields)) != len(fields):
            problems.append(f"{rid}: fields_compared must be a non-empty list of unique field strings")
            fields = [item for item in fields or [] if isinstance(item, str)]
        coverage = row.get("coverage") if isinstance(row.get("coverage"), dict) else {}
        kind = coverage.get("kind")
        if kind not in SHAPE_KINDS:
            problems.append(f"{rid}: coverage kind {kind!r} is not one of {SHAPE_KINDS}")
        without = coverage.get("fields_without_real_sample") or {}
        if not isinstance(without, dict):
            problems.append(f"{rid}: fields_without_real_sample must map a field to its reason")
            without = {}
        loaded = []
        samples = row.get("real_samples")
        if not isinstance(samples, list):
            problems.append(f"{rid}: real_samples must be a list")
            samples = []
        for sample in samples:
            value, found = load_sample(root, sample, route, cache)
            problems += [f"{rid}: {item}" for item in found]
            if value is not None:
                loaded.append(value)
        problems += check_fields_backed(rid, fields, coverage, loaded)
        for key in PR_BODY_KEYS.get(route, ()):
            if key not in fields:
                problems.append(f"{rid}: the code reads {key!r} from the {route} body but fields_compared does not list it "
                                "(PR_BODY_KEYS)")
        if not samples and (kind != "justified" or set(without) != set(fields)):
            problems.append(f"{rid}: real_samples may be empty only for a fully justified row")
        for nearest in row.get("nearest_real_samples") or []:
            # A nearest sample is evidence from a neighbouring route, so a sequence locator names its own route.
            near_route = nearest.get("route", route) if isinstance(nearest, dict) else route
            value, found = load_sample(root, nearest, near_route, cache)
            problems += [f"{rid}: nearest {item}" for item in found]
            shows = nearest.get("shows") if isinstance(nearest, dict) else None
            if value is not None and not (isinstance(shows, str) and field_resolves(shows, value)):
                problems.append(f"{rid}: the nearest real sample does not show {shows!r}")
        if kind == "justified" and not str(coverage.get("residual_risk", "")).strip():
            problems.append(f"{rid}: a row with a justified field or a justified row needs a non-empty residual_risk")
        if kind == "justified" and not str(coverage.get("justification", "")).strip():
            problems.append(f"{rid}: a justified row needs a non-empty justification")
        refs = coverage.get("refs") or []
        if kind == "real-shape-test" and not refs:
            problems.append(f"{rid}: real-shape-test needs at least one test ref")
        for ref in refs:
            path, sep, name = str(ref).partition("::")
            if not sep or path not in SHAPE_TEST_FILES:
                problems.append(f"{rid}: ref {ref!r} is not path::test_name in an approved real-shape test file")
                continue
            found = test_source(tests.get(path, ""), name)
            if found is None:
                problems.append(f"{rid}: ref {ref!r} names no single existing test function")
                continue
            body, header = found
            # The real bytes may be loaded by the test's own class fixture (setUp or setUpClass), so those count too.
            owner = name.rpartition(".")[0]
            fixtures = [test_source(tests.get(path, ""), f"{owner}.{hook}") for hook in ("setUp", "setUpClass")] if owner else []
            visible = "\n".join([body, header, *[item[0] for item in fixtures if item is not None]])
            if not REAL_SAMPLE_MARKER.search(visible):
                problems.append(f"{rid}: ref {ref!r} shows no real-sample read, so it cannot count as real-shape coverage")
    for route in sorted(expected - set(seen)):
        problems.append(f"route {route} has no response-shape row")
    return (problems + check_probe_observed_routes(record, root) + check_window_observed_routes(record, root)
            + check_paginated_link_fields(record, root) + link_forms_modelled(root))


def check_fields_backed(rid, fields, coverage, loaded):
    """253-140 fields_backed: each compared field resolves in a loaded (hash-, route-, sequence- and status-checked) real
    sample, or carries a per-field reason, and any reasoned field needs the row's residual_risk."""
    problems = []
    without = coverage.get("fields_without_real_sample") or {}
    if not isinstance(without, dict):
        without = {}
    for field in fields:
        resolved = any(field_resolves(field, sample) for sample in loaded)
        if resolved and field in without:
            problems.append(f"{rid}: field {field!r} resolves in a real sample but is also listed without one")
        if not resolved and not str(without.get(field, "")).strip():
            problems.append(f"{rid}: compared field {field!r} resolves in no real sample and has no reason in "
                            "fields_without_real_sample (fields_backed)")
    for field in without:
        if field not in fields:
            problems.append(f"{rid}: fields_without_real_sample names {field!r}, which is not a compared field")
    if without and not str(coverage.get("residual_risk", "")).strip():
        problems.append(f"{rid}: a row with a justified field or a justified row needs a non-empty residual_risk")
    return problems


# 253-129: a route a committed read-only probe ledger (name ending -R11-PROBE.json) saw answer 2xx or 3xx is observed
# live, so its response-shape row may no longer be justified: it must be real-shape-test and cite at least one of that

PROBE_LEDGER_GLOB = "*-R11-PROBE.json"

def probe_ledger_paths(root):

    return sorted(f"{PHASE_REL}/{path.name}" for path in (Path(root) / PHASE_REL).glob(PROBE_LEDGER_GLOB) if path.is_file())


def observed_probe_routes(root):
    """{ledger rel: {route: {sequence, ...}}} for every 2xx/3xx transaction of every -R11-PROBE ledger at root. A probe
    record without a transactions list (allocation, approval, bodies, evidence, requests) is not a ledger."""
    observed = {}
    for rel in probe_ledger_paths(root):
        try:
            document = json.loads((Path(root) / rel).read_bytes())
        except (UnicodeError, ValueError):

        transactions = document.get("transactions") if isinstance(document, dict) else None
        if not isinstance(transactions, list):

        routes = observed.setdefault(rel, {})
        for tx in transactions:
            status = tx.get("actual_status") if isinstance(tx, dict) else None
            if type(status) is int and 200 <= status < 400 and isinstance(tx.get("route_id"), str):
                routes.setdefault(tx["route_id"], set()).add(tx.get("sequence"))
    return observed


def check_probe_observed_routes(record, root):
    """Every probe-observed route whose row is not real-shape-test on at least one row of that probe ledger."""
    observed = observed_probe_routes(root)
    if not any(observed.values()):
        return [f"no committed {PROBE_LEDGER_GLOB} ledger with a 2xx/3xx row was found, so the observed-route rule "
                "would be vacuous"]
    rows = {row.get("route"): row for row in record.get("response_shape_rows") or [] if isinstance(row, dict)}
    problems = []
    for rel, routes in sorted(observed.items()):
        for route, sequences in sorted(routes.items()):
            row = rows.get(route)
            if row is None:
                problems.append(f"route {route} was observed live in {rel} (sequence {sorted(sequences)}) and has no "
                                "response-shape row")
                continue
            rid = row.get("id")
            kind = (row.get("coverage") or {}).get("kind")
            if kind != "real-shape-test":
                problems.append(f"{rid}: route {route} was observed live in {rel} (sequence {sorted(sequences)}), so its "
                                f"coverage must be real-shape-test, not {kind}")
            cited = [sample for sample in row.get("real_samples") or [] if isinstance(sample, dict) and sample.get("path") == rel]
            for sample in cited:
                if sample.get("sequence") not in sequences:
                    problems.append(f"{rid}: real sample {rel} sequence {sample.get('sequence')!r} is not a 2xx/3xx {route} "
                                    f"row of that probe ledger (its rows are {sorted(sequences)})")
            if not any(sample.get("sequence") in sequences for sample in cited):
                problems.append(f"{rid}: route {route} was observed live in {rel} but the row cites none of its rows "
                                f"{sorted(sequences)}")
    return problems

def window_ledger_tx(rel, sequence, root=ROOT):
    """(transaction, decoded body bytes) for one sequence of a committed window ledger."""

    if len(rows) != 1:
