+function parseArgs(args) {
+  const parsed = {};
+  for (let index = 0; index < args.length; index += 1) {
+    const flag = args[index];
+    if (!['--input', '--seam', '--invocation', '--output'].includes(flag)) {
+      throw new Error(`unknown argument: ${flag}`);
+    }
+    if (parsed[flag] !== undefined || !args[index + 1] || args[index + 1].startsWith('--')) {
+      throw new Error(`missing or duplicate value for ${flag}`);
+    }
+    parsed[flag] = args[index + 1];
+    index += 1;
+  }
+  for (const flag of ['--input', '--seam', '--invocation', '--output']) {
+    if (!nonEmptyString(parsed[flag])) throw new Error(`required argument missing: ${flag}`);
+  }
+  const options = {
+    input: parsed['--input'],
+    seam: parsed['--seam'],
+    invocation: parsed['--invocation'],
+    output: parsed['--output'],
+  };

+defmodule Sigra.Test.CITimingFormatter do
+  @moduledoc false
+
+  use GenServer
+
+  @unit "microsecond"
+  @count_keys [:passed, :failed, :skipped, :excluded]
+
+  @doc false
+  def new_state(path, invocation \\ System.get_env("SIGRA_EXUNIT_TIMING_INVOCATION")) do
+    %{
+      path: path,
+      invocation: invocation,
+      tests: [],
+      counts: Map.new(@count_keys, &{&1, 0}),
+      test_duration_sum_us: 0,
+      diagnostics: [],
+      started_at_us: nil,
+      aborted?: false
+    }
+  end
+
+  @impl true
+  def init(_opts) do
+    path = System.get_env("SIGRA_EXUNIT_TIMING_JSON")
+    state = new_state(path, System.get_env("SIGRA_EXUNIT_TIMING_INVOCATION"))
+
+    case clear_previous_report(path) do
+      :ok ->
+        {:ok, state}
+
+      {:error, reason} ->
+        report_write_error(reason)
+        {:ok, add_diagnostic(state, "previous_output_unavailable")}
+    end
+  end
+
+  @impl true
+  def handle_cast({:suite_started, _opts}, state) do
+    {:noreply, %{state | started_at_us: System.monotonic_time(:microsecond)}}
+  end
+
+  def handle_cast({:test_finished, %ExUnit.Test{} = test}, state) do
+    id = test_id(test)

+#!/usr/bin/env bash
+set -euo pipefail
+
+ROOT="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/../.." && pwd)"
+cd "$ROOT"
+
+OUTPUT_PATH=""
+if [[ "${1:-}" == "--output" && -n "${2:-}" ]]; then
+  OUTPUT_PATH=$2
+  shift 2
+fi
+
+if [[ $# -ne 0 ]]; then
+  echo "usage: bash scripts/ci/ci-exunit-timing.test.sh [--output PATH]" >&2
+  exit 2
+fi
+
+for tool in mix node jq; do
+  if ! command -v "$tool" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
+    echo "ci-exunit-timing.test: required tool is missing: $tool" >&2
+    exit 2
+  fi
+done
+
+TMP_ROOT="$(mktemp -d)"
+cleanup() {
+  rm -rf "$TMP_ROOT"
+}
+trap cleanup EXIT
+
+export MIX_ENV=test
+export PGUSER="${PGUSER:-postgres}"
+export PGPASSWORD="${PGPASSWORD:-postgres}"
+export PGHOST="${PGHOST:-localhost}"
+
+if command -v pg_isready >/dev/null 2>&1 && ! pg_isready -h "$PGHOST" -p "${PGPORT:-5432}" -U "$PGUSER" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
+  echo "ci-exunit-timing.test: PostgreSQL is not accepting connections at $PGHOST:${PGPORT:-5432}" >&2
+  exit 2
+fi
+
+FOCUS_TEST="test/sigra/planning/ci_timing_formatter_test.exs"
+TIMED_MIX_JS='const { spawnSync } = require("node:child_process");
+const started = process.hrtime.bigint();
+const result = spawnSync("mix", ["test", "test/sigra/planning/ci_timing_formatter_test.exs"], { encoding: "utf8" });
+const elapsedUs = Number((process.hrtime.bigint() - started) / 1000n);
+if (result.stdout) process.stdout.write(result.stdout);
+if (result.stderr) process.stderr.write(result.stderr);
+if (result.error) process.stderr.write(`ci-exunit-timing.test: ${result.error.message}\n`);
+process.stderr.write(`SIGRA_TIMING_ELAPSED_US=${elapsedUs}\n`);
+process.exit(result.status === null ? 1 : result.status);'
+
+PROBE_CODE='unless Code.ensure_loaded?(Sigra.Test.CITimingFormatter) do
+  Code.require_file("test/support/ci_timing_formatter.ex")
+end
+
+formatters =
+  if System.get_env("SIGRA_EXUNIT_TIMING_JSON") in [nil, ""] do
+    [ExUnit.CLIFormatter]
+  else
+    [ExUnit.CLIFormatter, Sigra.Test.CITimingFormatter]
+  end
+
+ExUnit.start(formatters: formatters)
+
+defmodule Sigra.CITimingProcessProbe do
+  use ExUnit.Case
+
+  test "probe keeps the original ExUnit result" do
+    if System.get_env("SIGRA_EXUNIT_TIMING_FAIL") == "1" do
+      assert 2 == 1
+    else
+      assert 1 == 1
+    end
+  end
+end'
+
+run_probe() {
+  local log_path=$1
+  shift
+  local status
+
+  if "$@" >"$log_path" 2>&1; then
+    status=0
+  else
+    status=$?
+  fi
+
+  printf '%s\n' "$status"
+}
+
+has_write_diagnostic() {
+  local log_path=$1
+  local diagnostic
+
+  diagnostic="$(sed -n 's/^SIGRA_EXUNIT_TIMING_JSON: //p' "$log_path" | tail -n 1)"
+  [[ -n "$diagnostic" ]] && printf '%s\n' "$diagnostic" | jq -e '.complete == false and .diagnostic == "write_failed" and (.reason | type == "string")' >/dev/null
+}
+
+run_focus_sample() {
+  local mode=$1
+  local sample=$2
+  local log_path=$3
+  local output_path=$4
+  local status elapsed_us
+  local -a command
+
+  if [[ "$mode" == "with" ]]; then
+    command=(env "SIGRA_EXUNIT_TIMING_JSON=$output_path" SIGRA_EXUNIT_TIMING_INVOCATION=instrumentation_test node -e "$TIMED_MIX_JS")
+  else
+    command=(env -u SIGRA_EXUNIT_TIMING_JSON node -e "$TIMED_MIX_JS")
+  fi
+
+  if "${command[@]}" >"$log_path" 2>&1; then
+    status=0
+  else
+    status=$?
+  fi
+
+  if [[ "$status" -ne 0 ]]; then
+    cat "$log_path" >&2
+    echo "ci-exunit-timing.test: focused suite failed in $mode sample $sample (exit $status)" >&2
+    return 1
+  fi
+
+  elapsed_us="$(sed -n 's/^SIGRA_TIMING_ELAPSED_US=//p' "$log_path" | tail -n 1)"
+  if [[ ! "$elapsed_us" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]]; then
+    cat "$log_path" >&2
+    echo "ci-exunit-timing.test: missing elapsed microseconds for $mode sample $sample" >&2
+    return 1
+  fi
+
+  if [[ "$mode" == "with" ]]; then
+    if [[ ! -s "$output_path" ]] || ! jq -e '.complete == true and .unit == "microsecond" and .invocation == "instrumentation_test" and (.tests | length == 3) and all(.tests[]; .invocation == "instrumentation_test")' "$output_path" >/dev/null; then
+      cat "$log_path" >&2
+      echo "ci-exunit-timing.test: instrumented sample $sample did not produce a complete three-test report" >&2
+      return 1
+    fi
+  else
+    if [[ -e "$output_path" ]] || rg -q 'SIGRA_EXUNIT_TIMING_JSON:' "$log_path"; then
+      cat "$log_path" >&2
+      echo "ci-exunit-timing.test: uninstrumented sample $sample produced timing output" >&2
+      return 1
+    fi
+  fi
+
+  if ! rg -q '3 tests, 0 failures' "$log_path"; then
+    cat "$log_path" >&2
+    echo "ci-exunit-timing.test: focused suite $mode sample $sample did not preserve normal ExUnit output" >&2
+    return 1
+  fi
+
+  printf '%s\n' "$elapsed_us"
+}
+
+PASS_PATH="$TMP_ROOT/pass.json"
+PASS_LOG="$TMP_ROOT/pass.log"
+printf '%s\n' '{"complete":true,"unit":"microsecond","tests":[]}' > "$PASS_PATH"
+PASS_STATUS="$(run_probe "$PASS_LOG" env \
+  "SIGRA_EXUNIT_TIMING_JSON=$PASS_PATH" \
+  "MIX_ENV=$MIX_ENV" "PGUSER=$PGUSER" "PGPASSWORD=$PGPASSWORD" "PGHOST=$PGHOST" \
+  mix run --no-start -e "$PROBE_CODE")"
+
+if [[ "$PASS_STATUS" -ne 0 ]] || ! jq -e '.complete == true and .passed_count == 1 and .failed_count == 0 and (.tests | length == 1) and .tests[0].test_id == "Sigra.CITimingProcessProbe.test probe keeps the original ExUnit result" and .tests[0].result == "passed" and (.tests[0].duration_us >= 0)' "$PASS_PATH" >/dev/null; then
+  cat "$PASS_LOG" >&2
+  echo "ci-exunit-timing.test: passing ExUnit process did not produce one complete timing row" >&2
+  exit 1
+fi
+
+rg -q 'Running ExUnit with seed:' "$PASS_LOG"
+rg -q '1 test, 0 failures' "$PASS_LOG"
+
+NO_OPT_IN_PATH="$TMP_ROOT/no-opt-in.json"
+NO_OPT_IN_LOG="$TMP_ROOT/no-opt-in.log"
+NO_OPT_IN_STATUS="$(run_probe "$NO_OPT_IN_LOG" env -u SIGRA_EXUNIT_TIMING_JSON \
+  "MIX_ENV=$MIX_ENV" "PGUSER=$PGUSER" "PGPASSWORD=$PGPASSWORD" "PGHOST=$PGHOST" \
+  mix run --no-start -e "$PROBE_CODE")"
+
+if [[ "$NO_OPT_IN_STATUS" -ne 0 || -e "$NO_OPT_IN_PATH" ]] || rg -q 'SIGRA_EXUNIT_TIMING_JSON:' "$NO_OPT_IN_LOG"; then
+  cat "$NO_OPT_IN_LOG" >&2
+  echo "ci-exunit-timing.test: opt-out ExUnit process changed result or emitted timing output" >&2
+  exit 1
+fi
+
+if ! rg -q 'Running ExUnit with seed:' "$NO_OPT_IN_LOG" || ! rg -q '1 test, 0 failures' "$NO_OPT_IN_LOG"; then
+  cat "$NO_OPT_IN_LOG" >&2
+  echo "ci-exunit-timing.test: opt-out process did not retain normal ExUnit CLI output" >&2
+  exit 1
+fi
+
+NOT_A_DIRECTORY="$TMP_ROOT/not-a-directory"
+: > "$NOT_A_DIRECTORY"
+UNAVAILABLE_PATH="$NOT_A_DIRECTORY/timing.json"
+
+PASS_UNAVAILABLE_LOG="$TMP_ROOT/pass-unavailable.log"
+PASS_UNAVAILABLE_STATUS="$(run_probe "$PASS_UNAVAILABLE_LOG" env \
+  "SIGRA_EXUNIT_TIMING_JSON=$UNAVAILABLE_PATH" \
+  "MIX_ENV=$MIX_ENV" "PGUSER=$PGUSER" "PGPASSWORD=$PGPASSWORD" "PGHOST=$PGHOST" \
+  mix run --no-start -e "$PROBE_CODE")"
+
+if [[ "$PASS_UNAVAILABLE_STATUS" -ne 0 ]] || [[ -e "$UNAVAILABLE_PATH" ]] || ! has_write_diagnostic "$PASS_UNAVAILABLE_LOG"; then
+  cat "$PASS_UNAVAILABLE_LOG" >&2
+  echo "ci-exunit-timing.test: passing tests with unavailable output were not diagnosed" >&2
+  exit 1
+fi
+
+FAILURE_VALID_PATH="$TMP_ROOT/failure.json"
+FAILURE_VALID_LOG="$TMP_ROOT/failure.log"
+FAILURE_VALID_STATUS="$(run_probe "$FAILURE_VALID_LOG" env \
+  "SIGRA_EXUNIT_TIMING_JSON=$FAILURE_VALID_PATH" \
+  SIGRA_EXUNIT_TIMING_FAIL=1 \
+  "MIX_ENV=$MIX_ENV" "PGUSER=$PGUSER" "PGPASSWORD=$PGPASSWORD" "PGHOST=$PGHOST" \
+  mix run --no-start -e "$PROBE_CODE")"
+
+if [[ "$FAILURE_VALID_STATUS" -eq 0 ]] || ! jq -e '.complete == true and .failed_count == 1 and .tests[0].result == "failed"' "$FAILURE_VALID_PATH" >/dev/null; then
+  cat "$FAILURE_VALID_LOG" >&2
+  echo "ci-exunit-timing.test: deliberate failure did not retain its original nonzero result" >&2
+  exit 1
+fi
+
+FAILURE_LOG="$TMP_ROOT/failure-unavailable.log"
+FAILURE_STATUS="$(run_probe "$FAILURE_LOG" env \
+  "SIGRA_EXUNIT_TIMING_JSON=$UNAVAILABLE_PATH" \
+  SIGRA_EXUNIT_TIMING_FAIL=1 \
+  "MIX_ENV=$MIX_ENV" "PGUSER=$PGUSER" "PGPASSWORD=$PGPASSWORD" "PGHOST=$PGHOST" \
+  mix run --no-start -e "$PROBE_CODE")"
+
+if [[ "$FAILURE_STATUS" -eq 0 || "$FAILURE_STATUS" -ne "$FAILURE_VALID_STATUS" ]] || [[ -e "$UNAVAILABLE_PATH" ]] || ! has_write_diagnostic "$FAILURE_LOG"; then
+  cat "$FAILURE_LOG" >&2
+  echo "ci-exunit-timing.test: failing tests with unavailable output lost their failure or diagnostic" >&2
+  exit 1
+fi
+
+if jq -e '(.complete == true) and any(.tests[]?; .duration_us == 0 and .result == "passed")' "$UNAVAILABLE_PATH" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
+  echo "ci-exunit-timing.test: unavailable output created a zero-duration success report" >&2
+  exit 1
+fi
+
+WITHOUT_US=()
+WITH_US=()
+PAIRED_DELTA_US=()
+
+for sample in 1 2 3 4 5; do
+  without_path="$TMP_ROOT/no-timing-$sample.json"
+  without_log="$TMP_ROOT/no-timing-$sample.log"
+  without_value="$(run_focus_sample without "$sample" "$without_log" "$without_path")"
+  WITHOUT_US+=("$without_value")
+
+  with_path="$TMP_ROOT/timing-$sample.json"
+  with_log="$TMP_ROOT/timing-$sample.log"
+  with_value="$(run_focus_sample with "$sample" "$with_log" "$with_path")"
+  WITH_US+=("$with_value")
+
+  PAIRED_DELTA_US+=("$((with_value - without_value))")
+done
+
+median_of_five() {
+  printf '%s\n' "$@" | sort -n | sed -n '3p'
+}
+
+INSTRUMENTATION_OVERHEAD_US="$(median_of_five "${PAIRED_DELTA_US[@]}")"
+WITHOUT_JSON="$(printf '%s\n' "${WITHOUT_US[@]}" | jq -R 'tonumber' | jq -s '.')"
+WITH_JSON="$(printf '%s\n' "${WITH_US[@]}" | jq -R 'tonumber' | jq -s '.')"
+DELTA_JSON="$(printf '%s\n' "${PAIRED_DELTA_US[@]}" | jq -R 'tonumber' | jq -s '.')"
+OBSERVED_AT="$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)"
+ELIXIR_RUNTIME="$(elixir --version | tr '\n' ' ')"
+MIX_RUNTIME="$(mix --version | tail -n 1)"
+
+REPORT="$(jq -n \
+  --arg observed_at "$OBSERVED_AT" \
+  --arg elixir_runtime "$ELIXIR_RUNTIME" \
+  --arg mix_runtime "$MIX_RUNTIME" \
+  --argjson without_us "$WITHOUT_JSON" \
+  --argjson with_us "$WITH_JSON" \
+  --argjson paired_delta_us "$DELTA_JSON" \
+  --argjson instrumentation_overhead_us "$INSTRUMENTATION_OVERHEAD_US" \
+  --argjson pass_process_exit "$PASS_STATUS" \
+  --argjson no_opt_in_process_exit "$NO_OPT_IN_STATUS" \
+  --argjson pass_unavailable_output_exit "$PASS_UNAVAILABLE_STATUS" \
+  --argjson fail_with_output_exit "$FAILURE_VALID_STATUS" \
+  --argjson fail_unavailable_output_exit "$FAILURE_STATUS" \
+  '{
+    contract: "sigra.exunit_timing.v1",
+    observed_at_utc: $observed_at,
+    runtime: {elixir: $elixir_runtime, mix: $mix_runtime},
+    focused_suite: "MIX_ENV=test mix test test/sigra/planning/ci_timing_formatter_test.exs",
+    samples: {without_timing_us: $without_us, with_timing_us: $with_us, paired_delta_us: $paired_delta_us},
+    instrumentation_overhead_us: $instrumentation_overhead_us,
+    overhead_method: "median of five paired whole-mix-process elapsed-time differences (instrumented minus uninstrumented)",
+    process_contract: {
+      passing_process_exit: $pass_process_exit,
+      opt_out_process_exit: $no_opt_in_process_exit,
+      passing_process_with_unavailable_output_exit: $pass_unavailable_output_exit,
+      failing_process_with_output_exit: $fail_with_output_exit,
+      failing_process_with_unavailable_output_exit: $fail_unavailable_output_exit,
+      unavailable_output_diagnostic: "SIGRA_EXUNIT_TIMING_JSON JSON object with complete=false and diagnostic=write_failed",
+      unavailable_output_is_measurement: false
+    },
+    complete: true
+  }')"
+
+if [[ -n "$OUTPUT_PATH" ]]; then
+  OUTPUT_TMP="$OUTPUT_PATH.tmp.$$"
+  printf '%s\n' "$REPORT" > "$OUTPUT_TMP"
+  mv "$OUTPUT_TMP" "$OUTPUT_PATH"
+else
+  printf '%s\n' "$REPORT"
+fi",

+#!/usr/bin/env bash
+set -euo pipefail
+
+BASELINE="" CONTRACT="" OUTPUT=""
+while (($#)); do
+  case "$1" in
+    --baseline) BASELINE="$2"; shift 2;;
+    --contract) CONTRACT="$2"; shift 2;;
+    --output) OUTPUT="$2"; shift 2;;
+    *) echo "ci-measure-report: unknown argument: $1" >&2; exit 2;;
+  esac
+done
+[[ -s "$BASELINE" && -s "$CONTRACT" && -n "$OUTPUT" ]] || { echo "ci-measure-report: baseline, contract and output are required" >&2; exit 2; }
+python3 - "$BASELINE" "$CONTRACT" "$OUTPUT" <<'PY'
+import json, pathlib, sys
+baseline=json.loads(pathlib.Path(sys.argv[1]).read_text())
+contract=json.loads(pathlib.Path(sys.argv[2]).read_text())
+output=pathlib.Path(sys.argv[3])
+identity=baseline.get('measured_pr_identity') or {}
+bundle_hash=baseline.get('source_bundle_sha256','unknown')
+full=baseline.get('instrumented_full_pr') or {}
+def show(value, unit=''):
+    if value is None: return 'unknown'
+    if isinstance(value, dict):
+        if value.get('status') in ('unknown','insufficient_data','unmeasured'): return 'unknown ('+str(value.get('reason') or value.get('status'))+')'
+        value=value.get('seconds',value.get('total_seconds',value.get('total')))
+        if value is None: return 'unknown'
+    return f"{value:g}{unit}"
+exunit_invocations=full.get('test_costs',{}).get('exunit_invocations',[])
+exunit_invocation_text='; '.join(f"{x.get('invocation','unknown')}: {x.get('tests','unknown')} tests, {show(x.get('test_duration_sum_us'),'µs')}" for x in exunit_invocations) or 'invocation reports unavailable'
+def section_rank(data):
+    rows=data.get('rows') or []
+    return '\n'.join(f"- {row.get('identity','unknown')} — {show(row.get('seconds'),'s')} (run {row.get('run_id','unknown')}, attempt {row.get('attempt','unknown')})" for row in rows[:5]) or '- unknown (no complete source timestamps)'
+def population(name, label):
+    p=baseline.get('populations',{}).get(name,{})
+    return f"- **{label}:** {p.get('run_count',0)} selected of {p.get('api_total_count','unknown')} API runs; outcomes `{json.dumps(p.get('outcomes',{}),sort_keys=True)}`; capped={p.get('population_capped','unknown')}"
+required='\n'.join(f"- `{c}` (ruleset IDs: {', '.join(str(x.get('ruleset_id')) for x in baseline.get('required_rule_provenance',[]) if x.get('context')==c) or 'unknown'})" for c in baseline.get('required_contexts',[])) or '- unknown (effective enforcement snapshot missing)'
+runs='\n'.join(f"- [{r.get('event')} run {r.get('id')} attempt {r.get('run_attempt','unknown')} — {r.get('conclusion','unknown')}]({r.get('html_url') or 'https://github.com/szTheory/sigra/actions'}) — SHA `{r.get('head_sha','unknown')}`, workload `{r.get('workload','unknown')}`" for r in baseline.get('source_runs',[])[:12]) or '- unknown (no source run records in replay)'
+events=['pull_request','main','nightly']
+rank_wait=baseline.get('ranked_by_wait',{}); rank_runner=baseline.get('ranked_by_runner',{})
+queue_pr=baseline.get('initial_wait',{}).get('pull_request',{})
+over=baseline.get('reporter_overhead',{})
+exunit=over.get('exunit',{})
+pw=over.get('playwright',{})
+versions=baseline.get('observed_versions',{})
+configured=baseline.get('configured_versions',{})
+def versions_text():
+    lines=[]
+    for event in events:
+        actual=versions.get(event,{})
+        pins=configured.get(event,{})
+        lines.append(f"- **{event}:** configured `{json.dumps(pins,sort_keys=True)}`; observed `{json.dumps(actual,sort_keys=True)}`")
+    return '\n'.join(lines)
+missing=[]
+if baseline.get('instrumented_full_pr',{}).get('complete') is not True:
+    missing.extend(baseline.get('instrumented_full_pr',{}).get('diagnostics') or ['complete instrumented full PR sample unavailable'])
+if baseline.get('required_result_wait',{}).get('status')!='measured': missing.append(baseline.get('required_result_wait',{}).get('reason','required result endpoint unavailable'))
+failures=baseline.get('failure_signatures',{})
+if failures.get('signatures'):
+    failure_text='\n'.join(f"- {x.get('signature')} — {x.get('occurrences')} observations: " + ', '.join(f"[run {r.get('run_id')} attempt {r.get('attempt')}]({r.get('log_reference') or 'https://github.com/szTheory/sigra/actions'})" for r in x.get('references',[])) for x in failures['signatures'][:3])
+else:
+    failure_text=f"- {failures.get('status','unknown')}: {', '.join(map(str,failures.get('missing_inputs',[])[:3])) or 'no recurring signature was identified in the bounded sample'}"
+attempts=baseline.get('instrumented_full_pr',{}).get('run_attempts') or []
+attempt_lines=[]
+for attempt in attempts:
+    failed=[j for j in attempt.get('jobs',[]) if j.get('conclusion') in ('failure','timed_out','cancelled')]
+    skipped=sum(1 for j in attempt.get('jobs',[]) if j.get('conclusion')=='skipped')
+    detail=', '.join(f"{j.get('name')} `{j.get('conclusion')}` ({show(j.get('runner_seconds'),'s')})" for j in failed) if failed else 'no failed, timed out or cancelled jobs'
+    attempt_lines.append(f"- Attempt {attempt.get('attempt','unknown')}: {show(attempt.get('runner_seconds'),'s')} summed runner time; {detail}; {skipped} skipped jobs.")
+attempt_text='\n'.join(attempt_lines) or '- unknown (attempt job records were not retained)'
+window=contract.get('window') or {}
+window_dates=f"`{window.get('start_utc')}` to `{window.get('end_utc')}`" if window.get('start_utc') and window.get('end_utc') else 'unset; freeze exact UTC start/end after candidate identity and before the first comparison run'
+text=f'''# Current CI baseline
+
+Cutoff: `{baseline.get('cutoff_utc','unknown')}`; collected `{baseline.get('captured_at_utc','unknown')}` from collector checkout `{baseline.get('source_sha','unknown')}` and collector workflow SHA-256 `{baseline.get('workflow_sha256','unknown')}`. Immutable source bundle SHA-256: `{bundle_hash}`. Replay source identity: `{baseline.get('source_sha256',{}).get('pull_request','unknown')}` (PR population hash), `{baseline.get('source_sha256',{}).get('request_ledger','unknown')}` (request ledger hash). Status: **{baseline.get('status','unknown')}**. This snapshot is bounded to 100 runs per event and a 30-day window; capped/expired or undetailed records remain unknown.
+
+## Separate populations
+
+{population('pull_request','Pull requests')}
+{population('push_main','Main pushes')}
+{population('schedule','Nightly schedule')}
+
+PR workload classes: full `{baseline.get('cohorts',{}).get('full',{}).get('n',0)}` measured / `{baseline.get('cohorts',{}).get('full',{}).get('run_count',0)}` selected; docs-only `{baseline.get('cohorts',{}).get('docs_only',{}).get('n',0)}` measured / `{baseline.get('cohorts',{}).get('docs_only',{}).get('run_count',0)}` selected. Missing changed-file detail is unknown, not docs-only.
+
+## Required result and cost

+const TEST_SUMMARY_STATUSES = new Set(['skipped', 'expected', 'unexpected', 'flaky']);
+const EXPECTED_STATUSES = RESULT_STATUSES;
+
+function isRecord(value) {
+  return value !== null && typeof value === 'object' && !Array.isArray(value);
+}
+
+function nonEmptyString(value) {
+  return typeof value === 'string' && value.trim().length > 0;
+}
+
+function validDate(value) {
+  return typeof value === 'string' && Number.isFinite(Date.parse(value));
+}
+
+function safePath(value) {
+  return value.replaceAll('\\', '/');
+}
+
+function compareText(left, right) {
+  return left < right ? -1 : left > right ? 1 : 0;
+}
+
+function makeBase({ seam, invocation }) {
+  return {
+    schema_version: 1,
+    source_format: 'playwright-json',
+    report_format_contract: 'playwright-json-1.59.1',
+    seam,
+    invocation,
+    unit: 'ms',
+    tests: [],
+    selected_count: null,
+    skipped_count: null,
+    excluded_count: null,
+    excluded_count_reason: 'native_json_does_not_include_excluded_cases',
+    suite_started_at: null,
+    suite_elapsed_ms: null,
+    sum_test_duration_ms: null,
+    complete: false,
+    incomplete_reasons: [],
+    reporter_overhead: {
+      status: 'unmeasured',
+      overhead_ms: null,
+      unit: 'ms',
+      reason: 'paired_same_selection_runs_not_recorded',
+    },
+  };
+}
+
+function addReason(reasons, reason) {
+  if (!reasons.includes(reason)) reasons.push(reason);
+}
+
+/** Validate and normalize a native Playwright 1.59.1 JSON report. */
+export function normalizeReport(report, identity) {
+  const normalized = makeBase(identity ?? {});
+  const reasons = normalized.incomplete_reasons;
+
+  if (!nonEmptyString(normalized.seam) || !nonEmptyString(normalized.invocation)) {
+    addReason(reasons, 'invocation_identity_missing');
+  }
+  if (!isRecord(report) || !isRecord(report.config) || !Array.isArray(report.config.projects)
+    || !Array.isArray(report.suites) || !Array.isArray(report.errors) || !isRecord(report.stats)) {
+    addReason(reasons, 'report_invalid_shape');
+    return normalized;
+  }
+
+  const projects = new Map();
+  for (const project of report.config.projects) {
+    if (!isRecord(project) || !nonEmptyString(project.id) || !nonEmptyString(project.name)
+      || projects.has(project.id) || [...projects.values()].some((existing) => existing.name === project.name)) {
+      addReason(reasons, 'project_identity_invalid');
+      continue;
+    }
+    projects.set(project.id, { id: project.id, name: project.name });
+  }
+
+  const stats = report.stats;
+  const statsCounts = ['expected', 'unexpected', 'flaky', 'skipped'];
+  if (!validDate(stats.startTime) || !Number.isFinite(stats.duration) || stats.duration < 0
+    || statsCounts.some((key) => !Number.isInteger(stats[key]) || stats[key] < 0)) {
+    addReason(reasons, 'report_stats_invalid');
+  } else {
+    normalized.suite_started_at = stats.startTime;
+    normalized.suite_elapsed_ms = stats.duration;
+    normalized.skipped_count = stats.skipped;
+  }
+  if (report.errors.length > 0) addReason(reasons, 'report_has_errors');
+
+  const identities = new Set();
+  let selectedCount = 0;
+  const observedSummaryCounts = { expected: 0, unexpected: 0, flaky: 0, skipped: 0 };
+
+  function visitSuites(suites, ancestors = []) {
+    if (!Array.isArray(suites)) {
+      addReason(reasons, 'suite_invalid_shape');
+      return;
+    }
+    for (const suite of suites) {

+"""Validate source-bound ExUnit reports emitted by the two mix ci invocations."""
+
+EXPECTED_REPORTS = {

+
+
+def validate(metadata, reports, artifact_names, run_id, attempt):
+    diagnostics = []
+    expected_metadata = [
+        {"invocation": invocation, "path": filename}
+        for invocation, filename in EXPECTED_REPORTS.items()
+    ]
+    if metadata.get("exunit_reports") != expected_metadata:
+        diagnostics.append("exunit_producer_report_contract_missing")
+
+    expected_artifact = f"library-test-timing-{run_id}-{attempt}"
+    if metadata.get("timing_artifact_name") != expected_artifact or any(
+        artifact_names.get(invocation) != expected_artifact
+        for invocation in EXPECTED_REPORTS
+    ):
+        diagnostics.append("exunit_timing_artifact_not_bound_to_library_job")
+
+    normalized = {}
+    summaries = []
+    rows = []
+    for invocation in EXPECTED_REPORTS:
+        report = reports.get(invocation)
+        if (
+            not isinstance(report, dict)
+            or report.get("complete") is not True
+            or report.get("unit") != "microsecond"
+            or report.get("invocation") != invocation
+        ):
+            diagnostics.append(
+                f"complete_exunit_{invocation}_timing_missing_or_wrong_invocation"
+            )
+            continue
+
+        report_rows = report.get("tests")
+        if not isinstance(report_rows, list) or any(
+            not isinstance(row, dict)
+            or row.get("invocation") != invocation
+            or not isinstance(row.get("test_id"), str)
+            or not isinstance(row.get("duration_us"), int)
+            or row.get("duration_us") < 0
+            for row in report_rows

+            diagnostics.append(f"exunit_{invocation}_duration_total_mismatch")

+

+defmodule Sigra.Test.CITimingFormatter do
+  @moduledoc false
+
+  use GenServer
+
+  @unit "microsecond"
+  @count_keys [:passed, :failed, :skipped, :excluded]
+
+  @doc false
+  def new_state(path, invocation \\ System.get_env("SIGRA_EXUNIT_TIMING_INVOCATION")) do
+    %{
+      path: path,
+      invocation: invocation,
+      tests: [],
+      counts: Map.new(@count_keys, &{&1, 0}),
+      test_duration_sum_us: 0,
+      diagnostics: [],
+      started_at_us: nil,
+      aborted?: false
+    }
+  end
+
+  @impl true
+  def init(_opts) do
+    path = System.get_env("SIGRA_EXUNIT_TIMING_JSON")
+    state = new_state(path, System.get_env("SIGRA_EXUNIT_TIMING_INVOCATION"))
+
+    case clear_previous_report(path) do
+      :ok ->
+        {:ok, state}
+
+      {:error, reason} ->
+        report_write_error(reason)
+        {:ok, add_diagnostic(state, "previous_output_unavailable")}
+    end
+  end
+
+  @impl true
+  def handle_cast({:suite_started, _opts}, state) do
+    {:noreply, %{state | started_at_us: System.monotonic_time(:microsecond)}}
+  end
+
+  def handle_cast({:test_finished, %ExUnit.Test{} = test}, state) do
+    id = test_id(test)
+    result = result(test.state)
+    state = update_in(state.counts[result], &(&1 + 1))
+
+    if result == :excluded do
+      {:noreply, state}
+    else
+      case test.time do
+        time when is_integer(time) and time >= 0 ->
+          row = %{
+            invocation: state.invocation,
+            test_id: id,
+            module: inspect(test.module),
+            name: Atom.to_string(test.name),
+            result: Atom.to_string(result),
+            duration_us: time,
+            unit: @unit
+          }
+
+          state =
+            state
+            |> update_in([:tests], &[row | &1])
+            |> update_in([:test_duration_sum_us], &(&1 + time))
+
+          {:noreply, state}
+
+        _ ->
+          {:noreply, add_diagnostic(state, "test_duration_unavailable:#{id}")}
+      end
+    end
+  end
+
+  def handle_cast({:max_failures_reached, _}, state) do
+    {:noreply, state |> Map.put(:aborted?, true) |> add_diagnostic("max_failures_reached")}
+  end
+
+  def handle_cast(:max_failures_reached, state) do
+    {:noreply, state |> Map.put(:aborted?, true) |> add_diagnostic("max_failures_reached")}
+  end
+
+  def handle_cast({:suite_finished, times_us}, state) do
+    report = build_report(state, times_us, true)
+    write_report(state.path, report)
+    {:noreply, state}
+  end
+
+  def handle_cast({:sigquit, _current}, state) do
+    state = state |> Map.put(:aborted?, true) |> add_diagnostic("suite_interrupted")
+    write_report(state.path, build_report(state, %{}, false))
+    {:noreply, state}
+  end
+
+  def handle_cast(_event, state), do: {:noreply, state}
+
+  defp build_report(state, times_us, suite_finished?) do
+    {run_us, diagnostics} = measured_time(times_us, :run, state.diagnostics)
+    {async_us, diagnostics} = measured_time(times_us, :async, diagnostics, optional: true)
+    {load_us, diagnostics} = measured_time(times_us, :load, diagnostics, optional: true)
+
+    suite_elapsed_us =
+      case {state.started_at_us, suite_finished?} do
+        {started_at_us, true} when is_integer(started_at_us) ->

<.link navigate={~p"/users/log_in"}> {dgettext("sigra", "Log in")}

<% :new -> %> <.header> {dgettext("sigra", "Confirm your email")} <:subtitle> {dgettext("sigra", "Enter the 6-digit code we sent to your email, or check your inbox for a confirmation link.")} <.form for={@form} id="confirmation_form" phx-change="validate" phx-submit="confirm" class="sigra-auth-stack sigra-auth-stack--4" > <.input field={@form[:code]} type="text" label={dgettext("sigra", "Confirmation code")} inputmode="numeric" autocomplete="one-time-code" aria-label={dgettext("sigra", "Confirmation code")} class="sigra-auth-code-input" required /> <.sigra_auth_button phx-disable-with={dgettext("sigra", "Confirming...")} class="sigra-auth-action sigra-auth-action--primary sigra-auth-action--block"> {dgettext("sigra", "Confirm email")} →

<% :already_confirmed -> %> <.header> {dgettext("sigra", "Email already confirmed")} <:subtitle> {dgettext("sigra", "Your email was already confirmed. You can log in below.")}

<.link navigate={~p"/users/log_in"}> {dgettext("sigra", "Log in")}

<% :sign_in_required -> %> <.header> {dgettext("sigra", "Sign in required")} <:subtitle> {dgettext("sigra", "Please sign in to confirm your email.")}

_uri, socket) do {:noreply, socket} end def handle_event("confirm_link", _params, socket) do case Auth.confirm_user(socket.assigns.confirmation_token) do {:ok, _user} -> {:noreply, socket |> do_confirm_user(socket, user, code) end) end defp do_confirm_user(socket, user, code) when is_binary(code) do normalized_code = String.replace(code, " ", "") if Regex.match?(~r/\A[0-9]{6}\z/, defmodule SigraInstallGoldenTmpWeb.RegistrationLive do use SigraInstallGoldenTmpWeb, :live_view import SigraInstallGoldenTmpWeb.SigraAuthComponents alias SigraInstallGoldenTmp.Accounts.User def render(assigns) do ~H""" <.sigra_auth_page flash={@flash}>
<.header> Register <:subtitle> Already registered? <.link navigate={~p"/users/log_in"}> Log in to your account now. <.form :let={f} for={@form} id="registration_form" phx-submit="save" phx-change="validate" phx-trigger-action={@trigger_submit} action={~p"/users/log_in?_action=registered"} method="post" class="sigra-auth-stack sigra-auth-stack--4" >

We couldn't create your account. Check the highlighted fields and try again.

<% # Add custom fields here (e.g., :name, :company) %> <.input field={f[:email]} type="email" label="Email" autocomplete="username" required /> <.input field={f[:password]} type="password" label="Password" autocomplete="new-password" required /> <% # Password strength indicator %>
{password_strength_label(@password_strength)}
  • {suggestion}
<.sigra_auth_button phx-disable-with="Creating account..." class="sigra-auth-action sigra-auth-action--primary sigra-auth-action--block"> Create an account →
""" end def mount(_params, _session, socket) do changeset = SigraInstallGoldenTmp.Accounts.change_user_registration(%User{}) socket = socket |> assign(trigger_submit: false, check_errors: false) |> assign(passkey_primary_enabled: SigraInstallGoldenTmp.Accounts.passkey_primary_enabled?()) |> assign(enroll_passkey_after_signup: false) |> assign(password_strength: nil, password_suggestions: []) |> assign_form(changeset) {:ok, socket, temporary_assigns: [form: nil]} end def handle_event("save", %{"user" => user_params}, socket) do enroll_passkey = Map.get(user_params, "enroll_passkey") in ["true", true, "on", "1"] case SigraInstallGoldenTmp.Accounts.register_user(user_params) do {:ok, user} -> # Deliver confirmation email (helper exists at SigraInstallGoldenTmp.Accounts.deliver_user_confirmation_instructions/2) confirmation_url_fun = fn token -> if enroll_passkey do url(socket, ~p"/users/confirm/#{token}?enroll_passkey=1") else url(socket, ~p"/users/confirm/#{token}") end end case SigraInstallGoldenTmp.Accounts.deliver_user_confirmation_instructions(user, confirmation_url_fun) do {:ok, :sent} -> :ok {:error, :already_confirmed} -> :ok end changeset = SigraInstallGoldenTmp.Accounts.change_user_registration(user) {:noreply, socket |> assign(trigger_submit: true) |> assign_form(changeset)} {:error, :email_taken} -> # Enumeration-safe: show generic message changeset = SigraInstallGoldenTmp.Accounts.change_user_registration(%User{}) {:noreply, socket |> put_flash(:info, "If this email is available, your account has been created. defmodule SigraInstallGoldenTmpWeb.Router do
  use SigraInstallGoldenTmpWeb, :router

  import SigraInstallGoldenTmpWeb.UserAuth

  pipeline :browser do
    plug :accepts, ["html"]
    plug :fetch_session
    plug :fetch_live_flash
    plug :put_root_layout, html: {SigraInstallGoldenTmpWeb.Layouts, :root}
    plug :protect_from_forgery
    plug :put_secure_browser_headers
    plug :fetch_current_scope
  end

  pipeline :api do
    plug :accepts, ["json"]
  end

  scope "/", SigraInstallGoldenTmpWeb do
    pipe_through :browser

    get "/", PageController, :home
  end

  # Other scopes may use custom stacks.
  # scope "/api", SigraInstallGoldenTmpWeb do
  #   pipe_through :api
  # end

  # Enable LiveDashboard and Swoosh mailbox preview in development
  if Application.compile_env(:sigra_install_golden_tmp, :dev_routes) do
    # If you want to use the LiveDashboard in production, you should put
    # it behind authentication and allow only admins to access it.
    # If your application does not have an admins-only section yet,
    # you can use Plug.BasicAuth to set up some basic authentication
    # as long as you are also using SSL (which you should anyway).
    import Phoenix.LiveDashboard.Router

    scope "/dev" do
      pipe_through :browser

      live_dashboard "/dashboard", metrics: SigraInstallGoldenTmpWeb.Telemetry
      forward "/mailbox", Plug.Swoosh.MailboxPreview
    end
  end

  # Sigra authentication

  pipeline :require_authenticated do
    plug :require_authenticated_user
    plug :require_mfa
  end

  pipeline :require_sudo do
    plug Sigra.Plug.RequireSudo, error_handler: SigraInstallGoldenTmpWeb.AuthErrorHandler
  end

  pipeline :require_mfa_capability do
    plug :ensure_mfa_capability
  end

  pipeline :require_passkeys_capability do
    plug :ensure_passkeys_capability
  end

  pipeline :require_auth_settings_capability do
    plug :ensure_auth_settings_capability
  end

  # Opt-in organization-aware pipelines.
  # Apps that want to gate routes by active organization membership
  # pipe_through :require_org (any active membership) or
  # :require_org_owner (owner role only). These wire into
  # the organization picker + switcher.
  pipeline :require_org do
    plug Sigra.Plug.RequireMembership, error_handler: SigraInstallGoldenTmpWeb.AuthErrorHandler
  end

  pipeline :require_org_owner do
    plug Sigra.Plug.RequireMembership,
      error_handler: SigraInstallGoldenTmpWeb.AuthErrorHandler,
      roles: [:owner]
  end

  # MFA challenge (accessible with mfa_pending sessions)
  scope "/users", SigraInstallGoldenTmpWeb do
    pipe_through [:browser, :require_mfa_capability]

    live "/mfa", MFAChallengeLive

  end


    scope "/users", SigraInstallGoldenTmpWeb do
      pipe_through [:browser]

      live_session :sigra_confirmation,
        on_mount: [{SigraInstallGoldenTmpWeb.UserAuth, :mount_current_scope}] do

    live "/confirm", ConfirmationLive
    live "/confirm/:token", ConfirmationLive, :confirm

      end
    end


  scope "/users", SigraInstallGoldenTmpWeb do
    pipe_through [:browser, :redirect_if_user_is_authenticated]

    # Login page is a plain controller, not a LiveView.
    get "/log_in", SessionController, :new

    live "/register", RegistrationLive

    post "/log_in", SessionController, :create
    get "/log_in/:token", SessionController, :magic_link


    live "/reset-password", ResetPasswordLive
    live "/reset-password/:token", ResetPasswordLive, :edit

  end

  scope "/users", SigraInstallGoldenTmpWeb do
    pipe_through [:browser, :require_authenticated]

    delete "/log_out", SessionController, :delete

    live "/sessions", Auth.SessionLive, :index

      get "/sudo", Auth.SudoController, :new
      post "/sudo", Auth.SudoController, :create

    live "/settings", SettingsLive, :edit
    live "/reactivation", ReactivationLive

  end

  scope "/users", SigraInstallGoldenTmpWeb do
    pipe_through [:browser, :require_auth_settings_capability, :require_authenticated, :require_sudo]

    live "/settings/mfa", MFASettingsLive

  end


  # Single unscoped InvitationAcceptLive at
  # /invitations/:token/accept. This route MUST remain outside any
  # `:require_authenticated` pipeline so both anonymous visitors
  # (signup branch) and signed-in visitors (accept / mismatch branch)
  # reach the same LiveView, which branches on `@branch` at mount.
  scope "/", SigraInstallGoldenTmpWeb do
    pipe_through [:browser]

    live_session :invitations_public,
      on_mount: [{SigraInstallGoldenTmpWeb.UserAuth, :mount_current_scope}] do
      live "/invitations/:token/accept", InvitationAcceptLive
    end
  end

  # Sigra organizations
  pipeline :org_scoped do
    plug Sigra.Plug.LoadOrganizationFromSlug,
      error_handler: SigraInstallGoldenTmpWeb.AuthErrorHandler,
      organizations: SigraInstallGoldenTmp.Organizations,
      session_store: Sigra.SessionStores.Ecto,
      session_store_opts: [repo: SigraInstallGoldenTmp.Repo, session_schema: SigraInstallGoldenTmp.Accounts.UserSession],
      scope_module: SigraInstallGoldenTmp.Accounts.Scope

    plug Sigra.Plug.RequireMembership,
      error_handler: SigraInstallGoldenTmpWeb.AuthErrorHandler
  end

  scope "/", SigraInstallGoldenTmpWeb do
    pipe_through [:browser, :require_authenticated]

    # POST /organizations/switch MUST be defined before the scoped block
    # below so Phoenix's definition-order matching doesn't interpret
    # "switch" as a slug.
    post "/organizations/switch", OrganizationSwitchController, :update

    live_session :organizations_unscoped,
      on_mount: [
        {SigraInstallGoldenTmpWeb.UserAuth, :ensure_authenticated},
        {SigraInstallGoldenTmpWeb.UserAuth, :assign_user_organizations}
      ] do
      live "/organizations", OrganizationsLive.Index, :index
      live "/organizations/new", OrganizationsLive.New, :new
    end
  end

  scope "/organizations/:org", SigraInstallGoldenTmpWeb do
    pipe_through [:browser]

    get "/sso", EnterpriseSSOController, :new
    post "/sso", EnterpriseSSOController, :create
    get "/sso/callback", EnterpriseSSOController, :callback
  end

  scope "/organizations/:org", SigraInstallGoldenTmpWeb do
    pipe_through [:browser, :require_authenticated, :org_scoped]

    live_session :organization_scoped,
      on_mount: [
        {SigraInstallGoldenTmpWeb.UserAuth, :ensure_authenticated},
        {SigraInstallGoldenTmpWeb.UserAuth, :assign_user_organizations},
        {Sigra.LiveView.OrganizationScope,
         [organizations: SigraInstallGoldenTmp.Organizations, scope_module: SigraInstallGoldenTmp.Accounts.Scope]}
      ] do
      live "/settings", OrganizationSettingsLive, :edit
      live "/members", OrganizationMembersLive, :index
    end
  end

# Phase 230 (D-23): the honest-skip set, as data.
#
# WHY THIS FILE EXISTS
# `ci-gate` counts a `skipped` conclusion as a pass, so "this lane was skipped" is
# indistinguishable from "this lane passed" unless the legitimate skips are enumerated
# somewhere a machine can read. That enumeration used to live only as prose in
# MAINTAINING.md. Prose is now a RENDERER of this file, not a second source of truth:
# scripts/ci/prohibitions/p21-honest-skip-parity.test.mjs asserts
# manifest <=> ci.yml <=> MAINTAINING.md and fails in every direction (an undocumented
# demotion, a stale doc entry, or a manifest row naming a construct ci.yml does not have).
#
# CONSUMERS
#   - scripts/ci/ci-demotion-observer.sh                   reads the `assert` rows to
#                                                          decide what must have executed
#                                                          on a non-pull_request run
#   - scripts/ci/prohibitions/p21-honest-skip-parity.test.mjs   three-way parity guard
#   - Phase 231 GATE-03                                    SHOULD read this file rather
#                                                          than re-deriving the set.
#                                                          GATE-03 owns the `ci-gate`
#                                                          pass/fail consequence; this
#                                                          file owns the enumeration.
#                                                          The pull_request half belongs
#                                                          in GATE-03, not here.
#
# TIERS
#   A  event-gated, pre-existing (Phase 196). NOT demoted by Phase 230. Phase 231's
#      GATE-01/GATE-02 own these; the observer deliberately does NOT assert on them --
#      asserting would add a tenth red to a 0-pass/9-fail nightly, which is the
#      unread-noise failure this milestone exists to remove.
#   B  event-gated, demoted BY Phase 230. These are exactly what AFTER-PUSH must observe
#      executing on the receiving lane.
#   C  diff-gated (docs-only). Skips on the CONTENT of the diff rather than the event --
#      a different audit question from A/B.
#
# COLUMNS (TAB-separated; `#` and blank lines are comments)
#   tier           A | B | C
#   kind           job | step
#   id             the ci.yml job id, or the step `id:` when kind=step. Every id here
#                  MUST resolve in ci.yml -- the parity guard asserts it, which is what
#                  stops this file from drifting into fiction.
#   parent_job_id  owning job id when kind=step; `-` when kind=job. A step row's parent
#                  MUST also appear here as a kind=job row -- that is how the observer
#                  resolves the parent's display_name (the Actions API returns names,
#                  never ids).
#   display_name   the job `name:` / step `name:` EXACTLY as ci.yml spells it. The
#                  parity guard pins id and display_name adjacent in ci.yml so the
#                  API-facing lookup cannot rot independently of the id-facing guard.
#   gate_level     job | step -- WHERE the predicate is applied. For the four
#                  ruleset-required tier-C lanes this MUST stay `step`: a job-level
#                  docs_only gate would make the required context `skipped` and can
#                  strand a PR under ruleset 14941512 (D-06).
#   gate           the literal gating predicate, normalized (${{ }} stripped, whitespace
#                  collapsed)
#   observer       assert | exempt | ignore
#                    assert = must have executed on a non-PR run (tier B only)
#                    exempt = event-gated but ALSO outcome-gated, so a skip on a healthy
#                             run is CORRECT -- never assert
#                    ignore = outside the observer's scope (tier A / tier C)
#
tier	kind	id	parent_job_id	display_name	gate_level	gate	observer

### Honest-skip set after Phase 230 (v1.47 FAST-02/FAST-03/FAST-05)

`ci-gate` counts a `skipped` conclusion as a pass (the `ci-gate` job's result loop treats
`"$result" != "success" && "$result" != "skipped"` as the only failing case), so the tiers below are the
enumerated baseline against which Phase 231's GATE-03 distinguishes "skipped because correctly
gated for this event" from "skipped because its gate rotted", and against which Phase 235's
GATE-05 builds its before/after coverage inventory. Every entry names the construct (job id or
step id) and its literal gating condition, verified against the shipped `ci.yml` at the commit
this section was written.

<!-- honest-skip-active-ids:start -->
- `install_matrix`
- `upgrade_smoke`
- `passkeys_manual_fallback_smoke`
- `passkeys_opt_out_smoke`
- `nightly_probe`
- `admin_design_recapture`
- `admin_checkpoint_recapture`
- `notify_release_lane_rot`
- `admin_eval_render`
- `design_gallery_snapshots`
- `example_playwright_shard`
- `library_tests_dep_off`
- `example_unit_smoke`
- `install_smoke`
- `example_http_smoke`
- `example_playwright_smoke`
- `retired_skip_lane`
<!-- honest-skip-active-ids:end -->

**Tier A — event-gated, pre-existing (Phase 196).** `install_matrix`, `upgrade_smoke`,
`passkeys_manual_fallback_smoke`, `passkeys_opt_out_smoke`, `nightly_probe`, plus the two
recapture lanes (`admin_design_recapture`, `admin_checkpoint_recapture`) and
`notify_release_lane_rot` — all gated to non-`pull_request` events. The "CI cadence" enumeration
above is the authority for this tier; it is repeated here only so the post-Phase-230 honest-skip
set reads as one list. `generated_admin_playwright_smoke` is no longer in this tier: Phase 231
GATE-02 / D-06 deleted its `if:` condition outright (not replaced), so it now runs on every
event, including `pull_request`, gated by nothing.

**Tier B — event-gated, added by Phase 230.**

- The job `admin_eval_render` (`Admin eval render + probe (hard signal on push/schedule/dispatch;
  not in ci-gate)`) — `if: github.event_name != 'pull_request'` — newly gated to non-`pull_request`
  events, removing a measured 17m33s from every PR (FAST-03, D-10). It is not in `ci-gate.needs`
  and is not a ruleset context, so a failure here never blocks a merge and this job never runs on
  a `pull_request` event at all — but as of Phase 231 GATE-04 (D-11 step 4), the JOB-level
  `continue-on-error: true` that used to mask a harness failure is gone: on push, schedule, and
  `workflow_dispatch` runs, a harness failure now reddens this job's own conclusion. The
  STEP-level `continue-on-error: true` under `id: admin_eval_harness` (D-13) is retained
  permanently so partial evidence bundles still upload as artifacts before the re-fail step turns
  the job red.
- The step `design_gallery_snapshots` ("Run design gallery board snapshots (non-PR)") inside
  `example_playwright_smoke` — `id: design_gallery_snapshots`,
  `if: ${{ !cancelled() && github.event_name != 'pull_request' && needs.changes.outputs.docs_only != 'true' }}`
  — newly gated to non-`pull_request` events, carrying the 84 per-board pixel-diff snapshot
  assertions (FAST-02, D-01/D-04). Its step id is in the seam-outcome aggregator's hard-coded
  outcome list (the `Aggregate Playwright step outcomes` step's `for o in ...` loop inside
  `example_playwright_smoke`), so a snapshot regression on `main` still reds the
  ruleset-required "Example Playwright smoke (full lifecycle)" context. The WCAG axe scan and the
  L1-state behaviour half of the same spec (`design_gallery`, filtered
  `--grep-invert '@snapshot'`) still run on every PR in the sibling step.

**Tier C — diff-gated (docs-only), added by Phase 230.** These skip on the *content of the diff*
(a new `changes` job's `docs_only` output) rather than on the event, which is a different audit
question from Tier A/B. Gated:

- The heavy steps (deps cache through the test-running step) of the four app-behaviour
  ruleset-required lanes — `example_unit_smoke`, `install_smoke`, `example_http_smoke`,
  `example_playwright_smoke` — each guarded `if: needs.changes.outputs.docs_only != 'true'` (with
  `!cancelled()` composed in where the job also carries other conditions). Gated at step level, not
  job level, so all four required contexts still run and conclude `success`.
- The whole `library_tests_dep_off` job —
  `if: ${{ !cancelled() && needs.release_ref_guard.result == 'success' && needs.changes.outputs.docs_only != 'true' }}`
  — gated at job level, permitted because it is not a ruleset-required context (D-08).

**Fail-open polarity:** an empty, missing, or non-`'true'` `docs_only` output runs every heavy
step and job above. Only an explicit `docs_only == 'true'` skips them.

**Not skipped.** `fast_checks` and `library_tests`/`library_tests_shard` are deliberately exempt
from Tier C and carry no `changes` dependency: their guards (`milestone-verification-gate.sh`,
`getting-started-contract.sh`) and the ExUnit files under `test/sigra/planning/` and
`test/sigra/*guides*` read `.planning/**` and `guides/**` directly — the exact paths a docs-only
PR changes. Gating either job would remove coverage in the one dimension the change touches.

See `.planning/phases/230-tier-1-critical-path-reclamation/230-EVIDENCE.md` for the observed-run
evidence backing each of these claims.

name: Boot example app for Playwright
description: Prepare, boot, and warm the repository example app for Playwright consumers.

inputs:
  database-name:
    description: Runner-local PostgreSQL database name.
    required: true
  database-port:
    description: Runner-local PostgreSQL port.
    required: false
    default: "5432"
  app-port:
    description: Port compiled into and used by the Phoenix endpoint.
    required: true
  base-url:
    description: Absolute URL used for readiness and Playwright.
    required: true
  server-log:
    description: Absolute path receiving Phoenix stdout and stderr.
    required: true
  browsers:
    description: Space-separated Playwright browser binaries to install.
    required: false
    default: chromium webkit
  cache-browsers:
    description: Whether to cache Playwright browser downloads.
    required: false
    default: "false"
  browser-cache-key:
    description: Exact browser cache key when cache-browsers is true.
    required: false
    default: ""
  warmup-paths:
    description: Space-separated application paths warmed after readiness.
    required: false
    default: /users/register /users/log_in /users/confirm /dev/mailbox /users/sessions /users/sudo /users/settings/mfa /admin/users

outputs:
  deps_cache_hit:
    description: Exact example dependency cache hit.
    value: ${{ steps.example_deps_cache.outputs.cache-hit }}
  browser_cache_hit:
    description: Exact Playwright browser cache hit, or false when disabled.
    value: ${{ steps.browser_cache_result.outputs.hit }}

runs:
  using: composite
  steps:
    - uses: erlef/setup-beam@54075bcc5e249e4758d363f27d099f55d843f124 # v1.24.1
      id: setup_beam
      with:
        version-file: .tool-versions
        version-type: strict

    - uses: actions/setup-node@820762786026740c76f36085b0efc47a31fe5020 # v7.0.0
      with:
        node-version: "20"
        cache: npm
        cache-dependency-path: test/example/priv/playwright/package-lock.json

    - name: Cache example dependencies
      id: example_deps_cache
      uses: actions/cache@v6 # v6.1.0
      with:
        path: |
          test/example/deps
          test/example/_build
        # Phoenix validates endpoint configuration against the compile-time value.
        # Partition cached _build output by the PORT supplied to this consumer.
        key: ${{ runner.os }}-example-dev-port${{ inputs.app-port }}-otp${{ steps.setup_beam.outputs.otp-version }}-elixir${{ steps.setup_beam.outputs.elixir-version }}-dev-${{ hashFiles('test/example/mix.lock', 'test/example/config/**', 'test/example/lib/**/*.ex', 'lib/**/*.ex', 'mix.exs') }}-v1
        restore-keys: ${{ runner.os }}-example-dev-port${{ inputs.app-port }}-otp${{ steps.setup_beam.outputs.otp-version }}-elixir${{ steps.setup_beam.outputs.elixir-version }}-dev-

    - name: Fetch and compile example
      shell: bash
      working-directory: test/example
      env:
        MIX_ENV: dev
        PORT: ${{ inputs.app-port }}
        PGDATABASE: ${{ inputs.database-name }}
        PGPORT: ${{ inputs.database-port }}
      run: |
        set -euo pipefail
        mix deps.get
        mix compile --warnings-as-errors

    - name: Create, migrate, and seed example database
      shell: bash
      working-directory: test/example
      env:
        MIX_ENV: dev
        PORT: ${{ inputs.app-port }}
        PGUSER: postgres
        PGPASSWORD: postgres
        PGHOST: localhost
        PGDATABASE: ${{ inputs.database-name }}
        PGPORT: ${{ inputs.database-port }}
      run: |
        set -euo pipefail
        mix ecto.create
        mix ecto.migrate
        mix run priv/repo/seeds.exs

    - name: Install Playwright dependencies
      shell: bash
      working-directory: test/example/priv/playwright
      run: npm ci

    - name: Cache Playwright browsers
      id: playwright_browsers_cache
      if: inputs.cache-browsers == 'true'
      uses: actions/cache@55cc8345863c7cc4c66a329aec7e433d2d1c52a9 # v6.1.0
      with:
        path: ~/.cache/ms-playwright
        key: ${{ inputs.browser-cache-key }}

    - name: Normalize browser cache result
      id: browser_cache_result
      shell: bash
      env:
        CACHE_ENABLED: ${{ inputs.cache-browsers }}
        CACHE_HIT: ${{ steps.playwright_browsers_cache.outputs.cache-hit }}
      run: |
        if [ "$CACHE_ENABLED" = "true" ] && [ "$CACHE_HIT" = "true" ]; then
          echo "hit=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
        else
          echo "hit=false" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
        fi

    - name: Install Playwright browsers
      shell: bash
      working-directory: test/example/priv/playwright
      env:
        BROWSERS: ${{ inputs.browsers }}
        CACHE_HIT: ${{ steps.browser_cache_result.outputs.hit }}
      run: |
        set -euo pipefail
        if [ "$CACHE_HIT" = "true" ]; then
          npx playwright install-deps $BROWSERS
        else
          npx playwright install --with-deps $BROWSERS
        fi

    - name: Boot example app
      shell: bash
      working-directory: test/example
      env:
        MIX_ENV: dev
        PORT: ${{ inputs.app-port }}
        PGUSER: postgres
        PGPASSWORD: postgres
        PGHOST: localhost
        PGDATABASE: ${{ inputs.database-name }}
        PGPORT: ${{ inputs.database-port }}
        PHX_SERVER: "true"
        SERVER_LOG: ${{ inputs.server-log }}
      run: mix phx.server > "$SERVER_LOG" 2>&1 &

    - name: Wait for app and warm routes
      shell: bash
      env:
        BASE_URL: ${{ inputs.base-url }}
        WARMUP_PATHS: ${{ inputs.warmup-paths }}
        SERVER_LOG: ${{ inputs.server-log }}
      run: |
        set -euo pipefail
        ready=false
        for i in $(seq 1 30); do
          if curl -sf "$BASE_URL/" > /dev/null; then
            echo "App responding after ${i}s"
            ready=true
            break
          fi
          sleep 1
        done
        if [ "$ready" != "true" ]; then
          echo "::error::example app did not become ready at $BASE_URL"
          cat "$SERVER_LOG" || true
          exit 1
        fi
        for path in $WARMUP_PATHS; do
          curl --fail --silent --output /dev/null "$BASE_URL$path" \
            && echo "warmed $path" \
            || echo "warmup miss $path (non-fatal)"
        done

        PGPORT: ${{ inputs.database-port }}

        PGHOST: localhost

        if [ "$CACHE_ENABLED" = "true" ] && [ "$CACHE_HIT" = "true" ]; then

        else

        fi

    - name: Install Playwright browsers
      shell: bash
      working-directory: test/example/priv/playwright
      env:
        BROWSERS: ${{ inputs.browsers }}
        CACHE_HIT: ${{ steps.browser_cache_result.outputs.hit }}
      run: |
        set -euo pipefail
        if [ "$CACHE_HIT" = "true" ]; then
          npx playwright install-deps $BROWSERS
        else
          npx playwright install --with-deps $BROWSERS
        fi

    - name: Boot example app
      shell: bash
      working-directory: test/example
      env:
        MIX_ENV: dev
        PORT: ${{ inputs.app-port }}
        PGUSER: postgres
        PGPASSWORD: postgres
        PGHOST: localhost
        PGDATABASE: ${{ inputs.database-name }}
        PGPORT: ${{ inputs.database-port }}
        PHX_SERVER: "true"
        SERVER_LOG: ${{ inputs.server-log }}
      run: mix phx.server > "$SERVER_LOG" 2>&1 &

    - name: Wait for app and warm routes
      shell: bash
      env:
        BASE_URL: ${{ inputs.base-url }}
        WARMUP_PATHS: ${{ inputs.warmup-paths }}
        SERVER_LOG: ${{ inputs.server-log }}
      run: |
        set -euo pipefail
        ready=false
        for i in $(seq 1 30); do
          if curl -sf "$BASE_URL/" > /dev/null; then
            echo "App responding after ${i}s"
            ready=true
            break
          fi
          sleep 1
        done
        if [ "$ready" != "true" ]; then
          echo "::error::example app did not become ready at $BASE_URL"
          cat "$SERVER_LOG" || true
          exit 1
        fi
        for path in $WARMUP_PATHS; do
          curl --fail --silent --output /dev/null "$BASE_URL$path" \
            && echo "warmed $path" \
            || echo "warmup miss $path (non-fatal)"
        done

          filtered = Map.take(attrs, known)
          Ecto.Changeset.change(user, filtered)
        end,
        session_store: Sigra.MockSessionStore,
        token_query_fn: fn _user, _contexts ->
          import Ecto.Query
          from(t in Sigra.TestUserToken, where: false)
        end,
        config: [deletion: [strategy: :soft_delete, grace_period_days: 14, cooldown_hours: 24]]
      ],
      overrides
    )
  end

  # --- schedule/3 ---

  describe "schedule/3" do
    test "returns {:ok, user, scheduled_date} on success" do
      user = build_user()

      Sigra.MockRepo
      |> expect(:transaction, fn multi ->
        assert %Multi{} = multi
        now = DateTime.utc_now() |> DateTime.truncate(:second)
        scheduled = DateTime.add(now, 14 * 86400, :second) |> DateTime.truncate(:second)

        {:ok,
         %{
           user: %{
             user
             | deleted_at: now,
               scheduled_deletion_at: scheduled,
               original_email: user.email,
               pending_email: nil
           }
         }}
      end)

      Sigra.MockSessionStore
      |> expect(:delete_all_for_user, fn _user_id, _opts -> {1, nil} end)

      assert {:ok, updated_user, scheduled_at} =
               Deletion.schedule(Sigra.MockRepo, user, base_opts())

      assert updated_user.deleted_at != nil
      assert updated_user.scheduled_deletion_at != nil
      assert updated_user.original_email == "user@example.com"
      assert updated_user.pending_email == nil
      assert %DateTime{} = scheduled_at
    end

    test "enqueues account deletion worker when generated-host job context is present" do
      # Simulate Oban supervision: oban_running?/0 checks both oban_available?/0
      # (true — Oban is compiled) AND Process.whereis(Oban) != nil. Register a
      # dummy process under the Oban name so the guard passes (D-01/D-02).
      dummy = spawn(fn -> Process.sleep(:infinity) end)
      Process.register(dummy, Oban)
      on_exit(fn -> Process.exit(dummy, :kill) end)

      user = build_user()

      Sigra.MockRepo
      |> expect(:transaction, fn multi ->
        assert %Multi{} = multi

        [{:user, {:update, changeset, []}}, {:tokens, {:delete_all, _query, []}}] =
          Multi.to_list(multi)

        now = Ecto.Changeset.get_change(changeset, :deleted_at)
        scheduled = Ecto.Changeset.get_change(changeset, :scheduled_deletion_at)
        Process.put(:account_deletion_scheduled_at, scheduled)

        {:ok,
         %{
           user: %{
             user
             | deleted_at: now,
               scheduled_deletion_at: scheduled,
               original_email: user.email,
               pending_email: nil
           }
         }}
      end)

      Sigra.MockSessionStore
      |> expect(:delete_all_for_user, fn 1, [] -> {1, nil} end)

      Sigra.MockRepo
      |> expect(:insert, fn changeset ->
        assert changeset.valid? == true
        assert Ecto.Changeset.get_field(changeset, :worker) == "Sigra.Workers.AccountDeletion"
        assert Ecto.Changeset.get_field(changeset, :queue) == "sigra_lifecycle"

        assert DateTime.compare(
                 Ecto.Changeset.get_field(changeset, :scheduled_at),
                 Process.get(:account_deletion_scheduled_at)
               ) == :eq

        assert Ecto.Changeset.get_field(changeset, :replace) == [
                 scheduled: [:scheduled_at, :args]
               ]

        args = Ecto.Changeset.get_field(changeset, :args)

        assert args["user_id"] == 1
        assert args["strategy"] == "soft_delete"
        assert args["repo"] == Atom.to_string(Sigra.MockRepo)
        assert args["user_schema"] == Atom.to_string(Sigra.TestUser)
        assert args["user_token_schema"] == Atom.to_string(Sigra.TestUserToken)
        assert args["session_store"] == Atom.to_string(Sigra.MockSessionStore)
        assert Map.has_key?(args, "organization_id") == true
        assert Map.has_key?(args, "actor_id") == true
        assert Map.has_key?(args, "audit_schema") == true
        assert Map.has_key?(args, "scope_module") == true

        {:ok, %Oban.Job{}}
      end)

      assert {:ok, updated_user, scheduled_at} =
               Deletion.schedule(
                 Sigra.MockRepo,
                 user,
                 base_opts(
                   user_schema: Sigra.TestUser,
                   user_token_schema: Sigra.TestUserToken
                 )
               )

      assert updated_user.scheduled_deletion_at == scheduled_at
    end

    test "safely degrades without enqueue when job context is missing" do
      user = build_user()

      Sigra.MockRepo
      |> expect(:transaction, fn multi ->
        assert %Multi{} = multi

        [{:user, {:update, changeset, []}}, {:tokens, {:delete_all, _query, []}}] =
          Multi.to_list(multi)

        now = Ecto.Changeset.get_change(changeset, :deleted_at)
        scheduled = Ecto.Changeset.get_change(changeset, :scheduled_deletion_at)

        {:ok,
         %{
           user: %{
             user
             | deleted_at: now,
               scheduled_deletion_at: scheduled,
               original_email: user.email,
               pending_email: nil
           }
         }}
      end)

      Sigra.MockSessionStore
      |> expect(:delete_all_for_user, fn 1, [] -> {1, nil} end)

      assert {:ok, updated_user, scheduled_at} =
               Deletion.schedule(Sigra.MockRepo, user, base_opts())

      assert updated_user.scheduled_deletion_at == scheduled_at
      assert %DateTime{} = scheduled_at
    end

    test "does not attempt to enqueue when Oban is compiled but not supervised" do
      # Arrange: Oban module is compiled (oban_available?/0 true) but Process.whereis(Oban)
      # returns nil in the ExUnit environment — Oban is not supervised here. This is the
      # exact condition the oban_running?/0 guard was added to catch (DEBT-01 D-04).
      assert Sigra.OptionalDeps.oban_available?() == true,
             "Oban must be compiled as a dep for this regression test to be meaningful"

      assert Process.whereis(Oban) == nil,
             "Oban must not be supervised in the test environment — this test verifies the guard fires"

      user = build_user()

      Sigra.MockRepo
      |> expect(:transaction, fn multi ->
        assert %Multi{} = multi

        [{:user, {:update, changeset, []}}, {:tokens, {:delete_all, _query, []}}] =
          Multi.to_list(multi)

        now = Ecto.Changeset.get_change(changeset, :deleted_at)
        scheduled = Ecto.Changeset.get_change(changeset, :scheduled_deletion_at)

        {:ok,
         %{
           user: %{
             user
             | deleted_at: now,
               scheduled_deletion_at: scheduled,
               original_email: user.email,
               pending_email: nil
           }
         }}
      end)

      Sigra.MockSessionStore
      |> expect(:delete_all_for_user, fn 1, [] -> {1, nil} end)

      # Act: no repo.insert expectation set — if the guard failed, Mox would
      # raise an unexpected-call error here (proving the guard fired when absent)
      import ExUnit.CaptureLog

      log =
        capture_log(fn ->
          result =
            Deletion.schedule(
              Sigra.MockRepo,
              user,
              base_opts(
                user_schema: Sigra.TestUser,
                user_token_schema: Sigra.TestUserToken
              )
            )

          # Assert: deletion succeeds (user soft-deleted, sessions revoked)
          assert {:ok, updated_user, scheduled_at} = result
          assert updated_user.scheduled_deletion_at != nil
          assert %DateTime{} = scheduled_at
        end)

      # Assert: no Oban-crash warning emitted — guard fired before insert attempt
      refute log =~ "Sigra account deletion job enqueue crashed",
             "Expected oban_running?/0 guard to prevent the insert attempt; got crash log: #{log}"
    end

    test "returns {:error, :already_scheduled} when deletion is already scheduled" do
      user =
        build_user(%{
          deleted_at: ~U[2026-01-01 00:00:00Z],
          scheduled_deletion_at: ~U[2026-01-15 00:00:00Z]
        })

      result = Deletion.schedule(Sigra.MockRepo, user, base_opts())

      assert result == {:error, :already_scheduled}
    end
  end

  # --- cancel/3 ---

  describe "cancel/3" do
    test "returns {:ok, user} when deletion is scheduled" do
      user =
        build_user(%{
          deleted_at: ~U[2026-01-01 00:00:00Z],
          scheduled_deletion_at: ~U[2026-01-15 00:00:00Z],
          original_email: "user@example.com"
        })

      Sigra.MockRepo
      |> expect(:transaction, fn multi ->
        assert %Multi{} = multi
        {:ok, %{user: %{user | deleted_at: nil, scheduled_deletion_at: nil, original_email: nil}}}
      end)

      assert {:ok, updated_user} = Deletion.cancel(Sigra.MockRepo, user, base_opts())

      assert updated_user.deleted_at == nil
      assert updated_user.scheduled_deletion_at == nil
      assert updated_user.original_email == nil
    end

    test "returns {:error, :not_scheduled} when not scheduled" do
      user = build_user()

      result = Deletion.cancel(Sigra.MockRepo, user, base_opts())

      assert result == {:error, :not_scheduled}
    end

    test "returns {:error, :not_scheduled} when user is already finalized" do
      user = build_user(%{deleted_at: ~U[2026-01-01 00:00:00Z]})

      result = Deletion.cancel(Sigra.MockRepo, user, base_opts())

      assert result == {:error, :not_scheduled}
    end
  end

  # --- execute/3 ---

  describe "execute/3" do
    test "returns {:ok, :soft_delete} for soft delete strategy" do
      user =
        build_user(%{
          deleted_at: ~U[2026-01-01 00:00:00Z],
          scheduled_deletion_at: ~U[2026-01-15 00:00:00Z],
          original_email: "user@example.com",
          pending_email: "pending@example.com"
        })

      Sigra.MockRepo
      |> expect(:transaction, fn multi ->
        assert %Multi{} = multi
        [{:user, {:update, changeset, []}}] = Multi.to_list(multi)

        assert Ecto.Changeset.get_change(changeset, :scheduled_deletion_at) == nil
        assert Ecto.Changeset.get_change(changeset, :pending_email) == nil
        assert Ecto.Changeset.get_change(changeset, :original_email) == nil
        assert Ecto.Changeset.get_change(changeset, :deleted_at) == nil

        {:ok,
         %{
           user: %{
             user
             | original_email: nil,
               pending_email: nil,
               scheduled_deletion_at: nil
           }
         }}
      end)

      opts = base_opts(config: [deletion: [strategy: :soft_delete]])

      assert {:ok, :soft_delete} = Deletion.execute(Sigra.MockRepo, user, opts)
    end

    test "returns {:ok, :hard_delete} and deletes user row" do
      user =
        build_user(%{
          deleted_at: ~U[2026-01-01 00:00:00Z],
          scheduled_deletion_at: ~U[2026-01-15 00:00:00Z]
        })

      Sigra.MockRepo
      |> expect(:transaction, fn multi ->
        assert %Multi{} = multi
        {:ok, %{delete_user: user}}
      end)

      opts = base_opts(config: [deletion: [strategy: :hard_delete]])

      assert {:ok, :hard_delete} = Deletion.execute(Sigra.MockRepo, user, opts)
    end

    test "returns {:ok, :anonymize} and clears PII" do
      user =
        build_user(%{
          deleted_at: ~U[2026-01-01 00:00:00Z],
          scheduled_deletion_at: ~U[2026-01-15 00:00:00Z]
        })

      Sigra.MockRepo
      |> expect(:transaction, fn multi ->
        assert %Multi{} = multi
        {:ok, %{user: %{user | email: "deleted_1@deleted.invalid", hashed_password: nil}}}
      end)

      opts = base_opts(config: [deletion: [strategy: :anonymize]])

      assert {:ok, :anonymize} = Deletion.execute(Sigra.MockRepo, user, opts)
    end

    test "returns {:error, :not_scheduled} when user is not scheduled for deletion" do
      user = build_user()

      opts = base_opts(config: [deletion: [strategy: :soft_delete]])

      assert {:error, :not_scheduled} = Deletion.execute(Sigra.MockRepo, user, opts)
    end

    test "returns {:error, :not_scheduled} when user is already finalized" do
      user = build_user(%{deleted_at: ~U[2026-01-01 00:00:00Z]})

      opts = base_opts(config: [deletion: [strategy: :soft_delete]])

      assert {:error, :not_scheduled} = Deletion.execute(Sigra.MockRepo, user, opts)
    end
  end

  # --- scheduled?/1 ---

  describe "scheduled?/1" do
    test "returns true when both timestamps are set" do
      user =
        build_user(%{
          deleted_at: ~U[2026-01-01 00:00:00Z],
          scheduled_deletion_at: ~U[2026-01-15 00:00:00Z]
        })

      assert Deletion.scheduled?(user) == true
    end

    test "returns false when deleted_at is nil" do
      user = build_user()

      assert Deletion.scheduled?(user) == false
    end

    test "returns false when scheduled_deletion_at is nil but deleted_at is set" do
      user = build_user(%{deleted_at: ~U[2026-01-01 00:00:00Z]})

      assert Deletion.scheduled?(user) == false
    end
  end

  # --- status/1 ---

  describe "status/1" do
    test "returns {:scheduled, days} when scheduled" do
      scheduled_at =
        DateTime.utc_now() |> DateTime.add(7 * 86400, :second) |> DateTime.truncate(:second)

      user =
        build_user(%{
          deleted_at: ~U[2026-01-01 00:00:00Z],
          scheduled_deletion_at: scheduled_at
        })

      assert {:scheduled, days} = Deletion.status(user)
      assert days >= 6 and days <= 7
    end

    test "returns :not_scheduled when no deletion" do
      user = build_user()

      assert Deletion.status(user) == :not_scheduled
    end

    test "returns :deleted when deleted_at set but no scheduled_deletion_at" do
      user = build_user(%{deleted_at: ~U[2026-01-01 00:00:00Z]})

      assert Deletion.status(user) == :deleted
    end
  end

  # --- within_cooldown?/2 ---

  describe "within_cooldown?/2" do
    test "returns true when cancelled_at is within cooldown hours" do
      cancelled_at =
        DateTime.utc_now() |> DateTime.add(-3600, :second) |> DateTime.truncate(:second)

      assert Deletion.within_cooldown?(cancelled_at, 24) == true
    end

    test "returns false when cancelled_at is beyond cooldown hours" do
      cancelled_at =
        DateTime.utc_now() |> DateTime.add(-25 * 3600, :second) |> DateTime.truncate(:second)

      assert Deletion.within_cooldown?(cancelled_at, 24) == false
    end
  end
end

defmodule Sigra.AuthTest do

  import Mox

  alias Sigra.Auth

  # Set up Mox mocks

  # A minimal test schema that mimics the generated User schema

      field :hashed_password, :string

      field :locked_at, :utc_datetime
      field :password_changed_at, :utc_datetime

  defmodule TestEnterprisePolicy do

      end)

      Sigra.MockSessionStore
      |> expect(:fetch, fn ^user_a_token, _opts -> {:ok, user_a_session} end)
      |> expect(:list_by_user, fn ^user_a_id, _opts -> [user_a_session] end)

      # Act: attempt to delete user_a's session with user_b's id
      result = Auth.delete_session(@session_config, user_a_token, user_id: user_b_id)

      # Assert: returns :ok (silent no-op) and session still exists
      assert :ok = result

  describe "delete_all_sessions/3" do
    test "deletes all sessions, returns count, broadcasts PubSub disconnect" do
      ref =
        :telemetry_test.attach_event_handlers(self(), [[:sigra, :session, :revoke_all, :stop]])

      session1 = build_session(%{hashed_token: "hash1"})
      session2 = build_session(%{hashed_token: "hash2"})

      Sigra.MockSessionStore
      |> expect(:list_by_user, fn 1, _opts -> [session1, session2] end)
      |> expect(:delete_all_for_user, fn 1, _opts -> {2, nil} end)

      # Start a PubSub for testing
      start_supervised!({Phoenix.PubSub, name: :test_pubsub})

      # Subscribe to the disconnect topics
      topic1 = "users_sessions:#{Base.url_encode64("hash1")}"
      topic2 = "users_sessions:#{Base.url_encode64("hash2")}"
      Phoenix.PubSub.subscribe(:test_pubsub, topic1)
      Phoenix.PubSub.subscribe(:test_pubsub, topic2)

      result = Auth.delete_all_sessions(@session_config, 1, pubsub: :test_pubsub)

      assert {2, nil} = result
      assert_receive :disconnect
      assert_receive :disconnect
      assert_received {[:sigra, :session, :revoke_all, :stop], ^ref, %{count: 2}, %{user_id: 1}}
    end

    test "with except_token option excludes current session" do
      session1 = build_session(%{hashed_token: "hash1"})
      session2 = build_session(%{hashed_token: "hash2"})

      Sigra.MockSessionStore
      |> expect(:list_by_user, fn 1, _opts -> [session1, session2] end)
      |> expect(:delete_all_for_user, fn 1, opts ->
        assert Keyword.get(opts, :except_token) == "hash1"
        {1, nil}
      end)

      start_supervised!({Phoenix.PubSub, name: :test_pubsub_except})

      topic2 = "users_sessions:#{Base.url_encode64("hash2")}"
      Phoenix.PubSub.subscribe(:test_pubsub_except, topic2)

      # hash1 should NOT get a broadcast
      topic1 = "users_sessions:#{Base.url_encode64("hash1")}"
      Phoenix.PubSub.subscribe(:test_pubsub_except, topic1)

      result =
        Auth.delete_all_sessions(@session_config, 1,
          except_token: "hash1",
          pubsub: :test_pubsub_except
        )

      assert {1, nil} = result
      # hash2 should get disconnect
      assert_receive :disconnect
      # hash1 should NOT get disconnect
      refute_receive :disconnect, 50
    end
  end
